izzyondroid:com.ztftrue.music.name: MonsterMusic
izzyondroid:com.ztftrue.music.summary: Offline music player with native C DSP engine, studio effects, visualizers & lyr
izzyondroid:com.ztftrue.music.description:
MonsterMusic is an open-source, private, and customizable local music player for Android.
 Key Features: 
 Native C DSP Audio Engine: Ultra-low latency audio processing powered by high-performance native C.
 Dual Filter Architectures: Choose between high-precision Biquad IIR filters and 2048-tap linear-phase FFT FIR filters with master stereo-linked soft limiting.
 Studio Audio Effects: Stereo Delay with ping-pong feedback, Reverb, Chorus, Flanger, Polyphony, and Stereo Widening (Spatial Virtualizer), each with dedicated Dry/Wet mix controls.
 Audio Signal Chain Inspector: View real-time audio pipeline details below the cover art (file decoder, sample rate resampler, DSP filter mode, and audio sink).
 Frequency-Reactive Visualizers: Dynamic Matrix Digital Rain and 32-band Audio Spectrum visualizers with frequency reactivity, fullscreen mode, and landscape orientation lock.
 Pitch & Speed Controls: Dual coarse (0.1x) and fine-tuning (0.01x) sliders for tempo and pitch stretching.
 Interactive Synced Lyrics: Smooth auto-scrolling, drag-to-seek timestamp navigation, and tap-to-lookup dictionary popup with multi-dictionary support.
 Video Playback Support: Dedicated Video tab for local video files with battery-saving audio-only background playback and full DSP audio effects. (Disabled by default for privacy; can be enabled in Settings, which requests Android 13+ READ_MEDIA_VIDEO permission strictly to scan and play your local video files). 
 Privacy First & 100% Offline: Operates completely without network requests, no analytics, no ads, and no unnecessary permissions.
 More features and customizations are waiting for your discovery!

World Clock is a simple, modern world clock for checking the local time and weather in cities around the world.

izzyondroid:org.projectsolutus.pomozen.name: Pomozen
izzyondroid:org.projectsolutus.pomozen.summary: Pomodoro timer to boost productivity and focus
izzyondroid:org.projectsolutus.pomozen.description:
Pomozen is a modern, open-source Pomodoro timer app designed to boost productivity and focus. It applies the Pomodoro Technique—structuring work into focused intervals (typically 25 minutes) followed by short breaks. This systematic approach helps combat mental fatigue, maintain concentration, and improve efficiency in work or study.
 Key Features: 
 📊 Comprehensive Statistics: Track focus sessions, break times, and productivity patterns. Custom labels let you track time spent on specific tasks, activities, or anything you want.
 ⏰ Customizable Reminders: Stay on track with personalized notifications. Smoothly transition between focus and break periods.
 💧 Hydration Reminder: Get timely reminders to drink water and stay hydrated throughout your day.
 🧘 Minimal Design: Clean, focused interface built with minimalism at its core—balanced spacing, calm colors, and no distractions.
 📴 Offline Support: No internet? No problem. All features, timers, and logs work offline.
 ⚙️ Fully Customizable Timer: While the default Pomodoro cycle is 25/5/15, you can fine-tune focus time, short/long breaks, session count, and reminder behavior to match your personal workflow.
 Privacy First 
 Pomozen has a strict no data collection policy. All session logs and preferences are stored only on your device—never sent to external servers or third parties.

fdroid:app.soundtree.name: SoundTree Recorder
fdroid:app.soundtree.summary: Audio recorder with topic organization, marks, and page-like waveforms.
fdroid:app.soundtree.description:
SoundTree is a personal audio recorder and organizer with an emphasis on bookmarks.
Everything stays on your device - no accounts, no cloud, no tracking, and no network permission at all.
Record high-quality M4A audio with a live scrolling waveform, pause and resume without starting a new file, and save from the notification while your screen is locked. Drop marks during recording or playback to flag moments worth revisiting. Sort recordings into a hierarchical topic tree, nested as deeply as you like. Back up automatically to an external drive or USB device.
Also supports audio-passthrough to earphones for monitoring audio inputs.

fdroid:com.abhinavxt.debforge.name: DebForge
fdroid:com.abhinavxt.debforge.summary: Download from TorBox, Real-Debrid, AllDebrid, Premiumize and Debrid-Link
fdroid:com.abhinavxt.debforge.description:
DebForge downloads the files in your debrid account straight to your phone, tablet or Android TV. Sign in to one or more services and switch between them any time.
 Supported services 
 TorBox
 Real-Debrid
 AllDebrid
 Premiumize
 Debrid-Link
 Offcloud
 Features 
 Fast downloads with up to 16 connections per file, pause and resume, and automatic link refresh
 Library view with clean titles, series grouped by season, and search across your whole account
 Posters from TMDB (add your own free API key in Settings)
 Add magnet links, .torrent files and links, from the app or by sharing to it, and optionally download them as soon as they're ready
 Built-in player that remembers where you stopped, a Continue watching row, subtitles from the torrent and the next episode ready to go, or play in VLC and others if you prefer
 Player gestures (double-tap to skip, swipe for brightness, volume and seeking, hold for 2×, pinch to zoom), subtitle style, audio and subtitle languages remembered per show, sleep timer, A-B loop, screenshots, picture-in-picture and background play. Downloaded files play offline
 Built-in browser: downloads a page starts go to DebForge's queue, and videos it plays (HLS streams too) are listed to download. Ads, trackers and pop-ups are blocked with uBlock Origin's default filter lists
 Pixeldrain, Google Drive and direct file links download straight to your phone, no service needed
 Follow a show and new episodes that reach your account download by themselves, with a Coming up row showing when the next one airs
 Follow YouTube channels and podcast feeds: new uploads and episodes show up in a New row and can download by themselves, as audio or video
 SponsorBlock (off by default) skips sponsor segments in YouTube videos and audio
 Play on TV: send a stream to a DLNA TV on your Wi-Fi, no Google services needed
 Release preferences: never see CAM or TS releases, and rank the ones you like higher
 Skip intros, recaps and credits; find missing subtitles on OpenSubtitles
 Trakt sync: scrobble what you watch and see what you watched elsewhere
 Home-screen widget, Quick Settings tile and launcher shortcuts
 Signed in to several services? Add to the one that already has it cached
 Free-space check before downloading, and optional auto-delete of old downloads
 Release-group notes, covers and sample clips are kept out of your library
 Rules for Wi-Fi only, charging only, a nightly time window and a speed limit
 Save to any folder, including SD cards and USB drives, with no special permission
 Remove torrents from your service in the app, or automatically once they have downloaded
 See whether a torrent is already cached before adding it (TorBox, Premiumize)
 Data-usage statistics for Wi-Fi and mobile data
 Back up and restore your settings, with optional password-encrypted sign-ins
 Optional Plex/Jellyfin folder layout for shows and movies
 Download a whole TorBox torrent as one zip
 Works on phones, tablets and Android TV
 Seven colour themes, light and dark, pure black for OLED, or your wallpaper colours
 Available in 14 languages
 Privacy 
API keys are encrypted with the Android Keystore and never included in backups. There are no analytics and no ads. If the app crashes, a report with tokens, links and file names removed is kept on your device, and it is only sent if you choose to share it.
A debrid account is optional: the built-in browser and direct links work without one. The debrid services above, and DuckDuckGo (the browser's default start page and search), are proprietary services, which is why F-Droid marks the app with the "Non-Free Network Services" anti-feature.

fdroid:com.gmail.anubhavdas54.whatsdelet.name: WhatsDeleted
fdroid:com.gmail.anubhavdas54.whatsdelet.summary: See WhatsApp messages & media deleted by the sender.
fdroid:com.gmail.anubhavdas54.whatsdelet.description:
Messages & media are saved to a backup location so that you can access them even if the sender deletes them.
How it works:
• Notification Listener logs new messages.
• Media Observer watches for new images.
How to use:
• Allow storage access.
• Allow notification access (tap on the switch next to Notification Listener and follow the instructions).
• Media Observer is turned on by default.
Backup Location:
• Images -> External Storage/WhatsDeleted/WhatsDeleted Images/
Points to note:
• Messages received directly in the chat window (and not in the notifications) won't be saved.
• Images will be saved to the backup directory only if they were downloaded.
• Clear the message log & image directory periodically to save storage space.

fdroid:de.singular.recorder.name: Title Track
fdroid:de.singular.recorder.description:
An Android recorder for music memos. Count yourself in at a tempo you choose, play, and if the third bar goes wrong hit Restart without looking. Takes are written as plain WAV files into a folder you pick, so they are on your phone's storage rather than locked inside the app.
Early-stage release — expect rough edges. Feedback and bug reports welcome via Issues.
 While a take is being made 
* Two buttons that matter — full-width, thumb-height Done and Restart. Done ends the take and saves it; Restart wipes it and counts you back in.
* Count-in — off, one bar or two, at a tempo you set, with an accented downbeat.
* A live waveform while you play — the last eight seconds as a scrolling peak envelope, drawn red near full scale so clipping is visible as it happens.
* Silent visual metronome — one dot per beat under the buttons, the lit one walking the bar, starting with the count-in. On by default because an audible click on a phone speaker ends up inside the take.
* A click through the take (optional, off) — for headphones, where there is nothing for the microphone to pick up.
* Listen before recording (optional, off) — draws what the microphone hears before you press Record, so mic distance is settled while it still costs nothing.
* A level test, not a guess — hold Record and play the loudest thing you will play; it reports the peak in dBFS and offers a gain that puts it at −9 dBFS.
* Recorded honestly — the least-processed microphone source the device offers, and unlike voice recorders no filtering of any kind.
 Tuner 
A third tab, in two faces. A needle, damped like a moving-coil meter so it settles rather than twitches while a peg is turning; and a strobe, two rings that come to a standstill when the string is in tune. There is no guitar/bass switch to set wrong: it names the nearest note across the whole range, with its octave. Equal temperament against A4 = 440 Hz: a guitar tuned on a pedal's sweetened preset will disagree by a few cents, and neither is wrong.
 Your folder, your files 
Pick any folder once — Music/Recording, an SD card, a synced folder; takes land there as 44.1 kHz mono WAV. Browse it in the app, make sub-folders, rename, move, star, share, delete, play back. The bpm you played to is written into the WAV itself as a LIST/INFO comment, so it survives being copied to a computer.
 The player 
Every take is drawn as a peak envelope in decibels — the same shape the record screen drew while you were playing. Touch anywhere on it to seek, drag to scrub, pinch to zoom in. WAV is read straight through; anything else the device can play is decoded and drawn just the same.
* Trim puts two handles on the waveform. A WAV cut to a WAV never decodes — the header is rebuilt and the selected bytes copied through, so what survives is exactly what was recorded.
* Level normalizes a quiet take in the file — Peak, which cannot distort, or Loudness, aiming at −14 dBFS RMS.
* Note attaches whatever the take needs saying about it: the chords, the words, what the idea was.
Both edits offer a choice when saving: overwrite the take, or save a lossless copy beside it as FLAC or WAV, tempo included.
Playback outlives the screen it started from — a mini player sits above the tabs wherever you are.
 Languages 
English and German, with a Language row in Settings. On Android 13 and up that is the per-app language in Android's own Settings.
 Known limitations 
* Recording stops if the app leaves the foreground — Android takes the microphone away from background apps. So keep your hands on the guitar.
* Mono only. Phone microphones are effectively mono.
 Permissions 
The microphone. No internet permission at all — the Support dialog's links open in your browser, which fetches in its own process.
 License 
GPL-3.0-only. The wordmark and the icon are CC BY 4.0; the name is not licensed, so a fork needs its own.

fdroid:dev.bikram.remember.gh.name: Remember: Notes & Reminders
fdroid:dev.bikram.remember.gh.summary: Notes, tasks, and reminders that keep coming back until they are done.
fdroid:dev.bikram.remember.gh.description:
Remember is built around one simple idea: if you dismiss a reminder without finishing the task, it comes back. No important item disappears just because you accidentally swiped away a notification.
Mark the note done, and the reminder is gone for good.
 ━━ 📌 REMINDERS THAT STICK ━━ 
Automatically restore accidentally dismissed reminder notifications until they are actually done. Choose from normal reminders, high-importance reminders with heads-up alerts, critical reminders that ring like an alarm every 15 minutes until done, or a quiet summary notification that keeps overdue and upcoming items pinned in your notification shade.
 ━━ 🔔 NOTIFICATION ACTIONS ━━ 
Add useful one-tap actions directly to reminder notifications so you can act without opening the app:
* Call, Message, or Email
* Get Directions
* Open a link, app, or shortcut
* Copy text or Share content
 ━━ 💤 NATURAL REMINDER PRESETS ━━ 
Set reminders and snooze with Timing (named times such as soon, later today, this evening etc.) or Duration (lengths of time such as 30 mins, 6 hours etc.). A custom date and time are always available.
 ━━ 📅 RECURRING SCHEDULES ━━ 
Create hourly, daily, weekly, monthly, or yearly reminders. Remember also supports richer calendar-style patterns like "the last Friday of every month", with optional end dates or occurrence counts.
 ━━ 📝 MARKDOWN NOTES AND CHECKLISTS ━━ 
Write rich markdown notes with headings, bold, italics, underline, links, and code blocks. Build nested checklists for groceries, packing lists, project steps, or anything else that benefits from structure.
 ━━ 🔍 ORGANIZE AND FIND THINGS ━━ 
Use tags, stars, archive, trash, full-text search, filters, sorting, and bulk actions to keep your notes manageable.
 ━━ 📱 WIDGETS AND QUICK CAPTURE ━━ 
Home screen widgets for upcoming reminders, starred/pinned/tagged notes, and quick capture. A persistent notification or the quick setting tiles can keep note creation one tap away at all times.
 ━━ ☁️ IMPORT FROM GOOGLE TASKS OR TASKS.ORG ━━ 
Move into Remember from Google Tasks using a connected account or a Google Takeout file. Or bring your data from tasks.org. Import is read-only; Remember does not modify or delete your Google Tasks / Tasks.org data.
 ━━ 💾 BACKUP AND RESTORE ━━ 
Export your notes and settings to a backup, optionally including attached media. Restore when moving to a new device, or import a backup to merge notes into your current collection.
 ━━ 🎨 MAKE IT YOURS ━━ 
Choose Material You wallpaper colors, hand-tuned color presets, your own custom colors & fonts, palette styles, gradient backgrounds, black OLED mode, cover images, and more. Theming is deep - the app can look and feel very different from any other notes app on your phone.
 ━━ 🔒 PRIVATE BY DEFAULT ━━ 
Your notes are stored entirely locally. Zero tracking, analytics, or automated background telemetry. No data leaves your phone without your explicit action (such as optional update checks or manually exporting a backup).

fdroid:io.github.chronosauros.contour.name: Contour
fdroid:io.github.chronosauros.contour.summary: The easiest way to manage your dongle. Pick a profile, hold to send. Done.
fdroid:io.github.chronosauros.contour.description:
Contour is a free, open-source app for the parametric EQ stored inside your USB DAC. Keep your EQ profiles on your phone, plug the DAC in, pick a profile and hold to send. Contour writes the EQ into the DAC and reads it back to check every value.
 The EQ stays in the dongle. It is written into the DAC itself, so it works in every app, not just one. On the DACs where Contour has confirmed it, the EQ stays after you unplug and plays on every device you plug the DAC into: another phone, a laptop, a PC or an iPhone. Each DAC's page says what was confirmed. No system equalizer, nothing running in the background.
 Supported DACs, each tested on real hardware 
 CrinEar Protocol Micro
 CrinEar Protocol Max
 FiiO KA15
 FiiO K13 R2R
 FiiO JadeAudio JA11
 FiiO JadeAudio JIEZI
 SnowSky Melody
 SnowSky Tiny A
 SnowSky Retro Nano
 TRN Black Pearl
 Moondrop Dawn Pro 2
 Moondrop Echo-A
 Moondrop DUSK-SP
 Kiwi Ears Allegro Mini
 Kiwi Ears AD1
 Tanchjim Space 2 (Space II)
 JCally JM12
 Made for your DAC 
 Contour only shows what your DAC can do: its bands, filter types and gain range. Where it has several USER slots, you pick one before you send: USER1, USER2 or USER3, or one of ten on the FiiO K13 R2R.
 Tune on the go 
 Drag bands on the response graph, or add one with +.
 Fine-tune frequency, gain and Q with sliders, or tap a number to type it.
 Leave the preamp on AUTO, or tap AUTO off and set it by hand with its slider.
 PEAK on every DAC, plus LOW SHELF, HIGH SHELF, LOW PASS, HIGH PASS, BAND PASS and ALL PASS where your DAC has them.
 Undo and redo, up to 100 steps per profile.
 Your EQ library 
 One profile per pair of IEMs or headphones, or per mood.
 Every profile keeps a saved version: save your changes or restore the saved one.
 Archive the profiles you don't use, delete the ones you don't need.
 Import a parametric profile from AutoEQ, squig.link or Equalizer APO (clipboard or .txt file), or read the EQ that is on the DAC now.
 Share a profile as Equalizer APO text or save it as a .txt file.
 Three profiles to start from: BASS BOOST, SOFTER VOCALS and TREBLE BOOST.
 DAC settings in the same app 
 Most of these DACs have a DAC page with their own settings, such as volume, balance, filter, output or presets. Factory reset on the KA15 and Melody saves a copy of your slots and settings on the phone first.
 Private by design 
 No account, no ads, no analytics. The app has no internet access and talks only to the DAC you plug in. Your profiles stay on your phone and leave it only when you share or save them yourself.
 Good to know 
 Needs Android 9 or newer and a phone with USB host (OTG) support.
 Contour writes to the DAC only when you hold HOLD TO SEND or change a setting on the DAC page.
 Contour does not update firmware.
 Moondrop Dawn Pro 2: its custom EQ has to be switched on. According to Moondrop it is off after every plug-in; holding both volume buttons for 2 seconds toggles it.
 Moondrop DUSK-SP: after every plug-in it plays its DUSK-DEFAULT preset. Tap CUSTOM EQ on the DAC page to hear what you sent.
 TRN Black Pearl: plug your headphones in first. Without them it does not show up on USB.
 Every supported DAC has its own page with its limits and notes: contoureq.app/install
 Contour is free and open source (Apache-2.0) and part of Soundblooms, a small audio label by Chronosaur.
 Unofficial. Not affiliated with or endorsed by CrinEar, FiiO, SnowSky, TRN, Moondrop, Kiwi Ears, Tanchjim or JCally. AutoEQ, squig.link and Equalizer APO are named only as profile formats Contour can read.

fdroid:si.jakobkreft.aftergleam.description:
Hundreds of new research papers appear every day. Aftergleam reads them and shows you the few worth your time.
It learns what you like from how you react to papers. The model is trained on your phone. There is no account, no server of our own, no analytics and no ads.
 Sources 
* arXiv: physics, mathematics, computer science, statistics, economics and more
* bioRxiv and medRxiv: biology and medicine
* PsyArXiv, SocArXiv and EdArXiv: psychology, social science and education
* Law Archive: law
* ChemRxiv: chemistry
* EarthArXiv and EcoEvoRxiv: earth sciences and ecology
* IACR ePrint: cryptography
Only the servers your subjects need are contacted.
 Features 
* A short daily digest, ranked for you
* Explore, for papers just outside your usual reading
* Popular, for what other people are reading
* Each paper says why it was picked
* Read PDFs in the app, find any word in them, copy text, and keep them offline
* A reader view for arXiv papers, with text that fits your screen at the size you choose
* Save papers, search, and import a BibTeX or RIS library from Zotero
* Export and restore your reading history as a plain file
* Light and dark themes, and a serif font and text size of your choice for papers
 Privacy 
Your reading history and the model stay on your device. To fetch papers, the app has to ask the preprint servers for them, so those servers see the requests it makes. The privacy policy lists exactly what is sent.
Aftergleam is free software under the GNU General Public License, version 3 or later.

apple-macos:1166075247.name: ReelToReelLike MusicPlayer
apple-macos:1166075247.description:
This App is music player modeled after an open reel tape.
The open reel tape section rotates and the tape increases and decreases.
In addition to the playback function as a music player, you can freely select the design of the main unit, so it can be used as an interior decoration depending on the location. (As a stylish interior with the background music of the store, as a desk interior)
Not only listening to music, but also watching it is fun and nostalgic, so you can enjoy a relaxing time.
【Feature Description】
-You can register and play your favorite songs in the order you like.
- Songs registered as tapes can be freely deleted and the order of songs can be changed later. You can also add songs.
- Songs can be registered and played on tape only from the sound source within the device.
- Low-speed playback, normal playback, high-speed playback (5 rotational speeds), and rewind/fast forwarding are possible.
- You can choose from 6 different body colors and 5 types reel x 5 colors. There are other items that can be changed in design.
- Compatible with iPhone and iPad in portrait and landscape orientation. The placement of each part changes, resulting in a different image. (For iPad, we now support Split View, Slide Over, and customizable windows.)
【Things impossible】
- You cannot cue, shuffle, or repeat songs.
- Because it is a pseudo tape format, the playback position can only be changed by fast forwarding or rewinding. Fast forwarding or rewinding may take some time.

apple-macos:6773501648.name: Trip Journal: Day by Day.
apple-macos:6773501648.description:
Turn your trips into stories you’ll actually want to revisit.
Trip Journal organizes every journey one day at a time, bringing together your favorite photos and videos, journal entries, places, weather, and maps in one beautiful travel record.
Create a trip and choose its dates. Trip Journal helps organize media from Apple Photos by day. Favorite your best photos and videos first for quick importing, then add daily journal entries, places you visited, and a vibe that captures each day.
Browse all your memories in the Trip Gallery, see geotagged photos on a map, and create a printable Trip Book PDF with a cover and a page for every day.
Whether it’s a weekend getaway, family vacation, road trip, cruise, or once-in-a-lifetime adventure, Trip Journal gives you one place to preserve the story behind the photos.
Features
- Create a journal for each trip
- Organize memories day by day
- Import favorite photos and videos
- Write daily journal entries and reflections
- Record places visited each day
- Add day vibes such as Scenic Drive, Best Meal, Beach Day, and more
- View and edit historical weather details
- See geotagged photos on a map
- Browse every memory in the Trip Gallery
- Create printable Trip Book PDFs
- Sync your journal across iPhone, iPad, and Mac with iCloud
- Explore a built-in sample trip before creating your own
- Your trips are more than dates and destinations. They’re stories worth remembering.
Free to Try
Create up to three trips for free. A single one-time purchase unlocks unlimited trips. No subscription required.
- Unlock unlimited trips with a one-time purchase
iCloud and Privacy
Your journal is stored on your devices and can sync through the private CloudKit database associated with your Apple account. To view imported photos and videos across devices, iCloud Photos must be enabled using the same Apple account.
Trip Journal contains no advertising and uses no third-party analytics. Photo dates and locations are used only to organize your memories, display maps, and retrieve historical weather.

apple-macos:911802606.description:
Traveling is all about experiencing new adventures and places. Documenting and capturing these memories is the focus of Travel Journal. Keeping your memories alive using a Travel Journal has been a tradition for most seasoned traveler for decades. Simply being able to revisit specific moments of your trip will make you smile.
Travel Journal is well organized and structured. The user interface is simple to use and the added features make this modern day journal work of art. You will be proud of your Travel Journal and the simplicity of making entries will ensure that you document all your adventures every day. Traveling is also about sharing your experiences with families and friends. 
On any trip Travel Journal will be your best friend. Reflecting on what took place during your vacation makes all your experiences more vivid. There is no better time to document your travel escapades than in real time. By the time you get home it is almost to late to document the little things like the smells of an open air market or the details of a mysterious person you met.
Capture your precious moments using the diverse features of Travel Journal and arrange it with text, photos and maps on a day by day basis.
Travel Journal is a creative journaling app, designed for you to write down your everyday activities, thoughts, locations, lessons learned, experiences, research results, appointment schedules and anything else that you would like to document.
Following features are at your finger tips:
# Map
# Drag & Drop or Add Pics
# Smileys
# Full Screen mode
# Password Protected
# Tags
HAPPY JOURNALING!

uRSS - Read the Web. Listen to Podcasts. On Your Terms.
Tired of algorithms deciding what you should see? uRSS gives you full control over your reading experience - no “For You” pages, no engagement bait, no corporate curation. Just the feeds and podcasts you choose, delivered cleanly and directly.
Key Features:
• Universal Feed Support - Subscribe to any RSS, Atom, or JSON feed by pasting a URL (we’ll automatically clean it up). Add feeds to folders or browse them individually - your rules, your way.
• Beautiful Reading Views - Choose from five list styles: clean Headline Only, Headline with Icon, Standard, or Large views with thumbnails and summaries. Adjustable font sizes, four font families, optional separators, and subtle grayscale icons.
• Effortless Navigation - In article view, swipe up from the bottom to go to the next article or pull down from the top to go back. Bookmark important articles, mark as read without opening, and enjoy smooth swipe gestures throughout.

apple-macos:6817130093.name: Fullday: Fitness, Food & Sleep
apple-macos:6817130093.description:
Fullday puts your whole day in one app: strength training, runs and rides, food, sleep and recovery. No account. No ads. No tracking.
Available in 50 languages.
TRAIN
• Log a set in one tap, with routines, programs and a rest timer on your Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island.
• Lifting records, plate and warm-up calculators and progression suggestions with Pro.
• Bring your workout, food and run history from other apps' export files, free.
RUN AND RIDE
• Record runs, rides, walks and hikes with GPS on your iPhone, or on your Apple Watch alone.
• Workouts and routes that other watches and apps save to Apple Health come in by themselves.
• Your best mile, 5K and 10K, found inside every run. Personal segments with your own leaderboard.
• Bluetooth heart-rate straps, power meters, speed and cadence sensors and footpods, free.
• Challenges, badges and a heatmap of everywhere you've been, with a privacy zone around home.
• Running and riding plans that read last night's sleep, and a route builder with turn cues on your wrist (Pro).
EAT
• Search hundreds of thousands of brand-name foods, even offline.
• Menus from 197 restaurant chains, from each chain's own published nutrition.
• Scan a barcode for a free product score out of 100, with the reasons in plain English: a Nutrition grade, how processed it is, and additives with their official status and source. Better-scoring swaps from the same aisle.
• Snap your plate and AI estimates each food and portion. You check every amount before it's saved. 3 photos a week free, more with Pro.
• Fuelling for training: what to eat and drink around long or hard sessions (Pro).
SLEEP AND RECOVER
• Free Recovery, Strain and Sleep scores from Apple Health and Apple Watch.
• Body signals: last night's HRV, resting heart rate, breathing rate, wrist temperature and blood oxygen against your own normal.
• Rest Mode for sick, injured, travel or stressed days: training waits and streaks don't break.
• Smart wake on Apple Watch, a bedside night screen, sleep sounds and a nap alarm.
• Snoring and sleep-talk detection, worked out on your iPhone (Pro).
YOUR DAY, AT A GLANCE
• Your day: last night's sleep, your meals, your training and the plan ahead on one ring, in the app and as a widget.
• Widgets, Live Activities and Siri shortcuts.
COACHING YOU CAN CHECK
• Every tip names the guideline or study it comes from.
• Coach chat: ask about your sleep, food and training, back and forth. You see exactly what's sent before you agree, and answers name their sources. 3 questions a week free, more with Pro.
Fullday doesn't diagnose anything and isn't medical advice.
CLUBS
• Private clubs for your team, gym crew or family: a weekly leaderboard, club challenges and cheers. Invite-only, kept in iCloud, and you choose what's shared. Free, 13 and up.
YOUR YEAR, WRAPPED
Weekly and monthly recaps, and Fullday Wrapped every December, made on your phone.
PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account to create. No ads. No analytics. No tracking.
• Your log lives on your devices, and in your own private iCloud with Pro.
• A meal photo or a coach message leaves your phone only when you send it.
FULLDAY PRO
Fullday is free to download, and the free app is a real app. Fullday Pro adds coaching on your scores, Coach chat, more AI meal photos, unlimited routines, your full history, personal records, plans, the route builder and iCloud sync. Extra AI credits, for more coach questions and meal photos, are a separate one-time purchase and never expire. Pro is a yearly subscription with a 7-day free trial, a monthly subscription, or a one-time purchase. Payment is charged to your Apple Account. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period. Manage or cancel in your Apple Account settings.
Terms of Use: https://getfullday.app/terms.html
Privacy Policy: https://getfullday.app/privacy.html

apple-macos:940668697.name: Opus One - Digital Planner
apple-macos:940668697.description:
Opus One is a real day planner, not another to-do app. Each day gets its own page — tasks with A/B/C priorities, your schedule, and notes — on a planner that looks and feels like paper. Plan on your Mac, and it all stays in sync with iPhone and iPad.
YOUR DAY ON ONE PAGE
• Daily Tasks with A/B/C priorities, status, notes, and alarms.
• A schedule that shows your Calendar events alongside your tasks.
• Drag a task onto the schedule — with task durations, the end time fills in automatically.
• Daily Notes with photos, PDFs, checklists, and audio.
• Today's weather and a daily quote, right on the page.
PLAN BEYOND TODAY
• Master Tasks: everything on your mind in one list, no due date required.
• Goals with timelines, photos, and progress you can see.
• Roles: review the areas of your life each week so nothing important gets crowded out.
• Mission, Values, and Vision pages to keep the big picture one click away.
• Meeting Planner for agendas, decisions, and next steps.
NOTES AND JOURNALS
• Rich notes with fonts, colors, tags, and your own custom sections.
• Sketches and handwriting made with Apple Pencil on iPad sync straight to your Mac.
• Journals with 25 covers to choose from, plus a guided Gratitude Journal.
ACROSS ALL YOUR DEVICES
• Widgets for today's tasks, your mission, your values, and daily quotes.
• Add a task with Siri.
• iCloud sync across Mac, iPhone, and iPad.
MAKE IT YOURS
• Planner themes, including seasonal ones.
• Task-complete sounds and rewards for finishing what you planned.
• Color-coded categories and repeating rules with advanced options.
OPUS ONE PRO
The core planner is free. Opus One Pro adds cloud sync across all your devices, weather, attachments (images, PDFs, audio), categories, repeating rules, Goals, Siri, and themes. One subscription covers Mac, iPhone, and iPad on the same iCloud account. Available yearly or monthly.

The app uses a technique called deep learning to analyze and understand the content of a given photo, then applies a variety of filters and effects to create a new, AI-generated image. One of the key features of the app is the ability to apply a wide range of filters to a photo, allowing users to experiment with different styles and effects. Users can also upload their own photos to the app, and use them as the starting point for their AI-generated art.
The app is free to use, and generates high-quality images that can be used for a variety of purposes, such as portraits, graphics for social media, and text-based art. flathub:eu.nimmerfort.blackbody.description:
Blackbody is a viewer for FLIR, Fluke, HTI, and IRG thermograms and other thermal images. Explore temperatures under the cursor, render to different palettes and ranges, overlay the visible-light photo, and inspect embedded measurements and camera metadata.
 Blackbody reads thermograms from many FLIR cameras, including the visible-light photo, and also opens Fluke thermograms from cameras such as the Ti400, Ti401p, TiS75+, and Ti25, HTI / ToolTop thermograms, and IRG thermograms such as the Topdon TC004. Plain thermal data can be imported and exported as single-band TIFFs or 16-bit PNGs.
 Features:
 Inspect the temperature under the cursor, in celsius, fahrenheit, or kelvin
 View embedded measurements: spots, lines, and areas
 Overlay view (Picture-in-Picture or MSX) combining thermal and visible images
 Render to the camera's embedded palette or many built-in ones, including inferno and turbo
 Adjust the temperature range to make details stand out
 Metadata panel with camera info and GPS location, openable in a map
 Export renders to PNG and thermal data to TIFF or 16-bit PNG
 Zoom, pan, and browse through a folder of thermograms
 Translated to multiple languages

flathub:org.thentrythis.Samplebrain.description:
Samplebrain chops samples up into a 'brain' of interconnected small sections called blocks which are connected into a network by similarity. It processes a target sample, chopping it up into blocks in the same way, and tries to match each block with one in it's brain to play in realtime.
 This allows you to interpret a sound with a different one. As we worked on it (during 2015 and 2016) we gradually added more and more tweakable parameters until it became slightly out of control.

fedora-packages:grout/grout.name: grout
fedora-packages:grout/grout.description: grout stands for Graph Router. In English, "grout" refers to thin mortar that hardens to fill gaps between tiles. grout is a DPDK based network processing application. It uses the rte_graph library for data path processing. Its main purpose is to simulate a network function or a physical router for testing/replicating real (usually closed source) VNF/CNF behavior with an open-source tool. It comes with a client library to configure it over a standard UNIX socket and a CLI that uses that library. The CLI can be used as an interactive shell, but also in scripts one command at a time, or by batches.

It is in beta stage and doesn't support all of rsync features, but can be effectively used to synchronize local directories. For example some people use grsync to synchronize their music collection with removable devices or to backup personal files to a networked drive.

fedora-packages:haveged/haveged.name: haveged
fedora-packages:haveged/haveged.summary: A Linux entropy source using the HAVEGE algorithm
fedora-packages:haveged/haveged.description: A Linux entropy source using the HAVEGE algorithm Haveged is a user space entropy daemon which is not dependent upon the standard mechanisms for harvesting randomness for the system entropy pool. This is important in systems with high entropy needs or limited user interaction (e.g. headless servers). Haveged uses HAVEGE (HArdware Volatile Entropy Gathering and Expansion) to maintain a 1M pool of random bytes used to fill /dev/random whenever the supply of random bits in /dev/random falls below the low water mark of the device. The principle inputs to haveged are the sizes of the processor instruction and data caches used to setup the HAVEGE collector. The haveged default is a 4kb data cache and a 16kb instruction cache. On machines with a cpuid instruction, haveged will attempt to select appropriate values from internal tables.

Hspell 1.4 still follows the old (pre June 2017) spelling standard of the Academy of the Hebrew Language.

firefox-addons:2955092.name: SYNTEX Privacy Shield
firefox-addons:2955092.summary:
Blocks trackers and strips browser fingerprinting headers so websites can't 
identify or profile you. Runs entirely in your browser. No data leaves your
device. Free forever. Donations welcome.
firefox-addons:2955092.description:
SYNTEX Privacy Shield v4.0 — rebuilt from the ground up.
WHAT IT DOES 
Tracker Blocking 
Blocks outright requests to known analytics and surveillance infrastructure:
Google Analytics, Facebook Pixel, DoubleClick, Hotjar, Segment, Amplitude, 
Mixpanel, FullStory, Intercom, LinkedIn Insights, Criteo, and more.
 Fingerprint Header Stripping 
 Removes the browser fingerprinting headers sites use to identify you across
 sessions — the entire sec-ch-ua-* family, x-client-data, sec-gpc, and others —
 before they leave your device.
 Traffic Pattern Obfuscation 
 Randomizes Accept-Language and Accept-Encoding values and shuffles header order on every request. Disrupts behavioral fingerprinting that tracks you by how your browser talks, not just what it says. 
No fake data injection, no promises about being "undetectable," no premium tier. Privacy tools that over claim are security liabilities. This does what it says, nothing more. 
PRIVACY 
No telemetry. No analytics. No data collection. Everything runs locally in your browser. Source available at codeberg.org/SYNTEX/firefox_privacy_shield . 
SUPPORT
Free forever. If it's useful, donations keep development going — button is in 
the extension popup. 
Works on Firefox desktop and Firefox for Android.

firefox-addons:824288.name: Search by Image
firefox-addons:824288.summary: A powerful reverse image search tool, with support for various search engines, such as Google, Bing, Yandex, Baidu and TinEye.
firefox-addons:824288.description:
Search by Image is a browser extension for Firefox that makes effortless reverse image searches possible, and comes with support for more than 30 search engines.
Search by Image is an open source project made possible thanks to a community of awesome supporters. If you'd like to support the continued development of the extension, please consider contributing with Patreon , PayPal or Bitcoin .
The extension helps journalists and researchers verify the authenticity of images, and assists in the identification of false information on social media. Search by Image is also popular among photographers, helping artists explore how their work is shared on the web, while shoppers find it valuable for discovering similar products at discounted prices.
The extension enables you to search for images from the context menu and the browser toolbar with the help of a diverse set of reverse image search engines, which can be toggled and reordered from the extension's options. Visit the wiki for the full list of supported search engines.
 https://github.com/dessant/search-by-image/wiki/Search-engines 
Images positioned at the selected area are detected regardless of how they were embedded in the page. The extension also supports searching with images from your device, images from private sites, and captured areas of the page.
A handful of search modes are offered that serve different use cases. The search mode can be set independently for the context menu and the browser toolbar from the extension's options.
 Search modes: 
 Select URL : select an image on the page and search with the image URL. This is the default search mode.
 Select image : select an image on the page and search with the image file. This search mode is preferred for sites which do not allow the direct linking of images, such as private sites.
 Capture : search with a captured area of the page.
 Browse : search with an image from your device. Pasting images from the clipboard is also supported on desktop platforms.
 URL : search with an image URL.
Known issues:
 Firefox Multi-Account Containers replaces created tabs and breaks the extension ( issue )
The extension is also available for Chrome and Safari .
The image you select during a search is sent to the requested service, visit the extension's privacy policy for more information.
 Reviews are not monitored for bug reports, please use GitHub for issues and feature requests. 
 https://github.com/dessant/search-by-image

firefox-addons:3054104.name: Security Toolkit
firefox-addons:3054104.summary: Right-click a suspicious link and see what is behind it: one page that combines urlscan.io, VirusTotal, AbuseIPDB and domain age. Then block the bad domains in NextDNS with one click.
firefox-addons:3054104.description:
Your junk folder, investigated. Got a spam, scam or phishing mail? Right-click the link, choose Security Analysis > Analyse link, and Security Toolkit opens one clear page that tells you how the attack works and what to block. No copy-pasting between five websites. One page, four steps
  • Analyse: the extension takes the link apart on your own computer: unwraps Safe Links and other redirect wrappers, decodes hidden data, spots look-alike domains and personalised tracking IDs.
  • Check: urlscan.io (screenshot and verdict), VirusTotal (70+ engines), AbuseIPDB (server reputation) and domain age each get their own card that fills in live. One overall assessment combines them.
  • Look deeper: optionally fetch the page from your own connection, without cookies, and follow the redirect chain. The page is read as text only; nothing is rendered or run.
  • Decide: tick the attacker's domains and add them to your NextDNS denylist, for one profile or all of them. Popular platforms are never suggested.
Made for batches Collect suspicious links during the day, scan the whole queue in one go and block everything that was flagged. Friendly to use
  • Spinners and a progress bar show that something is happening, and buttons lock so you cannot click twice.
  • Light and dark mode, keyboard friendly, and quiet: choose whether you get notifications.
  • Copy the result as Markdown for a ticket or abuse report (links are defanged), or download it as JSON.
Privacy
  • No account with me, no analytics, no tracking.
  • Your API keys stay in Firefox. The link only goes to the services you choose to run, and only after you click.
  • AbuseIPDB only receives an IP address.
  • The built-in Quick Scan works without any API key.
What you need The Quick Scan needs nothing. For the reputation cards, bring your own free API keys for urlscan.io , VirusTotal and AbuseIPDB. For blocking, add your NextDNS API key. Made by Paul Rutten. Questions or ideas: securitytoolkit@paulrutten.nl

bluejetty:00087914:ios.name: 城巴 Citybus
bluejetty:00087914:ios.summary:
1. Next Bus Arrival Time Enquiry function with driving status of the bus
- Display ETA of the next 3 arrivals within 60 minutes of all Citybus routes, including KMB and Long Win departures for jointly operated routes and the ETA of Kowloon
bluejetty:00087914:ios.description:
1. Next Bus Arrival Time Enquiry function with driving status of the bus
- Display ETA of the next 3 arrivals within 60 minutes of all Citybus routes, including KMB and Long Win departures for jointly operated routes and the ETA of Kowloon Motor Bus / Long Win Bus, New Lantao Bus, MTR Bus and Green minibuses provided by Data.gov.hk
- Exclusively display actual distance between current location of the travelling bus and the selected stop on Citybus routes. Alert user when delay is detected or when the bus cannot continue its journey.
- Able to customize ETA display method in “countdown minutes” or “arrival time”.
2. Nearby Route search, get ETA of all franchised buses and minibus routes nearby
- Display next bus ETA and nearest bus stop of all routes within 400m radius from current or selected location.
- The routes bookmarked or frequently checked will be displayed on the top of the list.
- You can manage routes bookmarked or checked in “Bookmark” and “History” page.
3. Find Nearby Bus Stop on map
- Click a bus stop on the map to show all routes calling that bus stop, next bus ETA.
4. Powerful Bookmark function with push notification on latest news
- Retrieve next bus ETA of desired routes in the “Bookmark” page after bookmarking a route and bus stop. Sequence of the bookmarks can be “Edited” to put favorite routes on top.
- With push notification enabled, you can receive route specific customer notice and special arrangement referencing the bookmarks.
- Origin and destination can also be bookmarked to speed up nearby bus stop search and point-to-point search.
5. Look for ETA by destination
- By clicking the new “Destination” button at main page, the system will suggest direct Citybus routes from user current location to the selected destination, with ETA to the nearest bus stop.
- If there is no direct route, the system will suggest a combination of Citybus routes to the destination.
6. Intelligent Point to Point Route Search
- Display the fastest, cheapest or less walking required Citybus routes at your selected time of travel
- Provide estimated journey time integrating timetable, historical bus journey times, ETA and user walking time.
- Octopus interchange and fare concessions are included when displaying fare.
7. Alight reminder
- Remind you to alight in 2 phases according to the distance to the bus stop. You can preset up to 10 alight reminders. The reminder will be deleted automatically upon arrival.
8. Instant Traffic News
- Provide special traffic news from Transport Department & Citybus
9. Fare Concession
- You can go to the Citybus fare concession page with just one click to view the various bus-bus interchange and other fare discounts we offer
Remarks:
- Automatic search for nearest routes and bus stops function uses location service of your device.
- When alight reminder is enabled, the app uses location service of your device continuously until arriving at the selected bus stop, which may drain battery.
- Next bus ETA, alight reminder and search result of point to point search are for reference only, subject to traffic conditions.

Solo seamlessly connects your work accounts to a single app so that you can manage your income, track your expenses, project your taxes and guarantee your daily pay. If you optimize your schedule using Solo’s pay predictions and earn less, we’ll pay you the difference. 

How does it work?

Download the app and link your gig work accounts
Start tracking your income, expenses, estimated taxes and access personalized pay predictions
Save thousands on taxes and earn up to 20% more per week

FEATURES
PAY PREDICTIONS & DAILY GUARANTEES
We crunch the numbers using real earnings data from the Solo community in your city. This allows Solo to produce pay predictions by hour and by job that you can use to optimize your schedule. When you schedule your work using these predictions, we guarantee your daily pay. If you make less than what we predicted, we’ll pay you the difference.

INCOME INSIGHTS
Manage your income from all of your gig jobs in one place to understand where you’re earning the most and how you compare to others in your city.

MILEAGE TRACKING
Automatically track your driving miles so that you can maximize your deductions and save thousands of dollars come tax season

TAX PROJECTIONS
Don’t be surprised come tax time - know what your estimated tax amount may be so that you can prepare ahead of time. *Solo only provides a projection for the income & expenses you track through the Solo app. Your actual tax liability may be different and you should consult a qualified tax professional.

LEADERBOARD
Curious how you stack up? Check out the earnings leaderboard to see how you stack up relative to other Solopreneurs

MARKETPLACE
Know you’re making the most with your time by seeing the hourly rates and weekly trends for gig jobs in your city

Privacy Policy: https://www.worksolo.com/privacy-policy

bluejetty:00097359:android.name: Yeti Sports Action
bluejetty:00097359:android.summary: Yeti is practicing javelin throw with a penguin. Help him achieve the record breaking feat by releasing the penguin when it is at its peak. If Yeti gets skilled enough, he might go to the Olympics and get a gold medal! That would make him r
bluejetty:00097359:android.description:
Yeti is practicing javelin throw with a penguin. Help him achieve the record breaking feat by releasing the penguin when it is at its peak. If Yeti gets skilled enough, he might go to the Olympics and get a gold medal! That would make him really happy!
The object of the game is to swing a penguin and throw him up in the air as high as possible. Click once to start swinging and again to release. Timing is everything to get the swing right, and with the help of the sea lions who toss the penguin further into the air you could get a cool top score. I bet that penguin feels sore in the morning though!
Seal Bounce represents the title of the third installment in the series of yeti Sports. As for the first two games, you will still remain in frozen territories where a new challenge appeared. This time, the adventure goes vertically for the penguin, as he will not have to travel in terms of length.
You will have to spin the penguin in your hands (in Yeti's hands, to be more specific) until you feel that you can throw it perfectly enough to go upwards. Other than that, you will also have some help from some seals that are on the sides of the "tunnel."
The game presented here is called Yeti Sports 3. It’s a strategy game featuring the legendary Yeti. Now, in this edition you’ll help our legendary hero to beat the record of throwing the penguins into the air.
The aim is to have fun and laugh while using the spacebar and your mouse. Enjoy the fine graphics, the snowy landscapes, the sea lions and more.
Now, in Yeti Sports 3 the Yeti will be on a small iceberg and he’ll launch his friends the penguins just like an olympic athlete throwing the hammer. They’ll spin high up in the air between two walls of ice and the sea lions will help them even getting higher if one of the walls gets touched.

bluejetty:00070135:ios.description:
One photo is all it takes.
Clear a blemish, smooth your skin, erase wrinkles, put on a full makeup look, change your hair color, swap the background entirely. No hopping between apps — BeautyTune does all of it.
■ Why BeautyTune
· Your photos never leave your phone. Every edit — even AI work like wrinkle and object removal — runs on your iPhone, so nothing gets uploaded to a server. It all works in airplane mode.
· No banner ads, no full-screen interruptions. Nothing breaks your flow while you edit.
· Most of it is free. Blemish removal, skin smoothing, eyes and teeth, skin tone, filters, text, and mosaic cost nothing.
· Retouching that knows when to stop. Skin keeps its texture, lipstick keeps its true shade, and hair never blows out to white.
· Mistakes are cheap. Undo step by step, or save your session and come back to it later.
■ Face and skin
· Blemish removal — tap a spot and it blends into the surrounding skin.
· Skin smoothing — smooth, with real texture kept intact. Never waxy.
· Wrinkle removal — AI finds nasolabial folds, forehead lines, crow's feet, frown lines, and the under-eye area and marks them. Pick only the areas you want, and use the intensity slider to decide how much to smooth away.
· Eyes and teeth — clear the whites, whiten teeth, soften dark circles.
· Smile — lifts the corners of your mouth and adds a natural eye smile for a relaxed, happy expression.
· Skin tone — shift your overall tone warmer or cooler.
■ Makeup and hair
· Looks — put on a full makeup look in one tap with 10 built-in looks, and set how strong it is with a single slider. Save the combinations you love as your own looks.
· Foundation — an even base in 21 shades. Choose the coverage and a finish: Natural, Matte, or Radiant.
· Blush — adds a soft flush to the apples of your cheeks, with a Natural, Matte, or Glow finish.
· Lipstick — pick a shade, then a finish: Natural, Gloss, or Matte.
· Brows — pick a shade, then a finish: Natural, Powder, or Pencil.
· Eyeshadow — lays one of 15 shades across your eyelids, solo or two-tone, in a Matte, Shimmer, or Metallic finish.
· Eyeliner — draws along your own lash line in one of 10 shades. Styles: Natural, Thin, Cat Eye, Bold, and Smudge.
· Lashes — drawn strand by strand along your lash roots. 5 styles and 5 mascara colors.
· Hair color — recognizes hair precisely and colors only that.
· Hair shine — adds a natural gloss to your hair.
■ Backgrounds
· Blur, solid color, gradient, photo, or mosaic — change it however you like.
· Separate the subject from the background and treat each one differently.
· Save your own gradient combinations as presets.
■ Finishing touches
· Filters and adjustments — fine control over brightness, contrast, saturation, and warmth. You can also split the subject from the background and adjust each separately.
· Text — add words in any font, color, background, and alignment.
· Mosaic and blur — brush over just what you want hidden, with either mosaic or blur.
■ Continue editing
Save a session and pick it up later, exactly where you left off. Your undo history comes back with it.
■ BeautyTune Pro
· Save at original quality, with no logo
· AI object removal — paint over what you want gone and the background fills itself in
· AI wrinkle removal — smooths away the wrinkles it finds, naturally
· Hair color, brow color and finishes, and the Smile tool
· Premium makeup — two-tone and metallic eyeshadow, Cat Eye, Bold, and Smudge eyeliner plus metallic, 4 lash styles, and up to 10 saved looks
· Every premium background
Cancel anytime.

Privacy Policy: https://potatopiegames.blogspot.com/2025/01/privacy-policy-for-beautytune.html

bluejetty:00066392:ios.name: Scrapyard Tycoon Idle Game
bluejetty:00066392:ios.summary: You can become an idle scrapyard tycoon! You’ve got the dream job here at your scrapyard, where you’ve got to manage all the machines and work stations to earn the most cash and make as much profit as you can - you are a tycoon after all…!
bluejetty:00066392:ios.description:
You can become an idle scrapyard tycoon! You’ve got the dream job here at your scrapyard, where you’ve got to manage all the machines and work stations to earn the most cash and make as much profit as you can - you are a tycoon after all…! Do you crush cars or recycle them? Upgrade your crane? Expand your warehouse if it’s too full?
This is how the idle scrapyard tycoon game works…Cars are delivered to the car lot, the crane then moves them to the car breaker where workers from removal stations go to remove parts from the cars. These are then moved to the crusher and the spare parts go to the warehouse. Players later unlock crafting stations such as the wheel workstation. They can buy blueprints to craft different items. All to become an idle scrapyard tycoon and become a millionaire capitalist!
You’ve got to keep your customers happy so complete all their orders! Go to the car trader so you can buy old cars and take off spare parts…or do you just take them to the big crusher! 
There are different work stations for you to manage. The Wheel Workstation, the Car Body Part Workstation, the Interior Workstation and the Mechanics Workstation. You’ll need to invest here to earn idle cash and boost your profits as a scrapyard tycoon. This is the start of a new empire to become a millionaire! You can earn offline or online. 
Crafting is a really important part of the game to earn cash and grow your profit and earnings. Everything from tyres to windows glass to sat navs. You’ve got to buy blueprints to craft all the different car parts in your scrapyard. Buy, sell, trade, earn and profit. It’s all in your hands!!
And don’t forget, you are helping to recycle car parts here so you’re also saving the planet with all this crafting, trading and recycling. Thank you! Someone’s trash could be your treasure - think of the cash and earnings, you genius tycoon!
Your warehouse is important as you need to store your parts here, but you’ll need to make sure the warehouse is upgraded with your profit investments so you have enough room to keep earning more cash to become a millionaire - even a billionaire! You’ve got to grow your capitalist empire - cranes, crushers, car lots, storage and more. This is how to get rich!
—- Your Idle Scrapyard Tycoon game team —-
https://www.neonplay.com
support@neonplay.com

Arrive in your new time zone and sleep when you need to — without waiting days to adjust.

* Exhausted but awake at 3am

Save your trip
Find 2 pressure points (guided in the app)
Apply pressure for a few minutes

bluejetty:00039966:ios.name: 4league - Tournament Maker
bluejetty:00039966:ios.summary: 4league is the football tournament maker, league maker and bracket generator for real competitions: create a football league, cup or group tournament, generate the fixtures, publish standings and share live scores with your teams and fans.
bluejetty:00039966:ios.description:
4league is the football tournament maker, league maker and bracket generator for real competitions: create a football league, cup or group tournament, generate the fixtures, publish standings and share live scores with your teams and fans. Free to start.
TOURNAMENT MAKER & LEAGUE MAKER
Create a league, cup, knockout tournament, group stage or playoffs in minutes. The fixture generator builds the whole schedule for you: round robin (Berger tables), single or double elimination bracket, groups followed by a knockout bracket, home and away series, promotion and relegation between leagues. Football, soccer and futsal rules for any team size, from 1v1 or 3v3 to 5-a-side, 7-a-side and 11-a-side.
FIXTURE GENERATOR & MATCH SCHEDULER
Set dates, pitches and kick-off times, postpone or replay a match, move a game between rounds and let the schedule update itself. Assign referees, manage suspended players and keep every round in order.
LEAGUE TABLE, STANDINGS & STATISTICS
The league table updates the moment a result comes in. Standings, top scorers, assists, cards, clean sheets, team form and player statistics for every competition and every season. Archive a season, restart it and promote or relegate teams automatically.
LIVE SCORES & NOTIFICATIONS
Enter goals, cards, substitutions and fouls minute by minute. Fans, parents and players get live scores and push notifications, vote the man of the match and follow the news.
APPLE WATCH APP: SCORE FROM YOUR WRIST
Referees, organizers and team managers run a live match from Apple Watch: start the match, add goals, cards, fouls and substitutions and end the game without taking out the iPhone. Actions are stored offline and synced when the watch reconnects (Pro plan, needs the iPhone app).
TEAM MANAGER APP
Team page with logo, kit and cover, squad management, friendly matches outside the tournament, team statistics per league and per season. Pick a formation, tick your starters and they are placed on the pitch by position; swap them, auto-fill the lineup or save it as the team default. Register the team in any competition with a code and invite players in one tap.
PLAYER PROFILES
Players get a personal profile with goals, assists, matches played, ratings and achievements that follow them from team to team and from tournament to tournament. Join a team and share your player card.
CLUBS, ASSOCIATIONS & FEDERATIONS
Organize a whole club or federation: board and organization chart with departments and roles, referees, player registrations and medical clearance, sanctions, transfer windows, polls, news and media. Affiliated clubs and their teams roll up into the organization's rankings.
WEBSITE WIDGETS & DATA API
Embed standings, matches, teams and players on your club website with widgets in your colors and language. Developers can read the organization's data through the Data API (Pro plan).
TRAINING SESSIONS
Schedule training sessions, take attendance, rate each player and follow their progress over the season.
POSTERS & SHARING
Generate match day posters, league table images and player cards ready for Instagram, Facebook and WhatsApp. Share a tournament, team or player with one link that opens the app or the web.
WHO IS 4LEAGUE FOR
• Tournament organizers and league managers running amateur football, 5-a-side, 7-a-side, futsal or 11-a-side competitions
• Clubs, associations and federations organizing teams, referees, registrations and rankings in one place
• Team managers and coaches who want a football team app for the whole season
• Players tracking their own statistics
• Fans and parents following live scores and standings
Available in 24 languages on iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch and the web at 4league.app. Create your football tournament or league today with the free tournament maker and bracket generator built for real pitches.
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00040614:ios.summary:
Al-Mujib App: A Leading Platform for Digital Religious Jurisprudence (Ifta’)
Al-Mujib serves as a contemporary bridge linking users with a specialized scholarly team providing authoritative responses derived from the risalah amaliyyah (prac
bluejetty:00040614:ios.description:
Al-Mujib App: A Leading Platform for Digital Religious Jurisprudence (Ifta’)
Al-Mujib serves as a contemporary bridge linking users with a specialized scholarly team providing authoritative responses derived from the risalah amaliyyah (practical treatises) of prominent Jafari Maraji such as Sayyid al-Khoei, Sayyid al-Sistani, Sayyid al-Hakim, and Shaykh al-Fayyad. It boasts a clear and intuitive interface, supporting multiple languages including Arabic, Azeri, Urdu, English, and Persian.
Key Features:
1. Responses to Religious Queries:
Users can directly submit their theological, jurisprudential, or family-related questions via the app, receiving verified and precise answers explicitly based on the recognized Maraji’s views, accompanied by detailed religious evidence whenever necessary.
2. User-Friendly Interface:
An intuitive design categorizes questions neatly into theological, jurisprudential, and social domains, facilitating anonymous submissions.
The app undergoes regular updates to enhance user experience and swiftly address technical issues.
3. Privacy and Security:
Only essential data is collected strictly for improving service quality, with a firm policy ensuring user data is never sold or shared with third parties.
Users maintain complete control over their accounts, with the ability to delete personal information or submitted questions at any time.
4. Supporting Services:
• Includes an extensive digital library with diverse educational materials, including Quranic exegesis (tafsir), jurisprudence, and other Islamic sciences.
• Interactive quizzes designed to foster religious knowledge and enhance user engagement.
5. Comprehensive Knowledge Base:
Features thousands of pre-answered, systematically categorized questions across theological, jurisprudential, and familial topics, validated through:
• Authentic narrations from the Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them).
• Clearly marked diverse scholarly opinions when differences among Maraji exist.
6. Multilingual Support:
Both the application’s interface and scholarly responses are fully accessible in Arabic, Azeri, Urdu, English, and Persian, providing broad international usability.

HOW TO PLAY THE REVERSE SINGING CHALLENGE
1. Record yourself singing a line of a song or saying something.
2. Tap Play Reverse to hear it backwards.
3. Record yourself singing what you heard.
4. Reverse your new recording and hear how close you got to the original.
WHAT YOU CAN DO
• Reverse audio instantly: play your voice backwards or forwards
• Change the speed and pitch for even funnier reverse voices
• Loop playback to learn the backwards sound by heart
• Keep your recordings, rename them and play them again anytime
• Share the original or reversed audio with friends
GREAT FOR
• Reverse singing challenges and party games
• Talking backwards with friends
• Funny voice clips for your group chats

Reverse Audio flips your voice backwards in one tap. Sing or say a song, a word or a whole sentence into the mic and play it in reverse. Then try to copy the backwards sound, reverse your new recording and hear how close you got. It's the viral reverse singing challenge, and it's even funnier with friends.

HOW TO PLAY THE REVERSE SINGING CHALLENGE
1. Record yourself singing a line of a song or saying something.
2. Tap Play Reverse to hear it backwards.
3. Record yourself singing what you heard.
4. Reverse your new recording and hear how close you got to the original.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
• Reverse audio instantly: play your voice backwards or forwards
• Change the speed and pitch for even funnier reverse voices
• Loop playback to learn the backwards sound by heart
• Keep your recordings, rename them and play them again anytime
• Share the original or reversed audio with friends

GREAT FOR
• Reverse singing challenges and party games
• Talking backwards with friends
• Funny voice clips for your group chats

Free to use with ads. Go Premium to remove ads.

Privacy Policy: https://sites.google.com/view/audio-reverser-privacy-policy
Terms of Use: https://sites.google.com/view/audio-reverser-terms

Calmee – Your Daily Dose of Motivation, Positivity & Focus
Start every day feeling inspired, confident, and ready to take on the world with Calmee, your personal source of daily motivation. Whether you’re chasing a big goal, overcoming challenges, or simply wanting a positive boost, Calmee delivers powerful, uplifting messages that help you stay focused and energized.
With Calmee, you get more than just quotes — you get handpicked motivation tailored to your mood, mindset, and aspirations. Each message is crafted to empower you, spark action, and remind you of your potential. Whether it’s early in the morning, during a work break, or before bedtime, Calmee is here to keep your mind clear and your heart strong.
Features of Calmee:
Daily Motivational Quotes – Wake up to inspiring thoughts and ideas from world leaders, thinkers, and visionaries.
Personalized Inspiration – Calmee adapts to your preferences, delivering messages that match your goals.
Beautiful Backgrounds – Pair your quotes with stunning, calming images for a visual boost.
Positive Affirmations – Build confidence and self-belief with daily affirmations from Calmee.
Goal-Oriented Motivation – Whether you’re working on fitness, career growth, or personal happiness, Calmee supports you every step of the way.
Share the Positivity – Send your favorite Calmee quotes to friends, family, or social media to spread encouragement.
Offline Access – Save and view your favorite motivational content from Calmee anytime, anywhere.
Gentle Reminders – Let Calmee send you timely nudges so you never miss your daily boost.
No matter what challenges you face, Calmee reminds you that you have the strength, determination, and spirit to rise above them. Your mindset shapes your reality, and with Calmee, you’ll keep it positive, focused, and full of hope.
Why Choose Calmee?
Curated quotes from a variety of themes: success, love, confidence, happiness, mindfulness, and more.
Designed for busy lifestyles — quick to read, powerful to remember.
Inspires both individuals and teams for better performance and morale.
Developed with a passion for positivity and mental wellness.
Whether you want to kickstart your morning, recharge your afternoon, or end your day on a high note, Calmee is your trusted daily companion for staying motivated and inspired.
Let Calmee help you create a habit of positivity — because one small dose of encouragement can spark a lifetime of success.

Langlandia is the first language learning app built like an actual video g
bluejetty:00015368:ios.description:
Learn Spanish, French, German, Japanese, Korean, Chinese (Mandarin), Arabic, Italian, Portuguese, Russian, Indonesian, or Thai, all inside a real online video game.
Langlandia is the first language learning app built like an actual video game with online play. Instead of wasting time on an addictive game, learn a language with one. For all ages, from complete beginners to advanced learners.
TRAP YOUR FIRST BEAST
To survive Langlandia and advance in the institution, you need a strong beast at your side. Will it be a ferocious polar bear? A noble lion? A tiger, wolf, or giant snake? Or will you get lucky and trap a mythical beast, like a yeti or even a dragon?
You'll raise your baby beast and grow together: it becomes more powerful while you become fluent. You're a team, and you'll need each other to find your way home from this mysterious island.
TALK TO YOUR BEAST (NEW)
Have real conversations with your beast in the language you're learning. Practice speaking without fear of embarrassment. Your beast always listens, answers, and helps you improve.
SPEAK FROM DAY ONE
Langlandia doesn't just play audio. It listens to YOU. Speak into the mic, get instant feedback on your pronunciation, and take speaking exams as you progress. If your goal is to actually talk, not just tap answers, this is the game for you.

bluejetty:00168507:ios.summary:
We’ve developed a relaxing, simple, and innovative gameplay experience that allows you to dive deep into managing your aviation empire.
● Build and Expand Your Airport:
There’s a wide variety of shops, services, restrooms, seating, and dec
bluejetty:00168507:ios.description:
We’ve developed a relaxing, simple, and innovative gameplay experience that allows you to dive deep into managing your aviation empire.
● Build and Expand Your Airport:
There’s a wide variety of shops, services, restrooms, seating, and decorative items to meet your passengers' diverse needs. They can enjoy a coffee at a café or savor a seafood dinner at a gourmet restaurant, all within your airport.
● Planes and Aircraft:
Over 20 different aircraft are available, each designed for various objectives. Each plane has unique characteristics such as speed, passenger capacity, cargo hold, comfort, and fuel efficiency. Strategically plan your routes to maximize financial returns, taking into account passenger types, cargo, distance, and weather conditions. Manage everything from takeoffs and landings to flight times, and avoid maintenance issues that could lead to accidents.
● Crew and Staff:
Hire employees for various roles within your company, each with different levels of rarity and expertise. Pilots, co-pilots, flight attendants, engineers, logistics managers, shop vendors, and many more.
● Products and Stock Market:
There are over 50 different types of products available in cities around the world. Check the price of pizza in Rome and sell it in New York, or buy pearls in Dubai and transport them to Sydney for a great financial return. You’ll need to keep an eye on the price fluctuations of each product to maximize your profits, becoming a true tycoon!
● Global Destinations:
With vibrant 2D graphics, travel to iconic cities around the world! Explore Tokyo, Los Angeles, Rio de Janeiro, Paris, Dubai, and many others. We’ll be expanding the number of destinations with every update, so feel free to suggest your city for the next one!
● Construction Projects in Every City:
Additionally, transporting materials will be key to completing large-scale construction projects in each city, earning you respect and financial returns once the work is done. Help build new skyscrapers, magnificent statues, football stadiums, historical monuments, museums, and more!
● VIP Passengers and Relics:
Complete your collection of famous passengers! They’re rare but willing to pay premium prices for their travels. You can pamper them with VIP lounges and high-quality shops. Plus, be on the lookout in every city you visit for invaluable items like relics and treasures.
With intuitive and engaging gameplay, this is the perfect challenge for aviation enthusiasts and aspiring tycoons. Are you ready to take flight toward success and establish your legacy in the aviation industry? Your journey to becoming an aviation tycoon begins now!

bluejetty:00044967:ios.summary:
ABOUT THE APP

WHAT YOU'LL GET (everything totally free):
- An oasis of calm, self-car
bluejetty:00044967:ios.description:
ABOUT THE APP
We created this app because we needed it, we think you might need it too. In a world obsessed with doing, we are discovering the ancient art of being. 
WHAT YOU'LL GET (everything totally free):
- An oasis of calm, self-care and the discovery of a better way to live
- A beginners guide to Biblical meditation and mindfulness
- Meditations that cover a wide range of topics such as joy, gratitude and freedom from stress.
- Customisable sessions; choose the music, voice, meditation and timings that best suit you.
- Regular updates with new content.
Life for too many is a struggle. So often we adopt a lifestyle that is frantic and busy and we then long for the next day off, the next vacation or to get beyond the next deadline. We so easily find ourselves living simply FOR rest. Yet for those who know God, life can and should be lived FROM rest!
This app is designed to help you find and maintain a place of peace. It is from this place that we actually become so much more productive. When we learn to “let go and let God” life actually becomes so much more joyful and fruitful.
Our prayer is that this app will help you find the rhythm of rest that God always intended you to have. As you rest, as you simply abide in Him, may you know the beauty of His peace.
“Drop Thy still dews of quietness,
Till all our strivings cease;
Take from our souls the strain and stress,
And let our ordered lives confess
The beauty of Thy peace.”
John Greenleaf Whittier (1807-1892)
For terms of use visit: https://www.livefromrest.com/termsofuse

さらに新コンテンツ「すっきり占い」が登場！
月星座の考え方をヒントに、あなたの「おなかのクセ」をチェック。毎朝の占いメッセージをきっかけに、今日のおなかの調子を自然に意識できる新しい観便習慣をサポートします。
「観便検定」では、自分のうんちチェック（観便）をより楽しく意味のあるものに！
毎日のうんち記録や腸活アドバイスを活用して、便秘や下痢などの不調、ダイエットや美容など、腸内環境を整えることでうんとすっきり快調な毎日を目指しましょう。
【こんな方におすすめ！】
・便秘、下痢などお通じの悩みがある
・健康や美容、ダイエットに興味がある
・腸活を手軽に続けたい
・医師監修の信頼できるアドバイスが欲しい
便秘解消から美容・ダイエットまで、観便で健康管理しましょう！
【ウンログの特徴】
・かんたん10秒でうんち記録
・健康状態をスコア化
・医師監修の腸活アドバイス
・腸活商品の無料サンプリング
・うんち記録でポイントGET
【主な機能】
■うんち記録（腸内環境スコア化）
10秒でうんちを記録！腸内環境の状態をスコアで確認できます。カレンダー管理でお通じの有無も一目瞭然。
■すっきり占い（NEW）
月星座の考え方をヒントに、あなたの「おなかのクセ」を診断。毎朝配信される占いメッセージをきっかけに、今日のおなかの状態を自然に意識できる新しい観便習慣をサポートします。
■腸活記録（食事・サプリメントなど）
食事やサプリメントなど、日々の腸活を記録できます。企業の腸活商品とコラボした「腸活チャレンジ」キャンペーンも不定期開催！
■健康管理（体重、生理、肌など）
体重・生理・肌など、健康情報もまとめて管理。美容やダイエットをサポートします。
■医師監修のアドバイス
毎日の記録に基づき、医師監修の専門的でわかりやすいアドバイスをお届け。お通じ改善や美腸習慣の定着をサポートします。
■観便検定
毎日の観便が楽しくなる「観便検定」。自分の便の特徴を知って腸活効果を実感できます。
■うんちSNS（ウントーーク）
お通じや腸活の悩みを共有できるSNS機能。リアルでは話しづらい便秘や下痢の悩みも気軽に相談できます。
■ウンチップ（ポイント）
記録やチャレンジでポイント「ウンチップ」をGET。Amazonギフト券に交換できます。
■パスコードロック
健康や排泄などセンシティブな記録も安全に保護します。
【メディアで紹介多数！】
腸活や美容、ダイエット、健康のサポートアプリとしてさまざまなメディアに紹介されました！
anan／Oggi／美ST／美的／日経ヘルス／NHK「あさイチ」/など
【お問い合わせ】
レビュー投稿のお客様からの貴重なご意見・ご感想は、スタッフ一同楽しみに拝見しております。
不具合や使い方が分からないなど、お困りのことがありましたら、レビューへの投稿ではなく、
アプリ内の【不具合報告】より、メールにてお問い合わせください。
（多くのレビューをありがとうございます！とっても励みになってます！！）
＜ウンログ利用規約＞
https://unlog.me/terms
＜ウンログバシーポリシー＞
https://unlog.me/privacy
※ウンチップはログインしていないと使えません。
※記録を残したい方は、必ずログインしてお使いください。

bluejetty:00185940:ios.description:
Who said becoming a witch was easy? Abracadabra! Hocus Pocus! Let's go for the magic broom!
Help Ursula, the beginner witch to pick up her witchery stuff before the supreme sorcerer notice the mess.
It seems that Aura the cat messed up all the potions and ingredients!
If Ursula does not find out what happened, she will not be able to win her magic broom.
This is not another match 3 game. It has a lot of levels, with different game mechanics. Very... bewitched game modes!
* The daylight levels run under the match3 classic rules. Match 3 or more stuff to collect it. Matching more than three will you a witchery booster.
At night levels, you need to connect the witchcraft stuff to collect it, Connect more than seven stuff to collect all same color items at once.
Finally, the graveyard has it's own rules, you need to touch a witchcraft piece to pick up this one and its same color adjacents. Collecting more than three will give you amazing powerups.
Each game mode, has its own boosters and powerups:
* Vertical and horizontal cleaners
* Skull Bombs
* Explosive Crystall balls
* Toad, will paint stuff
* Full moon, use as wildcard
Also, these game modes have each one their own troubles:
* Crystal slots you need to break
* Frozen witchcraft stuff you need to defrost before collecting them.
* Spellbooks you have to vanish
* White spiders to collect
Same way, you have some boosters to make it easier:
* Magic Broom to sweep same color witchcraft stuff
* Claws to pick up a single bewitched piece
* Tornado to shuffle it all
Win gems to get free lives, boosters and other additional witchery.
FEATURES;
* Very fun, very easy but hard to master
* Bewitched graphics and sounds.
* Witchcraft elements for a scary experience.
* Hundreds of puzzle levels each one is very unique
* Free, so download now
* Multiple difficulty levels
* Play with your friends & Family.
* Facebook connect, so you can share your goals and scores.
* Ranks for all levels, so you can check your friends scores and defeat them.
* Fun for all ages
What are you waiting for?
Play this amazing match3 and give Ursula the chance to win her magic broom and become the best witch ever.
Fun to play, you will love this bewitched adventure, collecting witchery. Each level is an amazing puzzle to solve.
