bluejetty:00185918:ios.name: Baby Adopter Sea
bluejetty:00185918:ios.summary:
Welcome to Baby Adopter Sea – a game for those who enjoy babysitting and caring for children.
Adopt a virtual baby and take care of them throughout the day. Feed them, dress them, and make sure they stay happy and healthy. As you care for
bluejetty:00185918:ios.description:
Welcome to Baby Adopter Sea – a game for those who enjoy babysitting and caring for children.
Adopt a virtual baby and take care of them throughout the day. Feed them, dress them, and make sure they stay happy and healthy. As you care for your baby, you earn points that you can use in different areas of the game.
Earn Points by Taking Care of Your Baby
You get points for actions like feeding your baby, changing their clothes, hunting for eggs, and playing mini-games. These points can be used to buy clothes, shoes, toys, and other items for game locations like the Baby Room, Playroom, Bathroom, Beach and more. Filling up each location with items is one of the fun goals of the game.
Egg Hunt and Mini-Creatures
While playing, you can search for hidden eggs in different locations. Each egg takes three cracks to hatch, and you’ll need to wait a little between each crack. Inside each egg is a small mini-creature to collect.
Mini-Games
Free Cell – a classic-style solitaire card game with cards numbered from 0 to 12.
VoiceOver Accessibility
The main game and mini-games fully support VoiceOver.
In Free Cell, tap a card to select it and double-tap to begin moving. Then tap where you want to place it—another stack, one of the four free cells, or one of the completed stacks—and double-tap to confirm the move.
Baby Viewer lets you see the baby in full 3D and play animations: walk, run, dance, workout, idle, and look around.
Karma Points
Karma points build up over time, reflecting your progress and experience in taking care of your baby. Unlike regular points, which you spend on items, Karma points show how much time and effort you’ve put into the game.
Game Center
Earn Game Center achievements by fully completing locations. Compete on leaderboards: one for the main game and others for specific mini-games.
In-App Purchases
Tap the yellow coin icon in game locations to buy points. In Baby Viewer, you can also purchase additional 3D animations.
Note: The game works on iPhone, iPad, Mac, and Apple Watch.
Baby Adopter is a registered trademark of x2line.

Filling up each location with items is one of the fun goals of the game.

Egg Hunt and Mini-Creatures

While playing, you can search for hidden eggs in different locations. Each egg takes three cracks to hatch, and you’ll need to wait a little between each crack. Inside each egg is a small mini-creature to collect.

Mini-Games
Free Cell – a classic-style solitaire card game with cards numbered from 0 to 12.

VoiceOver Accessibility
The main game and mini-games fully support VoiceOver.

In Free Cell, tap a card to select it and double-tap to begin moving. Then tap where you want to place it—another stack, one of the four free cells, or one of the completed stacks—and double-tap to confirm the move.

Baby Viewer lets you see the baby in full 3D and play animations: walk, run, dance, workout, idle, and look around.

Karma Points
Karma points build up over time, reflecting your progress and experience in taking care of your baby. Unlike regular points, which you spend on items, Karma points show how much time and effort you’ve put into the game.

Game Center
Earn Game Center achievements by fully completing locations. Compete on leaderboards: one for the main game and others for specific mini-games.

In-App Purchases
Tap the yellow coin icon in game locations to buy points. In Baby Viewer, you can also purchase additional 3D animations.

Note: The game works on iPhone, iPad, Mac, and Apple Watch.

bluejetty:00027195:ios.description:
Transform Your Body with the 30-Day At-Home Weight Loss Plan for Women
Are you ready to achieve your weight loss goals but unsure where to start? Do you want a convenient, effective solution without the hassle of a gym? Introducing the Lose Weight in 30 Days at Home—a specially program designed to help you shed pounds and build a healthier lifestyle in the comfort of your home.
Why This App is Ideal for Your Weight Loss Journey:
Whether you're a beginner looking to embark on your fitness path, seeking to return to a routine, or aiming to challenge yourself further, our app offers the perfect guidance. With 30 days of exhilarating workouts tailored specifically for women, you can easily integrate effective fitness into your daily routine—no gym required!
Features Designed for Your Success:
1) Structured 30-Day Workout Program: Enjoy a meticulously crafted workout plan that guides you day by day, helping you stay motivated and focused. Each session is designed to maximize weight loss and improve your overall fitness levels.
2) Flexible Scheduling: Fit workouts seamlessly into your busy lifestyle with short, effective sessions designed to accommodate even the most hectic schedules. Whether you have 7 minutes or 20, you can make these workouts work for you.
3) At-Home Workouts: Engage in a variety of bodyweight exercises, cardio, and high-intensity interval training (HIIT) routines, all expertly designed to help you achieve your weight loss goals without any equipment.
4) Step-by-Step Instructions: Each workout features clear audio instructions and high-definition video demonstrations, ensuring you have the guidance you need to perform each exercise accurately.
5) Progress Tracking: Monitor your weight loss and fitness achievements with built-in tracking features. Set milestones and celebrate your successes, keeping your motivation levels high as you progress.
How It Works:
· Set Your Weight Loss Goals: Define your target weight and desired timeline. This allows us to tailor the plan to align with your personal fitness goal.
· Target Your Focus Area: Whether you want to tone your belly, butt&leg, arms, back, or a full-body sliming, we have just what you need.
· Personalize Your Experience: Input your age, height, weight, and fitness level. This information will help us craft a customized workout experience just for you.
· Follow the 30-Day Plan: Receive your tailored daily workout schedule designed to promote weight loss and improve fitness. Each day builds upon the last, gradually increasing intensity and engagement to ensure steady progress.
· Track Progress and Stay Motivated: Track your weight and workout streak with easy and embrace each day with confidence.
Ready to Embark on Your Transformation?
Every incredible journey begins with a single step. Trust yourself, and let today be the day you take charge of your fitness journey. Download the app now and start your empowering 30-day journey toward a healthier, happier you!

bluejetty:00180003:ios.description:
Learning Italian has never been so easy.
It is perfect for you whether you have a beginner, basic, intermediate or advanced level of Italian. With our online Italian course you will notice your Italian improving very quickly. Millions of students have already tried our courses. Would you like to join them?
Our online Italian courses:
Italian Course
In this course you will learn Italian from the ground up. Whatever your starting level, the course is designed to help you learn Italian from day one.
Italian Pronunciation Course
In this course you will learn to recognize Italian sounds. This course has 23 lessons and many exercises to practice and improve your pronunciation.
Italian Verb Conjugation Course
In this course you will practice the conjugation of Italian verbs in all their tenses. This is extra practice recommended for people who are already doing the Italian Course. It includes regular and irregular verbs.
Our learning method:
An easy, guided learning process designed for you: you will feel that you are learning more Italian every day. Every sentence, exercise, review and reading has been carefully selected for you.
Audio clips in Italian: A wide variety of accents with clear, crisp pronunciation, recorded by professional narrators.
Linked concepts: Each word is linked to its use or precise meaning. Tap a word in any sentence, exercise or reading to see its meaning or an explanation of its use.
Lesson structure: Concepts are introduced progressively throughout the course. Only concepts that have already been explained are used to create the content (sentences, exercises and readings).
Vocabulary: Learn the meaning, pronunciation and use of words with activities adapted to your progress.
Grammar exercises: Practice your grammar with exercises linked to explanations.
Vocabulary topics: Words are grouped into topic categories.
Spaced reviews: Review vocabulary and grammar at increasingly long intervals.
Search: Find whatever you are looking for, including vocabulary and grammar.
Readings: Learn and practice with conversations, news, emails and interviews, among others.
Diplomas: Earn a diploma that proves your knowledge at the end of each level.
Account types:
- Basic: With a Basic account the course is free, with some limitations.
- Premium: With a Premium account you have access to all course content and activities.
At Wlingua we work hard every day to offer you a quality Italian app that helps you at work, with your next exam, on holiday or when talking to people from around the world.
Download our app to learn Italian!
Terms of service: https://www.wlingua.com/en/terms
Privacy policy: https://www.wlingua.com/en/privacy

bluejetty:00081043:ios.summary:
— Voice Recorder: Your Handy Audio Companion! —
Ever found yourself needing to capture important voice notes, lectures, or those fleeting brilliant ideas that come at the most unexpected times? Meet Voice Recorder – the app designed to make
bluejetty:00081043:ios.description:
— Voice Recorder: Your Handy Audio Companion! —
Ever found yourself needing to capture important voice notes, lectures, or those fleeting brilliant ideas that come at the most unexpected times? Meet Voice Recorder – the app designed to make audio recording and transcribing as easy and versatile as possible. Whether you’re a student, journalist, podcaster, or someone who just loves keeping track of thoughts, this voice recording app is packed with features to cater to your every need.
— Voice Recording, Audio Storage, and Playback —
With Voice Recorder app, you can effortlessly record audio anytime, anywhere. Capture voice notes, lectures, interviews, meetings, or even those random thoughts that pop into your head. All your recordings are securely stored on your device, ready for playback whenever you need them. 
— Transcribe Voice To Text (Auto-Transcription) —
Say goodbye to tedious manual transcription! Our advanced AI technology helps you transcribe voice to text format, either in real-time or after you’ve finished recording. This voice recording and transcription app lends itself nicely to creating written records of your audio content, making it super easy to review, search, share your notes and transcribe voice memos.
— Unlimited Voice Note Transcription —
Voice Recorder offers unlimited transcription with no time limits, supporting transcription in a whopping 56 languages. Whether you need to transcribe audio to text, a short voice memo or a lengthy interview, this audio recorder and transcriber has you covered.
— Extract Audio from Video —
With a single click, you can record audio or extract audio from any video file in your device’s gallery and transcribe it into text. This feature expands the app’s versatility, making it an all-in-one voice recording and transcription app.
— Audio Recorder and Editor —
Sometimes, you need to tweak your recordings. Voice Recorder app lets you cut, crop, delete parts, or even record over specific sections. This audio recorder app provides the flexibility to modify and refine your audio files to perfection.
— Add Flags to Audio Notes —
Add flags or bookmarks to crucial sections, making it easier to locate and revisit key points in your audio notes. This audio recorder with transcription features is meant for students, professionals, and anyone who's aiming to organize their voice memo transcription.
— Voice Recording App With Noise Reduction —
Our noise reduction feature significantly enhances audio quality by reducing background noise, ensuring your recordings are crystal clear and easy to understand.
— Audio Format Conversion —
Convert your recordings to various audio formats like WAV, MP4, M4A, AIFC, and more or transcribe voice recording to text. This audio recorder app ensures your audio files are compatible with different devices and applications, making this voice memo app incredibly versatile.
— File Sharing —
Share your files with anyone you need to via our audio recorder and transcriber. This feature shines for teamwork and sharing important information quickly and easily.
— Subscription Options —
We offer flexible subscription options with auto-renewal for either 1 month or 1 year. Manage your subscriptions conveniently through your account settings, with the option to turn off auto-renewal if you choose. Our audio recorder and transcriber services are designed to fit your needs.
Voice Recorder isn’t just a transcribe app; it’s a comprehensive tool designed to make your life easier. From recording and transcribing audio to editing, sharing, and managing your content, this audio recorder app is an all-in-one solution. Whether you need to transcribe audio to text for work, study, or personal use.

bluejetty:00089692:ios.description:
Act on high blood pressure. Heartery helps you lower BP with daily actions, not just logging. Built after 200+ interviews with people living with hypertension.
What you can do
 • Quick Heart Wellness Check
 All key heart indicators in one view.
• Medication side effects lookup
 Search registered side effects from trusted sources.
• Salt Monitor (scan)
 Point your camera at a label or menu. Heartery estimates salt, saturated fat and cholesterol using official nutrition databases. Stay within daily limits with the food diary.
• Exercise plan to lower BP
 Generated from your Apple Health activity and calories burned. Co‑developed with a Danish physiotherapist for hypertension.
• Pill support
 Use the adherence assessment to find your personal barriers. Set smart reminders and quickly mark taken or missed. Integrated with iPhone Calendar.
• Safe Food Alert
 “Is this BP‑safe?” Get a clear answer and a short explanation. Aligned with guidance from the US Department of Agriculture and the European Food Safety Authority.
• Trends & insights
 History tab shows average BP, min/max, and quick 3‑ and 7‑day views. Charts for 1, 3 and 6 months reveal your trends.
• Heartwise Recipe Finder
 Personalized recipe suggestions based on US and EU nutrition guidance.
• Guideline advice for every reading
 Tap any reading for instant guidance from the American Heart Association, the European Society of Cardiology and the World Health Organization.
• Symptom journal
 Log preset symptoms fast and share with your clinician.
Works with your devices
 Enter readings manually, import from Apple Health, or sync via Bluetooth from Omron blood pressure monitors where legally marketed. Check approval status in your country before use.
Subscription information
 Monthly, annual and lifetime plans unlock all features. Manage subscriptions and turn off auto‑renewal in account settings.
Medical disclaimer
 Consult a doctor or qualified healthcare professional before making medical decisions or if you have concerns. Heartery is an additional tool for managing blood pressure, not a replacement for medical advice, diagnosis or treatment. It does not replace the patient–provider relationship.
Jurisdiction statement
 Heartery lets you log blood pressure and heart rate readings. Data can be entered manually, imported from Apple Health or synced via Bluetooth from Omron blood pressure monitors. Omron devices are approved and cleared where legally marketed. Check approval status in your country before use.
Terms of use

bluejetty:00080367:ios.summary:

If you have received an access key, download the Outline app to get start
bluejetty:00080367:ios.description:
Outline is an easy way for you to set up your own virtual private network (VPN) server to more safely access the open internet and keep your communications private. 
If you have received an access key, download the Outline app to get started. 
If you haven’t received an access key, you’ll first need to set-up your own server. Get started by downloading the Outline Manager from getoutline.org. Creating your own server is quick and easy, and instructions in the Manager will guide you through each step. 
How Do I Set Up Outline? 
- Outline consists of two related products: the Outline Manager and Outline. 
- The Outline Manager lets you create and operate your own VPN, and share access with anyone you choose by sending them an invitation directly from the Manager. Once you’ve downloaded the Manager, you can easily set up a VPN server on a cloud provider in less than five minutes. 
- After setup is complete, you can download the Outline app on your phone and desktop. 
- Share internet access with coworkers or friends by inviting them directly from the Manager. 
- If you’ve received an access code from someone using an Outline Manager you’re all set! Just download the app and get started. 
Why use Outline?
- Fast, reliable access to the open internet, powered by the Shadowsocks protocol
- Allows you to create and maintain your own VPN server and provide access with those you trust
- Strong encryption keeps your communications private
- Completely open source and audited by a nonprofit security firm

bluejetty:00082040:ios.name: Prêt à Template
bluejetty:00082040:ios.summary: Bring your fashion design ideas to life, from the first sketch to the finished collection. Prêt-à-Template is a professional fashion design app created for fashion sketching, fashion illustration, outfit design, and product development. Bui
bluejetty:00082040:ios.description:
Bring your fashion design ideas to life, from the first sketch to the finished collection. Prêt-à-Template is a professional fashion design app created for fashion sketching, fashion illustration, outfit design, and product development. Built for students, creatives, stylists, and professional designers, it transforms inspiration into polished fashion concepts with tools designed specifically for the real fashion workflow.
Whether you are learning fashion drawing, building a fashion portfolio, developing a collection, or exploring new styling ideas, Prêt-à-Template offers a complete workspace for modern fashion design. Unlike generic drawing apps, it is built specifically for the needs of the fashion industry, combining fashion sketch tools, realistic templates, visual research, and presentation workflows in one place. It supports both creative exploration and technical development, helping designers move from early concepts to more resolved and presentation-ready ideas with greater speed and confidence.
The app lets you begin creating in two distinct ways, depending on your design style. You can work with linework templates that include front, side, and back guides, making them ideal for structured fashion sketches, technical development, and clean fashion illustration. Or you can start with realistic product templates, working directly over lifelike silhouettes with depth and volume, which is perfect for outfit design, product visualization, and concept development. Puzzle Look makes the creative process even faster and more intuitive. Simply describe the look you want, and it selects the most relevant templates from the library so you can begin designing right away. AI supports your process with fashion-aware suggestions while keeping the designer fully in control of every creative decision.
Prêt-à-Template also includes a flexible mood board workspace where inspiration, materials, styling ideas, and product references can come together naturally. Its integrated fashion library includes fabrics, textile structures, prints, patterns, textures, trims, findings, sleeves, collars, cuffs, pockets, openings, construction details, care labels, and textile symbols, creating a rich environment for research, experimentation, and product thinking. 
The canvas makes fashion sketching feel more expressive, natural, and realistic. You can sketch, shade, annotate, render, and refine using intuitive tools, realistic brush behavior, and a paper-like surface that gives the digital drawing experience a more tactile quality. Prêt-à-Template also uses AI with real fashion context. Its templates are built around garment proportions, silhouette logic, fabric behavior, drape, trims, and construction details, helping deliver results that feel realistic and aligned with professional fashion design workflows rather than generic image generation.
From fashion design and fashion sketching to fashion illustration, outfit design, mood board creation, collection development, styling exploration, textile research, and fashion portfolio building, Prêt-à-Template supports every stage of the fashion design process in one creative workspace, whether you are just starting out or already working at a professional level.
Subscription Pricing & Terms
Prêt-à-Template is free to download. Unlock full access with a yearly or monthly subscription. Auto-renews unless canceled 24 hours before the current period ends.
Manage your subscription in your Apple Account settings.

bluejetty:00017635:ios.description:
O App Banrisul é uma solução que integra simplicidade, segurança e novas tecnologias para você se tornar nosso cliente e gerenciar suas finanças. Confira porque nossa conexão transforma:
Nosso App é compatível com as versões de Sistema Operacional iOS 15 e superiores. Mantenha seu dispositivo atualizado para ter uma melhor experiência de acesso.
Serviços disponíveis para você: 
• Nova Conta Digital: Quer ser cliente Banrisul? Abra sua conta gratuita e escolha os produtos de crédito que mais combinam com você. 
• Fácil Acesso: Consulte sua conta de forma rápida apenas com sua senha de serviços (6 digitos) ou promova seu acesso para realizar transações financeiras nos caixas eletrônicos Banrisul ou Saque & Pague, nos canais de Internet Banking, ou ainda na sua agência com seu cartão físico.
• Transações Financeiras: Faça pagamentos, transferências, empréstimos, investimentos e câmbio, com mobilidade e total segurança, onde você estiver. 
• Office Mobile: Os serviços do Office Banking, que você ou sua empresa já utilizam no computador, agora no celular: consultas, movimentação, empréstimos e serviços.
• Consultas e Extratos: Acompanhe a movimentação da sua conta direto do seu celular. 
• Depósito em Cheque: Realize depósitos, capturando a imagem dos cheques pela câmera do seu celular.
• BanriCheque: Emita cheques sem o uso do cartão nas Dispensadoras de Cheques Banrisul. Clicou, emitiu!
• BanriSaque: Saque sem cartão nos caixas eletrônicos Banrisul ou Saque & Pague. Você também pode enviar o código de autorização para outras pessoas sacarem. Baixou, clicou, sacou!
• Cartões de Crédito Banrisul: Faça a gestão de seus cartões de crédito, com diversos serviços que vão facilitar seu dia-a-dia. Consulte limites, faturas e melhor dia de compra, registre o uso do cartão no exterior, peça uma nova via, desbloqueie o cartão novo que chegou, gere um Cartão de Crédito Virtual e faça transações online com muito mais segurança. Tudo isso e muito mais, disponível para todos os nossos clientes.
• Open Finance: Compartilhe dados de outros bancos com o Banrisul para criarmos soluções que melhor atendam suas necessidades.
• Consórcio: Simule, contrate consórcio e faça a gestão de suas cotas de consórcio ativas.
• Banrishopping: Faça compras utilizando seu cartão Banricompras, cartões de crédito Banrisul, seus pontos BanriClube ou cashback.
• Renegociação de Dívidas: Resolva as suas dívidas em atraso sem ter que ir até uma agência.
• Abertura de Conta Vinculada: Abra uma conta vinculada ao seu CPF. Seu filho ou dependente menor de idade pode ter uma conta nas modalidades de poupança, mesada eletrônica ou conta jovem.
• Fale com Sua Agência/Gerente: Converse com seu Gerente de Contas via telefone, celular, WhatsApp e e-mail.
• Espaço Afinidade: Saiba mais sobre opções de contatos e localização, incluindo atalho de geolocalização, da agência onde está o Espaço Afinidade de relacionamento, assim como os demais Espaços Afinidade.
• Soluções Afinidade: Conheça soluções e oportunidades aderentes e/ou exclusivas aos clientes gerenciados no Banrisul Afinidade, além de conversar diretamente com seu Gerente de Contas.
• Onde tem Banrisul: Ative seu GPS para visualizar nossas agências e pontos de atendimento próximos a você. Também permite consultas por cidades e bairros.
• Cotações: Acompanhe a cotação diária de moedas e índices. Dólar, Euro e outras moedas.
• Consulta de Cheques: Consulte a situação de cheques Banrisul.
• Telefones Úteis: Acesse nossos canais de atendimento telefônico.
• Autorização Gov.br: Autorize o seu acesso ao site gov.br com o App Banrisul, facilitando o acesso a diversos serviços do Governo Federal.
Obs.: Taxas poderão ser vinculadas na aquisição dos produtos e serão devidamente esclarecidas no ato da contratação.
Para saber mais sobre o Banrisul, visite o site ou entre em contato pelo e-mail banrisul_apps@banrisul.com.br.

bluejetty:00130020:ios.description:
An AI chat application that can be easily!
A wide range of needs can be met, from work and study to advice on worries and chatting in your spare time.
No registration is required, and it's easy to start for free!
AI Assistant kun is an AI chat app available both in Japanese and in English.
It’s easy to use on your smartphone and supports a wide range of needs—from homework questions to advice on life and relationships—tailored to your purpose.
Recommended for
People who want to work efficiently
You can create drafts of emails, look for typos and correct them. When you are stuck at work, it can help you come up with ideas for projects and catchphrases, and support wall-hammers and organizing your thoughts to clear your mind of clutter. We also recommend it for summarizing documents and organizing the formatting of meeting minutes.
If you need support with learning
We also specialize in homework support. You can use it to practice English conversation and explain what you don't understand. We are also good at drafting and composing sentences.
Those who want help with household chores and daily life.
We can help you with lifestyle issues. I can help you plan today's menu and create nutritionally balanced recipes. We are also good at giving wisdom on how to clean the house and on everyday situations that require help. When in doubt, we can even tell your fortune with tarot. We also recommend creating travel plans.
For creators
It is also a great tool for inspiration. From plotting a novel, to setting up a dream novel, to coming up with ideas for dialogue, to writing lyrics that resonate with you, to assisting in songwriting, we can help you.
For those who want to add color to their daily lives.
And for the little moments in your daily life. From chatting in your spare time to discussing your life and love life problems. You can also create a diary by sharing what happened today.
Features of AI Assistant kun
The most advanced natural language processing technology, so we can understand your words and feelings and communicate with you.
AI Assistant kun is always calm and collected. It is not affected by your emotions, and will kindly accept anything you say or do, no matter how many times you say or do it.
24/7 support. 24/7 support, available to answer your questions no matter what time of day it is.
How to use
No membership registration is required. You can download the application and start chatting immediately. Please note that you can start for free, but there is a daily usage limit for users.
You can get in touch with cutting-edge AI through a familiar chat UI.
Tips on how to use the service
When you finish an answer in the middle of a question, you can ask "Tell me the rest of the answer" and it will give you a longer answer.
It is good at generating ideas. It is good at coming up with ideas, so use it when you are in trouble.
Excels at creating the core structure of writing. You can rely on it when you’re unsure about how to organize your content.
When you want a lot of ideas, be specific about the number of ideas, such as 10.
Be very careful because you may get the facts wrong!
First of all, it's free. Try it now!

bluejetty:00041088:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00041088:ios.description:
We are on a mission to ease the lives of people dealing with chronic conditions.
Whether you are recently diagnosed or you’ve been living with a chronic condition for some time, Creda Health is your one-stop destination for staying on top of your health.
Living with chronic conditions can be tough. Monitoring medications, symptoms, vitals, lab tests, doctor visits, food, lifestyle, etc. can be overwhelming. Creda Health does all of that for you and helps you identify triggers and take steps to prevent complications and worsening of diseases. It finds better ways of staying on top of these health elements.
Our condition-specific care models analyze your symptoms, medications, vitals, labs, nutrition, and lifestyle elements, and monitor your disease progression and treatment effectiveness, unlike anything else on the market. We send you reminders, alerts, warnings, articles, actions to take, and things to talk to your doctor about – all to help you stay on top of your health.
Available for free to users across the globe, our app offers a range of features to help you stay on top of your condition.
With our app, you can:
 1. Manage medications, symptoms, vitals, diet, exercise, check-ups, and more
 a. Receive reminders, alerts, and education.
 b. Customize by condition and needs
 2. Get personalized articles, videos, guidance
 a. Understand your condition
 b. Learn what to expect
 3. Review your ongoing health report
 a. See how you do every week
 b. Know what to ask your doctor
 4. Ask questions and get answers via chat
 5. Creda Health App connects with Apple Health and the Fitbit app for auto retrieval of vitals. Connecting to these apps requires user consent.

bluejetty:00080444:ios.description:
TURN BUDGETING INTO A GAME
Bread Budgeting transforms everyday money management into a playful challenge. Set your own spending limits—or start with our ready-made templates—and keep Brad the Bread happy by staying on budget. Go overboard and Brad toasts; stay on track and each new month unlocks a fresh, collectible bread character to show off.
BUDGET TOGETHER, STAY ACCOUNTABLE
Invite a partner, roommate, or your whole friend group. Bread lets everyone share progress in real time, compare monthly goals, and cheer (or gently roast) one another. Your rarest bread achievements are displayed on a social leaderboard, so bragging rights are baked right in.
LEARN WITH BREAD UNIVERSITY
Whether you’re brand new to personal finance or fine-tuning an advanced savings plan, Bread University offers concise, practical articles curated by certified educators. Level up your money skills while Brad rises in the oven.
CONNECT YOUR BANK—NO MANUAL TYPING
Securely link your U.S. bank accounts (more regions coming soon) and import transactions automatically. Our smart categorization engine sorts every purchase so you always know where your money goes.
SEE YOUR MONEY CLEARLY
Interactive charts break down spending patterns, highlight subscriptions you may have forgotten, and display upcoming recurring charges on a calendar so nothing blindsides you at month-end.
SHOULD I BUY IT? ASK THE MAGIC EIGHT BALL
About to splurge? Shake our built-in Magic Eight Ball for a light-hearted reality check before you tap “Add to Cart.”
Bread Budgeting requires iOS 16 or later.

bluejetty:00144689:ios.description:
How to Draw helps you learn how to draw!
Use your phone's camera as a projector to draw.
How to Draw is a meticulously designed drawing application aimed at pushing the boundaries of your creativity. 
This unique app allows you to elevate your drawing skills from beginner to advanced levels. It includes drawings that even master artists, drawing enthusiasts, tattoo artists, art school students, and those who have never drawn before can enjoy.
Learn to draw with AI
With the How to Draw app, you can use AI to do the following:
 - Sticker Maker: Turn your photos into eye-catching stickers.
 - Photo to Sketch: Transform your photos into sketches and use the projector feature to draw them on paper using your phone's camera.
 - Background Remover: Flawlessly remove the background from your photos and draw anything you want in the background!
 - Enhance Old Photos: Improve the quality of your photos for drawing!
 - AI-Powered Drawing Sketches: One of the standout features of Ar Drawing is its AI-powered drawing sketch generator. Simply describe what you want to see—for example, "a white-haired man playing soccer"—and the AI will provide a drawing sketch that matches your description. This feature allows users to bring their imagination to life effortlessly.
Enjoyable Drawing Experience:
Ar Drawing, with its user-friendly interface, is easy to use. From beginners to professional artists, everyone can work on various drawing sketches and unleash their creativity.
Lightbox and Projector Features:
Drawing becomes incredibly easy with custom lightbox and projector features. You can follow step-by-step drawings on ready-made sketches. The art school is now in your pocket, allowing everyone, even those who have never drawn before, to create art.
Coloring Book Category:
Ar Drawing offers users a Coloring Book Category where they can step into colorful worlds. You can color ready-made drawings, create your color palette, and add a unique touch to your art.
Record Your Work in Real-Time:
While drawing, you can record videos of your work to track your progress.
Save and Share:
Save your works and share them on social media platforms! Ar Drawing makes it easy and fun to share your art with friends and the world. Explore the world of art with Ar Drawing, unleash your creativity, and share your unique drawings with the world.
Download it now and embark on an art-filled journey!
PRIVACY POLICY:
Read our privacy policy here: https://draw.findbluapp.com/privacy-policy
TERMS OF USE:
Get more information about our terms and conditions here: https://draw.findbluapp.com/terms-of-use
PREMIUM SUBSCRIPTION:
How to Draw app offers an automatically renewable subscription. The subscription will renew automatically unless turned off at least 24 hours before the current period ends. Subscriptions can be managed by the user at any time, and auto-renewal can be turned off by going to Account Settings after the purchase. Accounts will be charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current period. If a subscription with a free trial is initiated, charges will be made unless canceled 24 hours before the end of the trial period.
CONTACT US:
Do you have any questions or feedback that would contribute to development? Reach out to us at: support@findbluapp.com

bluejetty:00153111:ios.description:
Struggle to hit your step goals? StepPals makes you care.
It's a step tracker — with stakes. Your digital companion survives only if you hit your daily steps. It's nostalgic, emotional, and weirdly motivating.
Why StepPals Works:
StepPals gives you a reason to walk — every single day. It’s not just about fitness data. It’s about accountability, habit-building, and keeping your tiny friend alive.
- **Track daily steps easily**
- **Set goals that challenge you**
- **Build healthy routines that stick**
- **Feel *emotionally attached* to the outcome**
 How It Works:
- Set your daily **step goal**
- Walk to keep your **StepPal** alive
- Miss a day? Their health drops
- Miss too many? They're gone
- Start again with a new Pal — and a new streak
StepPals turns basic movement into something you actually look forward to.
Whether you’re walking for weight loss, energy, or mental clarity — your Pal is counting on you.
 Real Motivation. Real Results.
This isn’t your average step counter. StepPals makes walking **fun**, **emotional**, and **satisfying**.
No login required. No ads. No complicated dashboards.
Just you, your steps, and a little buddy that needs you.
 Download StepPals if You:
- Want to walk more consistently
- Need real accountability to move
- Are motivated by goals *and guilt trips*
- Miss the fun of old-school digital pets
- Are tired of boring health apps

Payment will be charged to your Apple ID account at the confirmation of purchase. 
You can manage and cancel your subscriptions by going to your account settings on the App Store after purchase. 
Any unused portion of a free trial will be forfeited when a subscription is purchased.

bluejetty:00184702:ios.summary: Welcome to Survey Junkie, where incentives and influence meet to create a better tomorrow. Survey Junkie is an online community with over 11 million members dedicated to making your voice heard. When large companies are creating new product
bluejetty:00184702:ios.description:
Welcome to Survey Junkie, where incentives and influence meet to create a better tomorrow. Survey Junkie is an online community with over 11 million members dedicated to making your voice heard. When large companies are creating new products or updating current ones, they need people like you and me to share valuable insight. Because at the end of the day, your voice is essential to a brand’s decision-making process.
Take fun and interesting surveys. Then redeem your points and cash out your rewards. 
It’s simple and straightforward. Your voice helps make a difference, so you get paid to do it. 
1. Can anyone become a member of Survey Junkie?
Members must be 18 or older and reside in the United States.
2. How do I earn points?
You must successfully complete surveys, profile questionnaires or take other rewardable actions to earn points. You'll know when an action is rewardable if it has designated points displayed within a green button.
4. How do I redeem my points?
To redeem your points click “My Points” from the navigation bar's dropdown menu or click “Current Points” from the user dashboard. Once you're on the My Points page, follow these steps: 
If you have reached a minimum of 1,000 points, you are eligible to redeem your rewards with the following methods 
- cash using PayPal 
- popular e-Giftcards. e-Giftcards 
- direct bank transfer.
PayPal redemptions may require you to log into your PayPal account. After you select your redemption method, you will be asked to select or provide the email address where you'd like to receive the reward. If you're adding a new email address, you will be required to confirm that email before proceeding with the redemption. This ensures we don't send the reward to the wrong person. Verify that the reward type, amount, and email the reward will be sent to are correct, then click “Yes, Redeem”. If you have successfully redeemed your reward, you should see a “Congratulations” popup window. This indicates that your reward has been sent to your registered PayPal or e-Giftcard email.
5. What can I redeem the points for?
Points are redeemable for cash through PayPal or e-Giftcards. E-Giftcards are currently available to U.S. residents only.
With Survey Junkie, you can see your opinions reflected in the products and services of tomorrow!

bluejetty:00157768:ios.description:
In the dark and eerie halls of the mental hospital, a young woman named Sophie awakens with no memory of who she is or how she got there. Desperate to escape from the mental hospital, she navigates the maze of the asylum searching for a way out. "Escape the mental hospital," she whispers to herself as she takes her first step in opening 100 doors in this escape room game.
Embrace this 100 doors challenge, seek and find hidden objects and solve escape puzzles, in order to help her piece together fragments of her past. But with sinister forces determined to keep her trapped within the asylum’s walls, she must use her newfound knowledge in this adventure escape game and employ special abilities to escape 100 mental hospital doors before it's too late. "Escape the mental hospital," she repeats to herself, determined to break free.

- Explore different mental hospital rooms
- Solve psychological puzzles 
- Find hidden objects
- Challenge your IQ
- Cool game mechanics
- Pick up the pieces of the immersive story to find out who she is

But with danger lurking at every turn, she must keep her wits about her if she hopes to escape the mental asylum. With twists and turns at every corner, she finds herself in a race against time to uncover the truth in this asylum escape room game. 
Will she make it out before she becomes just another forgotten soul trapped within the asylum walls? Only time will tell in this thrilling 100 doors escape adventure game journey. Unlock the secrets. Escape the mental hospital.

bluejetty:00088207:ios.summary: Are you concerned about recent changes in your health? Do you have symptoms but don’t know what’s causing them? Our short interview, created by doctors and powered by AI, is a quick and simple way to check your symptoms at home and receive
bluejetty:00088207:ios.description:
Are you concerned about recent changes in your health? Do you have symptoms but don’t know what’s causing them? Our short interview, created by doctors and powered by AI, is a quick and simple way to check your symptoms at home and receive medically-verified guidance on what to do next. It’s fast, it’s free, and it’s anonymous.
Symptomate analyzes your symptoms from a bank of thousands and connects them to the most probable conditions, based on your presenting symptoms, risk factors, and medical history. Symptomate is appropriate for conducting a preliminary assessment of both child and adult symptoms.
HOW DOES IT WORK?
1. Choose the person to be interviewed (either you or someone else)
2. Add basic demographic data
3. Enter a few initial symptoms
4. Answer a series of symptom-related questions
5. Get a list of the most probable conditions and associated recommendations, including: the level of urgency, medical specialization, appointment type, and related educational content.
WHAT TO DO WITH RECOMMENDATIONS?
* read them to better understand your health
* use them to choose the right medical care
* print them out to prepare for an appointment
Important: Symptomate does not store any of your data. It is 100% anonymous. It is up to you whether you'd like to use its calculations or not.
EXTRAS
* simple language of medical content
* multiple symptoms analyzed at once
* explanations of medical terms and instructions
* interview mode for parents and caregivers
* educational content to learn more about medical conditions
* tips on home care for mild conditions
SYMPTOMATE AT A GLANCE:
* 5 levels of possible care
* 1800+ symptoms
* 900+ conditions
* 340+ risk factors
* 40+ engaged physicians developing Symptomate
* built and validated with 140,000+ hours of doctors’ work
* 94% recommendation accuracy
* 15 language versions: English, Spanish, Chinese, German, French, Portuguese, Portuguese Brazilian, Arabic, Dutch, Czech, Turkish, Russian, Ukrainian, Polish and Slovak
LEGAL NOTICE
Symptomate does not provide a diagnosis. It is for informational purposes only and is not a qualified medical opinion.
Do not use it in emergencies. In case of a health emergency, call your local emergency number immediately.
Your data is safe. The information you provide is anonymous and not shared with anyone.
Read more in our Terms and Conditions (https://symptomate.co

bluejetty:00123966:ios.name: Infinite Flight Simulator
bluejetty:00123966:ios.summary: Infinite Flight offers the most comprehensive flight simulation experience on mobile devices, whether you are a curious novice or a decorated pilot. Explore high definition scenery around the entire world with our diverse inventory of detai
bluejetty:00123966:ios.description:
Infinite Flight offers the most comprehensive flight simulation experience on mobile devices, whether you are a curious novice or a decorated pilot. Explore high definition scenery around the entire world with our diverse inventory of detailed aircraft, and fly with others in our busy multiplayer environment with human Air Traffic Control! 
Take Control of Your Dream Aircraft
A fleet of detailed aircraft awaits, ranging from single-engine propeller to military fighters and airliners. Configure your flight with comprehensive planning tools, including weight and balance, and take off in your favorite aircraft and livery combination. Advanced autopilot functions including VNAV, LNAV, and autoland will have you flying like a pro. 
Explore the World
Fly anywhere on the globe with high-definition satellite terrain imagery at 15m/px resolution. Navigate with a global database of NAVAIDs, SIDs, STARs, Approaches, and Oceanic tracks, ensuring an authentic flight planning experience. Compatible airports even support auto-pushback in coordination with ATC instructions, making your pre-flight setup seamless.Enjoy realistic airport environments with 3D terminals, animated ground service equipment, jet bridges, and functional stand guidance at a growing number of airports worldwide.
Fly with others in controlled airspace
Flight simulation is best with others! Join a vibrant multiplayer community where pilots navigate busy airspace with human Air Traffic Controllers. Whether you're flying or controlling, beginner and expert server options provide a structured and realistic ATC experience. Coordinate with other pilots, follow real-world procedures, and take your skills to the next level in a truly immersive airspace.
INCLUDED FEATURES
• Curated selection of aircraft and locations 
• Growing selection of 3D Airports 
• ILS plus NAV Data including SIDS, STARS, GPS approaches 
• Realistic Atmospherics with customizable time of day & weather conditions, and cirrus clouds 
• Autopilot with LNAV, VNAV, Autoland (select aircraft) 
• Flight Planning, taxiway networks, auto-pushback 
• Logbook and advanced replay system 
• Weight & Balance config 
• Aircraft cockpit, door, jet bridge, and ground service animations
• Engine startup & shutdown 
• Stand guidance at equipped airports
SUBSCRIBE TO INFINITE FLIGHT PRO to enjoy our entire fleet of aircraft with thousands of other pilots, anywhere in the world.
INFINITE FLIGHT PRO FEATURES
• Multiplayer 
• Global flight 
• Dozens of aircraft and over 1000 livery combinations 
• 15m/px satelite terrain imagery 
• Human ATC (act as pilot or controller) 
• Auto pushback with ATC integration 
• Live weather and winds aloft 
• SimBrief Integration 
• EFB Link (ForeFlight, Garmin Pilot, and more)
Note: 
Internet connection (WiFi or Cellular) is required to use Infinite Flight.
Privacy Policy:
infiniteflight.com/legal/privacy
Terms of Service:
infiniteflight.com/legal/terms

bluejetty:00152369:ios.description:
Clap Track — Make Finding Your Phone Fun and Easy!
Ever experienced the awkward moment when your phone is lost under the couch cushions or in the corner of your desk, and you can't find it for the life of you? Clap Track offers a simple and fun solution! Just clap, and your phone will play a sound to help you quickly locate it! No matter how far your phone is, just a clap and the sound will guide you right to it.
Main Features:
Clap to Find Your Phone: Simply clap your hands, and your phone will emit a sound, helping you quickly locate it and avoid the hassle of losing it.
Charging Mode: When your phone is plugged into the charger, it enters charging mode. If the charger is unplugged, your phone will emit a sound to remind you, ensuring you don’t forget to unplug it.
Anti-Theft Mode: If your phone is in your pocket, and it’s removed, it will play a sound reminder, helping prevent theft or simply forgetting your phone.
Touch Detection: If your phone is touched while lying still, it will play a sound reminder, avoiding accidental touches or unwanted interactions.
Clap Track helps you quickly find your phone while adding a little intelligence to your device. Small smart features can make life more convenient, so give it a try now!

bluejetty:00072414:ios.description:
Welcome to Human or Not, the ultimate trivia app that challenges your ability to differentiate between human-generated and AI-generated images! Get ready for an exciting journey through the realms of artificial intelligence and human creativity.
Human or Not combines the best of both worlds, allowing you to put your instincts to the test and determine whether an image was created by a human artist or an advanced AI image generator. It's a thrilling game of wits, where you'll be presented with two visually stunning images and asked to identify which one was crafted by a human hand.
Engage in captivating conversations with our intelligent chatbot assistant, available to guide you throughout the mid-journey of this unique experience. Simply ask questions, seek hints, and delve deeper into the artistry behind each image. Our chatbot is designed to provide stable diffusion of knowledge, offering valuable insights into the world of image generation and AI technology.
With Human or Not, you'll explore the frontiers of creativity, discovering how AI has revolutionized the art-making process. Challenge your friends, family, and fellow trivia enthusiasts in thrilling head-to-head quizzes. Showcase your knowledge of AI, art, and image generators as you race against the clock to achieve the highest scores and unlock new levels.
Immerse yourself in a visually stunning world of avatars and artistry, where the lines between human and machine creativity blur. Each image presents a fascinating puzzle, inviting you to unravel the techniques used in its creation. Sharpen your trivia skills and expand your understanding of AI's impact on various domains.
Key Features:
Engaging trivia quizzes that test your ability to distinguish between human-made and AI-generated images.
Interactive chatbot assistant to assist you throughout your mid-journey experience.
Challenging head-to-head battles with friends and other players.
Beautifully crafted avatars and visually stunning artwork.
Explore the fascinating world of AI image generation and its impact on art.
Unlock new levels and showcase your expertise in the realm of AI and trivia.
Download Human or Not now and embark on an extraordinary adventure where human artistry and AI-generated wonders collide. Step into the realm of trivia and test your skills as you decipher the creations of humans and machines alike. Are you ready to play the game of Human or Not?

1000+ engaging activities that emphasize learning, creativity, cooperation – and most of all, fun!
Developed by an award-winning education studio, 22learn, in cooperation with educational specialists.
Perfect for kids aged 1-5.
Welcome to Learnity Planet! A whole world of carefully curated learning activities for your babies, toddlers, and preschoolers to learn their ABCs, Numbers, Math Operations, Colors, Shapes, and more! Your children will learn with their favorite animals and vehicles like dinosaurs, robots, fire trucks, and more! Join over 70 million other kids that love to play and learn with 22learn's newest app package!
Included in the subscription, which starts with a FREE 7-day trial, are 5 apps providing a comprehensive suite of learning that you may share across different iOS devices and with different accounts (Family Sharing). We aim to make it as easy for you to try, share, and then cancel when no longer needed.
Let your child have fun playing (and learning) on their own as they explore Learnity Planet.
== Essential Early Reading Skills ==
Designed to foster early and emergent literacy skills.
• Letter recognition 
• Letter names
• Letter-sound relationships
• Phonemic awareness
• Letter tracing 
• Letter writing
• Letter matching (uppercase & lowercase)
• Identify beginning sounds
=== Essential Early Math Skills ===
• Numbers 1-10
• Numbers 10-20
• Numbers 1-100
• Addition
• Subtraction
• Shapes
• Counting, sorting, and comparing
=== More Essential Pre-Skills ===
• Recognize various animals
• Learn different colors
• Operate and learn more about community vehicles like firetrucks and school buses
• Practice problem-solving and critical thinking in different situations
• Improve fine-motor skills 
• Practice memory skills
=== Features ===
• Interactive world perfect for inquisitive little minds to explore
• Lovable companions to accompany your child on their learning adventure! Dinosaurs, Aliens, Abby the Monkey, and more!
• Child-friendly controls and interface with no complicated menus or unnecessary distractions
• Professional animations, voice-over, and sound effects
• No third-party ads or links to social media
• Only positive reinforcement is provided to engage children
We are parents of children ourselves and thoroughly test all our products on them and their social circles. Our little beta-testers that tried this app had continuous fun playing and learning on their own! So, sit back, relax, and have a nice moment to yourself while listening to your kid giggle away while learning essential preschool concepts.

bluejetty:00090746:ios.description:
Play the classic solitaire game (Klondike variant, one card) with custom designed decks of poker size playing cards. The game is free to download, free to play, free from ads, and with high quality graphics. 
You start with 3 available decks. Two of them have been designed exclusively for high clarity on mobile and tablet. The 3rd one is a taste of what a custom designed deck of cards look like.
You will navigate your collection and preview the cards of the other custom decks available as in-app purchase. All these decks are designed by Stockholm17 Playing Cards, Sweden. Any custom deck can be used to play the game. Make sure you read the in-game legibility properties of each deck before the purchase, some of them might be hard to read on devices with small screen.
App size: approximately 80Mb as first download, reaching up to 150Mb in various stages during the usage of the app.
Landscape mode only, you will be playing in a 3D environment and 4 simple tasks will guide you to quickly learn the interface and the game dynamics.
Game Center is necessary to access the leaderboard.
You need an internet connection to play the game.
In the future more custom decks will be added and improvements will be made.
Have fun and good luck!

bluejetty:00152278:ios.name: Glow Tales: Merge & Makeover
bluejetty:00152278:ios.summary:
Where every style tells a story, and every makeover begins with a spark of creativity.
In Glow Tales: Merge & Makeover, you’ll enter a vibrant world where beauty, fashion, and storytelling intertwine. Merge beauty items, design stunning loo
bluejetty:00152278:ios.description:
Where every style tells a story, and every makeover begins with a spark of creativity.
In Glow Tales: Merge & Makeover, you’ll enter a vibrant world where beauty, fashion, and storytelling intertwine. Merge beauty items, design stunning looks, and follow Michael and his team as they transform their salon—and the lives of everyone who walks through its doors.
Merge & Makeover
Dive into a relaxing merge gameplay where every match brings a touch of beauty!
Drag, drop, and merge beauty items — from makeup brushes and perfumes to stylish dresses and salon tools. Combine them to craft upgraded cosmetics and unlock new makeover materials.
As you merge, you’ll prepare for real transformations: glowing looks, bold hairstyles, chic fashion pieces, and salon-ready vibes! Watch as your beauty table turns into a glowing canvas of creativity.
Fashion, Style & Story
In Glow Tales, every makeover hides a story.
Help clients rediscover their confidence — from brides-to-be seeking their dream look, to celebrities preparing for red carpet moments, and everyday people chasing a fresh start.
Each chapter introduces a new challenge, a new style, and a new emotional twist.
Will Michael’s creative spark return?
Can Mina prove herself as more than a newcomer?
And who’s behind the mysterious “Glow Agency” that’s competing to steal your spotlight?
Relaxing & Satisfying Merge Fun
Enjoy soothing ASMR moments as you merge brushes, tap lipsticks, and polish nails.
Feel the satisfaction of transforming messy salon corners into glowing studios, one merge at a time.
Perfect for relaxing after a long day — calm visuals, soft animations, and satisfying sound design make every action rewarding.
Build Your Dream Salon
Work alongside Michael, the studio’s founder and visionary lead, a talented crew stands by his side:
Collette — the sharp-eyed stylist who turns concepts into runway-ready looks.
Mina — a cheerful makeup artist with a love for color and soft glam.
Leo — the charming photographer who captures every transformation in perfect light.
Luca — the creative hairdresser crafting signature cuts and head-turning styles.
Features You’ll Love
Merge Beauty Items – Match and combine tools, products, and accessories to create premium beauty kits.
Complete Makeovers – Transform characters from simple to stunning using the items you merge.
Fashion Design Challenges – Choose outfits, colors, and accessories to match every story.
Interactive Stories – Experience heartfelt journeys, dramatic rivalries, and touching character moments.
Relaxing Gameplay – Soft music, glow effects, and ASMR-inspired visuals to unwind anytime.

When the chill of a drawn bowstring meets the ninja’s elusive movements, Ninja Hunt delivers an adrenaline - surging shadow hunt with blend of stealth and shooting. As a casual first-person shooter that fuses ninja themes with the essence of modern gun-play, you will step into the role of a night hunter, traversing diverse battlefields, weaving deadly traps with bows and crossbows, and unlocking endless possibilities through never-ending challenges. 
Gameplay 
• Use trees, broken walls and other cover to hide, launch assassinations beyond the enemy’s sight, or take a secure position to aim with a crossbow and take out targets with pinpoint accuracy. 
• Each chapter offers unique settings, bosses and enemy arrangements. With cyclic challenges, the game guarantees long‑term play ability. 
• Weapons are divided into two main types, bow and crossbow, each with 17 different models at present, varying in performance and tactical role. Complete a set number of stages to unlock new gear, and upgrade to raise damage, arrow count and rate of fire, strengthening your combat power and forging your own exclusive arsenal. 
• Level up to increase health, stealth and arrow equipping attributes, directly improving survival and combat efficiency. 
• Take on bounty missions and gain diamonds, rare materials and other rich rewards upon completion. During stages, drones carrying keys will appear at random — shoot them down to collect keys; gather three keys to open one treasure chest and claim generous prizes. 
• The shop provides powerful weapons and resource packs to fuel rapid growth. 
Game Features 
• Combines ninja stealth and assassination elements with the thrilling impact of modern shooting, creating a unique combat rhythm of stealth plus sniping. 
• The five major chapters cover a wide variety of scenes. Each boss possesses distinctive battle mechanics, and enemies come in many types, offering wide scope for strategy. 
• A total of 34 weapons, bows and crossbows, with different attack styles and upgrade paths, together with stage unlock mechanics, satisfy collectors and those who love progression. 
• The key drone and treasure chest system adds exploration and instant decision making, turning battles into more than defeating foes - they bring unexpected surprises and the joy of resource management. 
• The hero can fully upgrade core attributes; the shop and bounty systems give clear paths for growth and high value returns.

Whether you're a casual player looking for easy word puzzles or a seasoned puzzler seeking a challenge, Word Cross has something for everyone. Word Search Puzzles: Classic word search games where you find hidden words in a grid. Test your vocabulary and find 5-letter words, 6-letter words, and even 7-letter words to master the game.
Daily Crossword Puzzles: Play free daily crosswords to keep your brain sharp. Each day brings new crossword puzzles filled with challenging clues to test your knowledge.

Crossword Puzzles Generator: Use our custom word search generator to create your own puzzles and challenge friends and family.
Seasonal Puzzles: Get into the holiday spirit with our themed puzzles like the Christmas hidden words and Halloween word search. You’ll love the festive word search games designed for every season.
Why Choose Word Cross?
Free to Play: No hidden fees or subscriptions, enjoy free crossword puzzles and free word search games without limits!
Daily Updates: Fresh content every day with new puzzles added regularly.
For All Skill Levels: From easy crossword games to expert-level challenges, there’s a puzzle for everyone.
Brain Training: Improve your vocabulary, focus, and memory with word puzzles designed to challenge your brain.
Play Offline: No internet connection? No problem! Play all our puzzles offline without restrictions.
Fun for All Ages: Whether you're a child learning new words or an adult seeking a mental challenge, Word Cross offers fun and engaging gameplay for all ages.
Word Cross is the perfect mix of word search, hidden words, and crossword puzzle clues. If you're a fan of word connect games, word hunt, or looking to find a word missing letters, this game will keep you entertained for hours. Whether you’re looking for a quick puzzle fix or a daily challenge, Word Cross is the ultimate game for word lovers.
Download Word Cross today and start solving puzzles now!

bluejetty:00174339:ios.summary:

This app provides a wide variety of sounds. Some are simp
bluejetty:00174339:ios.description:
Sound Oasis is the world leader in sound therapy systems. We take tinnitus therapy seriously and it is our hope that this application will provide relief for your tinnitus symptoms.
This app provides a wide variety of sounds. Some are simply great nature sounds. Others are different forms and frequencies of white noise. Six of the sounds are musical and were developed by Dr. Jeffrey Thompson, one of the world’s leading experts on sound therapy. Dr. Thompson’s sounds represent the most advanced approach to tinnitus therapy sounds that anyone has ever attempted with fixed pre-recorded sound tracks. Each of his sound tracks have multiple high range frequencies built right into the music so it is more palatable to play - during the day or to sleep with at night.
How Does This APP Work? 
The sounds in this app can be an effective tool to manage your tinnitus using sound therapy and sound masking to make tinnitus symptoms less noticeable. This masking effect can be particularly effective at night when the surrounding environment is quieter. By listening to pleasant sounds, particularly sounds close to the frequency level of your tinnitus symptoms, your brain will predominantly hear the pleasant sound instead of the annoying tinnitus noise.
Features: 
24 INCLUDED THERAPEUTIC SOUNDS: 
- 11 therapeutic white noise masking sounds: Brown Noise, Cooling Fan, Full Spectrum White Noise, Gray Noise, Natural White Noise, Ocean Surf with White Noise, Pink Noise, Rain with White Noise, Stream with White Noise, White Noise 4 kHz, White Noise 6 kHz
- 6 doctor developed tinnitus therapy sounds: Tinnitus Therapy .9K - 3.2K, Tinnitus Therapy 1 1K - 10K, Tinnitus Therapy 2 1K - 10K, Tinnitus Therapy 2.5K - 5K, Tinnitus Therapy 2K - 8K, Tinnitus Therapy 3 1K - 10K
- 7 authentic nature sounds: Forest Rain, Ocean Rain, Ocean and Crickets, Rain on Tent, Song Birds, Summer Night, Thunderstorm
SESSION TIMER 
- 5 to 120 minute session timer with continuous therapy option. 
12 BAND GRAPHIC EQUALIZER WITH INDIVIDUAL SOUND MEMORY 
- Control precise frequency levels of sound playback with exclusive 12 band graphic equalizer. 
- Tune each sound to your personal frequency levels. 
- Automatically save up to 2 of your favorite equalizer settings for each sound. 
SOFT-OFF VOLUME MANAGEMENT 
- Full volume control with soft-off volume management. 
FREE ACCESS TO ALL NEW SOUNDS 
- Free access to new sounds and features with regular application updates offered through the iTunes Store.

bluejetty:00137022:ios.description:
Get ready to embark on a dazzling journey in the world of K-Pop Academy, where your dream of building the ultimate K-pop sensation comes true! Immerse yourself in the charming world of adorable idols, where you take charge of their daily lives and guide them to stardom.
Build Your Dream K-Pop Supergroup: Create your very own K-pop music group by customizing every aspect of your idols, from their clothing and hairstyles to the trendiest accessories. Create your own idols or recreate your favorite, and watch as your idols transform into the next big K-pop sensation right in the palm of your hand!
Make a Home for Your Idols: Design and decorate a cozy home for your idols, making it the perfect haven for their creativity to flourish. Turn your pocket-sized space into a warm and adorable sanctuary where love and camaraderie thrive.
Cook, Rehearse, and Conquer: Take care of your idols' daily lives by cooking their favorite meals, helping them rehearse for performances, and nurturing their talents. Strengthen the bond between your idols and become their guiding star on the path to greatness.
Conquer the Stage: Put together breathtaking concerts and witness your idols steal the show! The stage is set for them to shine, and the applause from fans will fill their hearts with love. Become the ultimate K-pop phenomenon as you guide your idols to stardom!
Mini-Games for Rewards: K-Pop Academy is not just about managing the K-pop lifestyle – dive into entertaining mini-games that unlock exciting rewards! Whether it's testing your rhythm or challenging your strategic skills, these games add an extra layer of fun to your idol adventure.
LGBTQ+ Friendly & Diverse: At K-Pop Academy, diversity and inclusivity are at the heart of our world. Embrace the uniqueness of your idols and create a K-pop group that celebrates love in all its forms. This game is not just a simulation; it's a welcoming space for everyone.
Step into the spotlight at K-Pop Academy and witness the rise of your adorable idols!

bluejetty:00178249:ios.description:
Mochicats are carefree and enjoy eating and playing around. 
They can eat as much dessert as you feed them, like they will never get enough of it! 
They also love making new friends! The cats love those who buy them dessert , of course! 
Come play Mochicats Collection and invite all kinds of mochicats to join you, become friends with them. 
Let these cute little mochicats soothe you in the hustle and bustle world! 
Game Features 
1. Over 50 distinguishable cats are available for collection. 
2. You can interact with mochicats by poking, feeding and patting them. 
3. You can also pile up the mochicats. The more cats you have, the higher you can pile them up! 
4. A simple game with lots of fun that will soothe and comfort you every day! 
5. There are many secrets that you can only discover in the game once you join the mochicats!?
Terms of Services and Subscription 
Subscription of Mochicats' Blessing is available in the game. 
For only NT$290 a month (A special price of NT$140 is even designed for the first month!)
You will acquire the following: 
Unlock a unique lvl S Cleaner Cat! 
Auto poking and mochi collection functions. 
The best of all: a free party coupon on a daily basis! 
Payment: Once purchase is confirmed, payment will be deducted from the iTunes account. 
To renew the subscription, payment will be automatically deducted from your iTunes account 24 hours before services expire. 
Once the payment goes through, the subscription will be renewed for one month. 
To cancel the subscription: Please manually turn off the auto renewal function in subscription in your Apple ID at least 24 hours before services expire. 
For more information on how to cancel subscription and relevant terms, please refer to: 
https://support.apple.com/zh-tw/HT202039 
Terms of Use 
https://domozea.wixsite.com/sanctum/terms-of-use-mochicat 
Privacy Policy 
https://domozea.wixsite.com/sanctum/privacy-policy-mochicat

bluejetty:00063788:ios.description:
Navahang: Your Hub for Persian Music
Navahang is a Finland-based broadcasting and media production company and record label specializing in Persian music. We produce and publish songs and music videos, and operate a satellite TV channel, a radio station, and an online music streaming service.
Experience It All in One App
Discover the latest songs, music videos, albums, mixes, and playlists; listen to Radio Navahang; watch Navahang TV; and much more, all in one seamless app.
Key Features:
• Offline Listening: Enjoy songs, albums, playlists, mixes, and your custom-synced playlists anytime, anywhere.
• Upcoming Videos: View upcoming videos on Navahang TV.
• Smart Search: Easily find a song by searching for any part of its lyrics.
• Music Clips: Create “Music Clips” from any song.
• Playlist Creation: Build your own playlists, no login required.
• Live Lyrics: Read the lyrics of the currently playing song while listening to live radio.
• Sync & Share: Seamlessly sync, add songs to playlists, and share the tracks you’re enjoying on the radio.
• Latest Releases: Get instant access to the newest songs and music videos.
• Notifications: Receive timely alerts about important events and updates.
Enjoy Limitless Entertainment
All of Navahang’s services are completely free with no usage restrictions. We’re committed to providing you with an exceptional experience on our iOS app.
Your feedback is invaluable to us. Please reach out with any suggestions or if you run into any issues. We hope you enjoy exploring Navahang!

bluejetty:00174890:ios.description:
*** The original, most feature-rich and only iOS shutter count reader that works with all new Canons ***
ShutterCount displays the number of shutter actuations (the shutter count) of your Canon EOS, Nikon or Pentax digital camera - see the complete list of certified models below. The shutter count is read directly from USB or Wi-Fi connected Canons, and from image files for Nikon and Pentax cameras. With ShutterCount you can easily check whether a newly purchased camera is really new, or how heavily used a pre-owned item is. And you can save a trip to a service center by doing the reading for yourself.
BASE FEATURES
• Unlimited readings
• Counter for still photos
• Wear indicator with numeric and graphical rated shutter life percentage display
• History logging to track camera usage; logs are stored in CSV format that can be imported into Numbers or Excel for further processing
• Reports in plain text format
• Wizard to guide you through the reading process
LIVE VIEW PACK (optional in-app purchase supporting select Canon models)
• Counters for live view/videos and electronic shutter
• Distribution chart
PLUS PACK (optional in-app purchase)
• Graphing
• Shutter life forecasting (not available for some Nikon and Pentax models)
• History deduplication
• Canon EOS camera management (date/time sync, owner name editing, copyright information setting, outdated firmware warning, IPTC export/import)
• Raw copyright information display and secure personal data wiping for Canons

bluejetty:00137374:ios.summary: Welcome to "Gas Station: Idle Car Tycoon," the ultimate car station simulator game where your entrepreneurial journey begins at a small gas station, ready to be transformed into a bustling car service empire. This idle games experience is p
bluejetty:00137374:ios.description:
Welcome to "Gas Station: Idle Car Tycoon," the ultimate car station simulator game where your entrepreneurial journey begins at a small gas station, ready to be transformed into a bustling car service empire. This idle games experience is perfect for those who dream of managing their own business and becoming a tycoon in the world of cars and fuel delivery.
Build and Expand:
Start with a mini gas station and work your way up to a large station, adding fuel pumps to serve more cars and parking spaces to manage the idle cars waiting for service. Every car refueled brings you closer to expanding your station. With the money collected, invest in new services like a toilet for visitors, a mart for quick shopping, and a cafe to keep your customers happy.
Dive into the Arcade of Services:
Your gas station doesn't just stop at fuel. Open a mini mart where customers can grab essentials, making your station a one-stop destination. The arcade of services grows as you introduce a toilet to cater to the needs of every visitor, ensuring their comfort and satisfaction.
Cafe and Hotdog Delivery:
The aroma of hot dogs fills the air as you open your station's cafe. Prepare perfect hot dogs, ready to delight and satisfy. Expand your menu to include more items, offering a variety of choices to please your customers. With every hotdog sold, your cafe becomes the talk of the town, attracting more visitors and increasing your earnings.
Become the Idle Tycoon:
As a simulator game, Gas Station: Idle Car Tycoon allows you to become the tycoon you've always dreamed of. Manage your money wisely, invest in upgrades, and watch your idle tycoon empire grow. With offline gameplay, your station keeps earning money even when you're not playing, making it the perfect game for busy gamers.
Key Features:
Immersive simulator gameplay, perfect for fans of idle games and arcade challenges.
Manage a variety of services, from fuel to toilets, mart, cafe, and hotdog delivery.
Strategic expansion decisions to grow your car station empire.
Offline earnings make your tycoon journey continuous.
Perfectly designed for fans of car games, seeking a blend of arcade fun and tycoon strategy.
Ready to embark on this car station journey? Download "Gas Station: Idle Car Tycoon" now and start your path to becoming a gas station tycoon. Your empire awaits, with every car parked, every tank filled, and every hotdog sold bringing you closer to tycoon status. This game is the perfect blend of idle pleasure and active management, ready to please any aspiring tycoon. Please, join us in this adventure and let your tycoon journey begin!

This idle games experience is perfect for those who dream of managing their own business and becoming a tycoon in the world of cars and fuel delivery.

Build and Expand:
Start with a mini gas station and work your way up to a large station, adding fuel pumps to serve more cars and parking spaces to manage the idle cars waiting for service. Every car refueled brings you closer to expanding your station. With the money collected, invest in new services like a toilet for visitors, a mart for quick shopping, and a cafe to keep your customers happy.

Dive into the Arcade of Services:
Your gas station doesn't just stop at fuel. Open a mini mart where customers can grab essentials, making your station a one-stop destination. The arcade of services grows as you introduce a toilet to cater to the needs of every visitor, ensuring their comfort and satisfaction.

Cafe and Hotdog Delivery:
The aroma of hot dogs fills the air as you open your station's cafe. Prepare perfect hot dogs, ready to delight and satisfy. Expand your menu to include more items, offering a variety of choices to please your customers. With every hotdog sold, your cafe becomes the talk of the town, attracting more visitors and increasing your earnings.

Become the Idle Tycoon:
As a simulator game, Gas Station: Idle Car Tycoon allows you to become the tycoon you've always dreamed of. Manage your money wisely, invest in upgrades, and watch your idle tycoon empire grow. With offline gameplay, your station keeps earning money even when you're not playing, making it the perfect game for busy gamers.

Key Features:

Immersive simulator gameplay, perfect for fans of idle games and arcade challenges.
Manage a variety of services, from fuel to toilets, mart, cafe, and hotdog delivery.
Strategic expansion decisions to grow your car station empire.
Offline earnings make your tycoon journey continuous.
Perfectly designed for fans of car games, seeking a blend of arcade fun and tycoon strategy.
Ready to embark on this car station journey? Download "Gas Station: Idle Car Tycoon" now and start your path to becoming a gas station tycoon. Your empire awaits, with every car parked, every tank filled, and every hotdog sold bringing you closer to tycoon status. This game is the perfect blend of idle pleasure and active management, ready to please any aspiring tycoon. Please, join us in this adventure and let your tycoon journey begin!

bluejetty:00108008:android.description:
SBI Secure OTP is an OTP generation App for verifying transactions done through SBI Internet Banking and Yono Lite App. 
The application will replace the need for receiving the OTP for INB transactions via SMS. OTP can be generated using the application after completion of registration process. The application will generate Online OTP with Internet connectivity ON.
User can generate Online OTP after login to the application. 
User can click on the de-register option provided in the "Settings" menu within the application. Alternatively visit Onlinesbi and go to "Profile>> High Security Option" and deregister the SBI Secure OTP App from there to complete the de-registration process.
Please note that after de-registration of the app, user will start receiving the OTP in registered mobile number with Internet Banking.
One time registration with your Internet Banking credentials is required for using the App. Service provider independent, hassle free OTP service is now available to customer.
For more details please visit, https://mobilityretail.sbi/sbijava/mobile/sbsecure_otp_app_faq.html
