bluejetty:00140948:ios.summary: Relax, explore your mind, and sleep better with the Lumenate app. Utilizing research-backed light sequences from your phone's flashlight, Lumenate guides you into an altered state of consciousness, blending deep meditation and classic psych
bluejetty:00140948:ios.description:
Relax, explore your mind, and sleep better with the Lumenate app. Utilizing research-backed light sequences from your phone's flashlight, Lumenate guides you into an altered state of consciousness, blending deep meditation and classic psychedelics. In this state, you can expect to be fully immersed in the present moment, experiencing powerful closed-eye visuals and exploring your mind from a new perspective.
How It Works
Lumenate uses neural entrainment to synchronize brain waves with the flashing light, gently guiding the brain into an altered state of consciousness.
Steps to Use
- Get comfortable.
- Point your phone's flashlight towards you.
- Close your eyes.
- Immerse yourself in a kaleidoscope of shapes and colours.
Key Benefits
- Relax & De-Stress: Reduce stress and everyday anxiety by immersing yourself in the present moment.
- Explore Your Mind: Discover new thoughts and perspectives.
- Sleep Better: Enhance your sleep quality with guided sessions.
- Improve Mental Wellbeing: Feel calmer, happier and better rested.
- Boost Focus and Productivity: Clear mental fog and focus on priorities.
- Enhance Creativity: Unlock new levels of creativity.
- Emotional Healing: Process and release emotional blockages.
Backed by Science
- EEG Brain Scans: Developed through hundreds of scans.
- Neural Entrainment: Experience consciousness shifts.
- Expert Endorsements:
 “Capable of inducing visual effects with an intensity similar to psychedelic substances” - Freie Universität Berlin.
 “Stroboscopic stimulation offers a powerful non-pharmacological means of inducing altered states of consciousness” - Sussex University.
- Ongoing Research: We support and fund cutting-edge neuroscience and psychedelic research at Imperial College London, Freie Universität Berlin and many more leading universities.
Upgrade to Lumenate Plus
- Exclusive Content: Access John Lennon’s ‘Mind Games’ Special Mixes. 9 sessions designed to put the listener in a relaxed and contemplative state, using various sound design techniques and processes applied to the original 2" multitrack recordings, complemented with additional instrumentation from Sean Ono Lennon.
- Rosamund Pike: Golden Globe winning Actress Rosamund Pike is our company’s Creative Director and voice of the app.
- Guided Sessions: Receive guidance on goals and contentment.
- AI Guide: Personalize your experience, set intentions and integration.
- Better Sleep: Custom sessions for a restful night.
- Open Explorations: Explore your mind freely.
- Guiding Soundtracks: Purposeful music for every session.
- Fresh Content: Regular new experiences.
- Personal Journal: Reflect on your thoughts.
- Offline Access: Download sessions for use without Wi-Fi.
Subscription
Lumenate offers auto-renewing monthly and yearly subscriptions. If affordability is an issue, email support@lumenategrowth.com for free access. Manage your subscription in iTunes Account settings. Charges apply upon purchase confirmation.
We are a technology company that provides mobile mediation services that are guided by sound and stroboscopic light to promote mindfulness and well-being. The Services do not fall within the criteria of a medical device pursuant to Section 201(h) of the United States Federal Food, Drug and Cosmetic Act because they are not intended in any way to diagnose, treat or cure conditions or diseases. We are not healthcare professionals or a provider of medical or healthcare services.
Note: Not suitable for those under 18 or those with a history of photosensitive epilepsy.
Terms of Service: https://lumenategrowth.com/app-terms/
Privacy Policy: https://lumenategrowth.com/app-privacy-policy/

bluejetty:00062198:ios.description:
"This may be the best iPad app yet. Worth buying the iPad for all by itself. Range, power, clarity, all improving day by day. A wonderful tool." - Music in Ashcroft
Can I learn to sing?
If you can talk, you can sing. Singing is a completely natural activity; our voices are designed for both speaking and singing (in ancient human tribes, everyone sang, not just a few “professional” singers). Singing uses basically the same skills as speech, but for singing we use our breath differently, hold sounds longer, and use a wider range of tones.
Don’t I need talent?
You may not be able to become the fastest marathon runner. However, unless you have a physical condition that prevents you from running, you can most definitely train to run marathons successfully, and get very good at it through regular exercise. Similarly, you may not be able to become the next Pavarotti; however, you can be as good as many professional singers who sing for a living, provided you train your voice regularly and with focus. Even if you’re not willing to put in a lot of effort, you can always improve from where you are, and have fun singing.
Why do I need training?
Just as you can’t run a marathon without any training and practice, you can’t sing well without training and practice. Lessons used in Erol Singer’s Studio focus on techniques and sounds that show you how to use your voice effectively, and prevent you from making the most common mistakes in singing, such as breathing poorly and closing your throat (e.g. by letting your larynx rise up). These carefully selected sounds, which have been in use for centuries around the world, ensure that your muscles are coordinated in the most useful ways for singing. By practicing these sounds and building up the muscle memory, it becomes easier to sing other sounds as well and you have more freedom in different parts of your vocal range.
Why Erol Singer’s Studio?
With Erol Singer’s Studio, we defined a new genre of vocal training software starting in 2012, and have improved it year after year with your feedback and our own ideas. Patented at its core, the app comes with a complete set of lessons organized into progressive levels designed by an award winning singer and vocal coach, best in class super-smooth pitch tracking technology that’s a joy to use, and an optional built-in exercise editor for those who’d like to add their own patterns/song-snippets for practice. But don’t take our word for it; download for free¹ and see for yourself.
Terms of Use: https://www.erolstudios.com/ToU-ESS-iOS.html
¹ Beginner 1 & 2, and select exercises in other levels are included for free, while the complete set of lessons requires an active subscription. If you decide to purchase a subscription, payment will be charged to your Apple ID account when you confirm your purchase. Subscription automatically renews unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period; your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. You can manage and cancel your subscriptions via your account settings on the App Store after purchase.

bluejetty:00120395:ios.description:
NagmaLive – Your Essential Companion for Tabla, Kathak and Indian Classical Music Practice
Whether you’re a tabla player, kathak dancer, instrumentalist, vocalist, or an electronic musician, NagmaLive helps you bring your practice to life with real nagma and lehra recordings by world-class artists. Personalize your sessions, track your progress, and immerse yourself in the authentic sound of Indian classical music.
Key Features
Authentic Nagma & Lehra Library
 - 14 popular Raags to explore
 - Choose your lead instrument: Sarangi, Harmonium, or Sitar
 - Real recordings by renowned artists:
 Ustad Roshan Ali Khan – Sarangi
 Jayanta Banerjee – Sitar & Harmonium
 Hiranmay Mitra – Harmonium
 Chaz Hastings – Tabla
Multiple Taal Options
 - Tintal, Rupaktal, Jhaptal, Ektal, Dhamar
 - Adjustable tempo: 15–600 BPM for Tintal, 15–300 BPM for others
 - Add a Tanpura drone alongside your nagma
Advanced Mixer Controls
 - Fine-tune volume, reverb, and stereo panning for each instrument
Presets for Fast Setup
 - Save and recall personalized practice settings
 - Adjust nagma pitch, taal, and BPM with ease
Kathak Mode
 - Live tabla theka recordings tailored for Kathak practice
 - Matching taal and pitch for each nagma
Alap & Gats
 - Add Alap intros for a live feel
 - Practice tabla accompaniment with gat recordings
 - Boost drut tintal with real jhala tracks
Practice Tracking & Sharing
 - Save your sessions and monitor your progress
 - Share milestones on social media
TERMS OF USE

bluejetty:00129042:ios.summary: Discover Arkheim - Realms at War, the new fantasy MMO war game from the makers of the MMO strategy classic, Travian. Build an empire, raid and battle in true cross-platform PVP – the depth of an RTS strategy game, with the accessibility of
bluejetty:00129042:ios.description:
Discover Arkheim - Realms at War, the new fantasy MMO war game from the makers of the MMO strategy classic, Travian. Build an empire, raid and battle in true cross-platform PVP – the depth of an RTS strategy game, with the accessibility of a mobile app.
Arkheim, once a legendary empire, has been destroyed with remnants of its kingdom floating in the sky. Its ancient relics have enthralled new explorers such as yourself, promising power and answers about the past. A prophecy foretells that once all three moons align into the Full Moon Trinity, those worthy will ascend into a Kingdom of Eternal Light. You must gather mystical orbs that let you channel the energy of the moons, and transfer them into a colossal relic at the center of your realm: the Ark. The stronger your Ark, the more powerful your empire will become.
Build your empire and command a mighty army. Dungeon battles will have you face-to-face with twisted demons. Battle demons to gain ancient knowledge and powerful items in return. Command Warlords with unique sets of abilities and send multiple armies into epic PvP battles. Raid other realms to gain powerful orbs and increase the power of your Ark.
Fantasy war tactics will make or break your empire. Create an alliance and discuss MMO strategy, and fight alongside players all over the world. RTS strategy will lead your empire to the Kingdom of Eternal Light...or to destruction. You hold the fate of your people in your hands.
Will you be deemed worthy to ascend into the Kingdom of Eternal Light?
ARKHEIM FEATURES:
Fantasy RTS Games:
- Command an army of fallen soldiers & harvest the power of the three moons
- Build up your economy & train a mighty military
- Raid other realms and steal their orbs to increase the power of your Ark
Build Your Empire:
- War Commander, Pioneer & Ascendant: Gifted with rare abilities, you're destined to turn your settlement into a flourishing city
- Battle as a ruthless elf or an inventive dwarf and enter war over an ancient prophecy
- Unite in a powerful kingdom, your realm, with players from all over the world
- Kingdom defense and expansion: Fight for territorial conquest & epic loot
Alliance Strategy:
- MMO strategy: Join a realm and meet allies to battle with
- Build mighty alliances in your realm
- Team-based 4X strategy game - where teamwork is key
War & Dungeons:
- Raid other realms and goblin towers to gather mystical orbs to channel the energy of the moons
- Battle twisted demons, gain ancient knowledge and collect powerful items
- Command mighty warlords and clash with other players
- PvP battles: Devise cunning strategy to conquer enemy towers and prevail
Create a prosperous future for you, your people and your realm.
--
Arkheim - Realms at War offers in-app purchases. You can disable this by turning off the in-app purchases in your device’s settings.
Privacy Policy: https://agb.traviangames.com/privacy-en.pdf

- Controller support.
From the creator of Shoot The Moon, Punch Kick Duck is a compact, lovingly made score-chaser game designed to test your skills without emptying your wallet.

Fighting is all about timing. Just ask any duck.

The right move + right time = swift victory.

All you need to do is PUNCH KICK DUCK!

The cruel Baron Tigrisso has imprisoned you in his tower. Fight hordes of the Baron’s hench-critters as you battle up the tower to confront your captor.

Simple controls & challenging action mean you'll soon be sending foes flying and chasing high scores. But be warned, your enemies are as determined as they are numerous, so you'll need to think quick and act quicker!!

Just remember these three golden rules, passed down by countless generations of ducks:

PUNCH beats KICK
KICK beats DUCK
DUCK beats PUNCH

Oh, and don’t forget to RUN. You don’t want to meet The BEAR.

Think you can handle it? Sure you can. You’re one tough duck!

- Three selectable difficulty levels.
- Unbox a colorful cast of characters.
- Playable in both landscape and portrait orientation.
- Cloud saves.
- Simple responsive touch controls.
- Controller support.

From the creator of Shoot The Moon, Punch Kick Duck is a compact, lovingly made score-chaser game designed to test your skills without emptying your wallet.

bluejetty:00060881:ios.name: Avaya Workplace
bluejetty:00060881:ios.summary: Avaya Workplace integrates your iPhone and iPad with your office Avaya Aura or IP Office communications environment and delivers mobile voice & video VoIP calling, rich conferencing, instant messaging, presence, visual voicemail, corporate
bluejetty:00060881:ios.description:
Avaya Workplace integrates your iPhone and iPad with your office Avaya Aura or IP Office communications environment and delivers mobile voice & video VoIP calling, rich conferencing, instant messaging, presence, visual voicemail, corporate directory access, call history and more!
Key Capabilities (Feature availability will vary based on your environment and configured services)
· VoIP calls – Lower your mobile service charges by making VoIP calls over Wi-Fi or mobile data networks
· Conceal Your Mobile Phone Number - Calls made with Avaya Workplace are handled by your office communication system and will display your office calling line ID, not your mobile phone number
· Cellular Voice integration – If VoIP isn’t your best option, then traditional cellular voice service can be used and calls will still be routed through your office communication system
· Call Mobility – VoIP roaming between Wi-Fi and 3/4G networks, and call handoff between cellular voice and VoIP
· Single Number Contact – Choose to have incoming office calls ring on your iPhone and/or any other phone you may want to use
· Visual voicemail – Enables you to see who left you a voice message and when it arrived. Messages can be played in any order.
· Instant Messaging – Exchange text messages and multi-media file attachments with archival/retrieval
· Presence status – View the Presence status of colleagues
· 24X7 call logs shows all office line call activity regardless of which device was used or when calls arrived
· Corporate Directory Integration – Search for corporate contacts and create a list of favorites
· Integrated audio / video / web conferencing with Avaya Workplace Meetings Online and Avaya Workplace Conferencing

bluejetty:00114293:android.description:
VixFun : Photo to Video Maker is an advanced AI-powered creative app that transforms your photos into stunning, dynamic videos in just a few taps. Designed for creators, influencers, and everyday users, VixFun lets you bring still images to life using powerful AI video effects, face animation, and photo-to-video generation technology.
With VixFun, you can upload a single photo and instantly convert them into eye-catching AI videos. The app uses smart motion effects, realistic transitions, and high-quality rendering to produce smooth and engaging videos that look professional and trendy.
The app includes intelligent face detection and enhancement, ensuring natural movement and expressive results. You can preview results instantly, customize effects, and export videos in high quality without complicated editing tools.
VixFun : Photo to Video Maker is a powerful and easy-to-use app that transforms your photos into stunning videos using smart animation and motion effects. With just a single image, VixFun adds smooth movements, dynamic transitions, and stylish visual effects to create eye-catching videos.
VixFun helps you turn ordinary photos into engaging video clips without any editing experience. Simply choose a photo, select a video style, and let the app automatically generate a high-quality video.
Whether you want to create trendy videos, animated portraits, stylish lifestyle clips, or creative photo animations, VixFun makes video creation for everyone.
VixFun is built with a clean and user-friendly interface, making it suitable for beginners while still powerful enough for advanced users. No video editing experience is required—just upload your photo, choose an effect, and generate your AI video in seconds.
Features:
* Photo to AI video generation with smooth motion
* Trending AI video effects and styles
* Face-based animation and enhancement
* High-quality video output
* Simple and intuitive user interface
* Convert photos into videos instantly
* Smart motion and animation effects
* Multiple video styles and templates

bluejetty:00184794:ios.summary:
SmartRace Race App for Carrera® Digital
Bring the racing action directly to your living room with the SmartRace Race App for Carrera® Digital! Just connect Carrera® AppConnect® to your track and start SmartRace on your tablet or smartphone
bluejetty:00184794:ios.description:
SmartRace Race App for Carrera® Digital
Bring the racing action directly to your living room with the SmartRace Race App for Carrera® Digital! Just connect Carrera® AppConnect® to your track and start SmartRace on your tablet or smartphone. SmartRace features:
* Clear racing screen with all the important data for all drivers and cars.
* Free practice, qualifying and race mode (time or lap based) available
* Database for drivers, cars and tracks with photos and tracking of personal records.
* Gathering of extensive statistical data with all driven laps, leader changes and pitstops in races and qualifyings.
* Sharing, sending, saving and printing of results (depends on third party apps).
* Voice announcements with the driver's name for important events.
* Ambient sounds to make the driving experience even more intensive and realistic.
* Full support for the fuel feature with exact display of the current amount left in the fuel tank.
* Straightforward setup for cars using sliders (speed, brake strength, fuel tank size).
* Straightforward assignment for drivers and cars to controllers.
* Assignment of individual colors to each controller for easy distinction.
* Many configuration options for all segments of the app.
* Fast and free support for all questions and issues.
SmartRace (aswell as the voice announcements) is entirely available in english, but you can of course switch to one of the supported and included languages any time. These languages are supported at the moment:
* English
* German
* French
* Italian
* Spanish
* Dutch
* Polish
If you have any questions, are experiencing issues or have new ideas, please head over to https://support.smartrace.de or get in touch with me via info@smartrace.de. SmartRace is constantly refined with new and useful features!
——— In-App Purchases and Subscriptions ———
You may want to subscribe to the SmartRace Champions Club to get immediate access to all available add-ons, available as a subscription from within the app.
- 1 month costs €2.49
Should you choose to subscribe to the SmartRace Champions Club, the purchase will be charged to your iTunes account. The subscription will be auto-renewed 24 hours prior to it running out and you can manage it from User Settings in iTunes after purchasing it, and you'll also be able to cancel the auto-renewing subscription from there.
Terms and Privacy Policy: https://www.smartrace.de/tos
SmartRace is a cooperations partner of the ADAC RAVENOL 24h Nürburgring.
Carrera®, Carrera Digital® and Carrera AppConnect® are registered trademarks of Stadlbauer Marketing + Vertrieb GmbH. SmartRace is no official Carrera product and in no way affiliated with or endorsed by Stadlbauer Marketing + Vertrieb GmbH.

The app is compatible with most Air
bluejetty:00100470:ios.description:
Smart Printer App℠ helps you print, scan, edit, and organize documents and photos directly from your phone, whenever you need. This all-in-one printer and scanner app is built to simplify everyday tasks.
The app is compatible with most AirPrint-enabled printers, making wireless printing fast and effortless.
Whether you’re handling work files, study materials, or personal documents, you can manage everything from your iPhone or iPad without switching between multiple apps or devices.
Our smart printer & scanner app works seamlessly with most printer models, including HP, Brother, Canon, Dell, Epson, Lanier, Xerox, Aurora, Lexmark, Panasonic, Ricoh, Toshiba, and many more.
PRINT ANYTHING
Smart Printer gives you the freedom to print almost any type of content with ease. Documents, photos, emails, plain text, or web pages can be sent to your printer in just a few taps. The app focuses on smooth performance and reliable output, so printing feels simple instead of technical.
SCAN DOCUMENTS & PHOTOS
With the built-in smart scanner, your phone becomes a portable scanning tool. Use your camera to scan documents and photos anytime, anywhere. Capture receipts, contracts, handwritten notes, or images, then adjust brightness, crop edges, and enhance clarity before saving or printing. Your scans stay clean, readable, and professional.
PRINT PHOTOS
Turn digital memories into physical prints effortlessly. Select photos from your library and print them instantly. Smart Printer supports batch photo printing, making it easy to create albums, share moments with family, or print images for daily use.
PRINT DOCUMENTS
Access documents stored on your device or in cloud storage and print them without extra steps. The app supports common formats such as PDF, PNG, and JPEG, so you can print reports, forms, invoices, or study files quickly and confidently.
PRINT FROM EMAIL, TEXT & WEBSITE
Smart Printer makes it easy to print content from outside the app. Print email attachments, plain text, or web pages by sharing them directly to Smart Printer. No copying, no exporting — just send and print.
FILES MANAGEMENT
Keep everything organized in one place. Smart Printer includes file management tools that let you store, rename, sort, and review your scanned and printed files. This helps you stay organized and find important documents whenever you need them.
LOGIN & SYNC DATA
Your documents stay safe and accessible across devices. With login and data sync, Smart Printer keeps your files up to date so you can continue your work seamlessly, whether you switch devices or return later.

The story unfolds in the middle of the 20th century. The Sullivans family, consisting of brave father Thomas, sm
bluejetty:00086398:ios.description:
Welcome to Yukon: Family Adventure! Immerse yourself in this captivating farm game simulator and build your farm from scratch.
The story unfolds in the middle of the 20th century. The Sullivans family, consisting of brave father Thomas, smart and cute mother Nancy, active daughter Casey and fearless dog Riley, will become your companions in all adventures.
Help our characters expand the town with new buildings, produce valuable resources, upgrade the barn and design their farm with unique decorations. Sow and harvest crops, raise livestock and boost productivity by cooking meals. Explore different locations and enjoy exciting adventures there. Meet friends, help and even rescue some of them. Fulfil orders and get rewarded for your efforts.
Dive into the world of farming fun where every day brings a new opportunity to create, explore and thrive!
Main features of Yukon: Family Adventure:
- Adventures. Set off on a journey to uncover the breathtaking beauty of a vibrant, fresh dreamland, discovering new and untouched wonders at every step. 
- Home Atmosphere. Improve your homeplace, restore buildings, bring animals into the household and decorate your farm. A diverse range of production buildings, including carpentry, pottery and even power station, ensures a comfortable life for the town of Yukon and offers opportunities for trade.
- Farm Work. Collect resources like plants, wood and stones. Harvest crops, care for domestic animals and cook food to boost productivity.
- Quests. Take on thrilling challenges and join the adventures of the Sullivans family.
- Friends and Enemies. Encounter unique friendly characters and face off against dangerous wild animals.
- Storyline. Follow the characters on amazing adventures that take them to surprising locations in Yukon and beyond. Through engaging dialogues, they connect with each other and their friends, drawing the player deeper into the unfolding story.
- Graphics. Every element is crafted by our expert artists and animators, making the game uniquely beautiful and captivating.
- Various Events. Participate in our main locations, seasonal activities and special events - there's always something exciting to do!
Follow Yukon: Family Adventure on Facebook and Instagram for news and extra fun!
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/profile.php?id=61554720345227
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/yukonfamilyadventure
Have questions about the game? Our support team is here to help - just email us to support@enixan.com!

As a Vonage Customer the Extensions app brings your home phone to your iPhone. Download now and you can make and receive home phone calls on up to two phones over W
bluejetty:00034932:ios.description:
Your new Vonage VoIP phone service is here. And you can take it anywhere. 
As a Vonage Customer the Extensions app brings your home phone to your iPhone. Download now and you can make and receive home phone calls on up to two phones over Wi-Fi or 3G/4G. (Push Notifications required)
Features
• Make calls from your Vonage home number on your iPhone (New)
• Calls to your home phone ring on up to two smartphones at the same time -answer whichever one is more convenient (New)
• VoIP allows for business and home phone service, or calls on the move
• Save with your Vonage internet calling plan wherever you are – unlimited international calling to 60+ countries with some plans
• Use WiFi calling to make online phone calls and save cell minutes, avoid roaming charges when abroad and reach people when there’s poor coverage
• Know who is calling you on your Vonage number - the app will use your contact book to tell you who is calling
• Uses your contact book for easy, one touch dialing
• Do Not Disturb – Easily turn on and off calls to the app (New)
• Keep your mobile number private – Caller ID will show your Vonage number. (New)
• Choose which number to display as your Caller ID – Home or Mobile.
• Block unwanted calls to your Vonage line from your Recents or Call Settings. (New)
• Boomerang - for international callers. No more missed call & callback frustration. Automatically connects to selected contacts using YOUR Vonage VoIP number - at no charge to them! (New)
Getting Started
• Download the Vonage Extensions VoIP app to your iPhone 
• Enter your mobile number, your Vonage VoIP phone number and your account password.
• View the tour and accept push notifications to receive inbound calls.
Note: Vonage VoIP service required.
* Reasonable Use Policy applies to unlimited calling. Extensions® usage is combined with home phone usage under the policy. See www.vonage.com/reasonable_use_policy from more details. Calls made from mobiles may use airtime and incur charges, depending on your mobile plan.
Pat: http://www.vonage.com/corporate/press_patents.php

bluejetty:00075573:ios.description:
Study AI is a cutting-edge mobile application that harnesses the power of artificial intelligence (AI) to revolutionize the way you approach scientific tasks. With Study AI, you can simply snap a photo of any complex problem from the fields of algebra, chemistry, physics or other scientific subjects, and let the app do the rest. It's like having a personal tutor in your pocket, available anytime, anywhere. 
Key Features:
Intelligent Photo Analysis: Study AI utilizes advanced AI algorithms to analyze the photo of your scientific task accurately. Whether it's an algebraic equation or a chemical formula, the app can decipher the problem, break it down, and identify the relevant components.
Instant Solutions: Within seconds, Study AI provides you with comprehensive solutions to your scientific problems. The app's AI-powered engine applies complex calculations, rule-based algorithms, and extensive scientific knowledge to generate step-by-step solutions tailored to your specific task.
Detailed Explanations: Understanding the process is just as important as finding the solution. Study AI goes beyond providing answers and offers detailed explanations for each step of the solution. This helps you grasp the underlying concepts and enhances your learning experience.
Comprehensive Subject Coverage: Study AI supports a wide range of scientific subjects, including algebra, calculus, chemistry, physics, and more. No matter the complexity or topic, the app is designed to handle a variety of scientific tasks, making it a versatile tool for students, professionals, and enthusiasts alike.
User-Friendly Interface: Study AI features an intuitive and user-friendly interface, ensuring a seamless experience for users of all skill levels. Its sleek design and easy-to-navigate layout make it effortless to capture photos, view solutions, and explore additional resources.
Please note, some of the features are limited or available only to premium subscription holders. Namely: detailed and step-by-step solutions, unlimited AI queries and ads-free experience.
Privacy and Security: Rest assured that your data and scanned photos are treated with the utmost confidentiality. Study AI prioritizes user privacy and implements robust security measures to protect your information. For more details please see our privacy policy https://telegra.ph/APENGAMES-O%C3%9C-Privacy-Policy-10-20 and Terms of use https://telegra.ph/APENGAMES-O%C3%9C-Terms-of-Use-EULA-06-02
Unlock the power of AI and transform the way you tackle scientific challenges with Study AI. Whether you're a student looking for quick homework help, a professional needing on-the-go problem-solving assistance, or an enthusiast eager to explore scientific concepts, Study AI is the ultimate tool for your academic and scientific journey.
Note: Study AI is intended to assist users in their scientific tasks and learning process. It is always recommended to understand the underlying principles and concepts rather than solely relying on automated solutions.

bluejetty:00116804:ios.description:
Ready for a real brain challenge?
We’ve got the ultimate puzzle game for true logic lovers! Our new game will put your brain to the test with intricate word puzzles, hidden proverbs, famous quotes, and secret words to decode. But here’s the twist – there’s no auto-fill! Every single letter must be placed manually, and mistakes matter – accuracy is everything! Can you handle the challenge?
A Fresh Take on the Crossword Puzzle Genre!
If you love crossword puzzles, logic riddles, and word games, this is your next obsession! We’ve taken the classic crossword genre and turned it into an interactive brain workout, where every move requires precision and strategy. No more random guessing or easy solutions – each word must be carefully assembled, piece by piece.
This is the perfect mix of traditional word puzzles and innovative gameplay mechanics that will keep you hooked for hours. Whether you enjoy word searches, cryptograms, or number-based word puzzles, this game will challenge and entertain you like never before.
What makes this word puzzle unique?
This isn’t just another crossword game. It’s a logic-based puzzle experience, where you match letters with numbers and manually place each one into the correct spot. The difficulty ramps up as you progress, and every mistake is tracked – so stay sharp and think strategically!
Game Features:
- No auto-fill – every letter must be placed manually!
- Mistakes are tracked – precision and attention to detail are essential
- Strategic gameplay – every move has consequences
- Levels get harder over time – get ready for a true mental workout
- Hidden proverbs, famous quotes, and historical facts to uncover
- Unique blend of logic riddles and word puzzles
- Intuitive controls, deep strategy – easy to start, hard to master
How to play?
- Match letters to their corresponding numbers
- Drag and drop each letter – no shortcuts or auto-completion
- Be careful – mistakes are recorded, and accuracy affects your progress
- Beat each level to unlock more complex challenges and sharpen your mind
Get ready for a whole new level of word puzzle fun! This is more than just crosswords – it's a precision-driven logic test, combining the charm of classic puzzles with fresh, innovative mechanics.

bluejetty:00177181:ios.description:
Love playing match-3 puzzle games? Love eating delicious cakes, cookies, and desserts? Now you can do both with Cake Blast - Match 3 Puzzle Game, an exciting and addictive matching puzzle game that's all about matching candy, swapping cakes, and creating huge blast combos! 
Cake Blast - Match 3 Puzzle Game takes place in a wonderful world of colorful sweets. Chef Rose needs to make special cake flavors by matching many different desserts. She'll need your help to solve each puzzle by crushing, popping, and matching sweets in this fun and free adventure. All you need to do is swap desserts to create matches of three or more pieces, then keep playing until you clear the whole screen!
Hope you're hungry, because Cake Blast will fill your eyes with all of the sweetest desserts in the world. In addition to the best free match-3 puzzle levels around, you'll also enjoy these fun features:
• Swap, match, pop, and blast desserts in a colorful and fun world
• Create amazing power-ups that help you make bigger matches
• Play alone or match against friends online
• Meet crazy characters and uncover funs surprises
• Enjoy special tournaments and other events
• Sync your progress across multiple devices
• Over 2440 puzzles to solve, with more to come in the future
• FREE to play, and lots of fun!
Crush, pop, and blast sweet desserts in this crazy game as you destroy everything from cookies to chocolate, honey snacks, jelly treats, and of course, every cake flavor you can imagine. Matching is addictive and easy, but beating all of the levels and mastering this puzzle game will be a true challenge. Think you're good enough to win?
Start this sweet puzzle matching adventure today by downloading Cake Blast right away!

D0TS Echoplex gives you the same visuals and sounds, so you can easily recreate the drum line, right in your hand. Feel free to use this application as a music instrument to play the song live by yourself, or with your band.

All the audio files are extracted from the Nine Inch Nails album “The Slip”, available at nin.com under a creative commons attribution non-commercial share alike license.

bluejetty:00033977:ios.description:
Transform your home into a powerful, intelligent fitness hub with the MERACH app. Seamlessly connect your MERACH rowing machine, treadmill, exercise bike, or elliptical trainer to unlock guided workouts and real-time control. Achieve your strength, endurance, and fat-burning goals through structured programs, diverse on-demand classes, and direct smart equipment integration—all within your personal space.
【User-Friendly Features】
Engineered for intuitive and effective training, our core features give you complete control:
- Smart Instant Connection: Effortlessly pair your rower, treadmill, bike, or elliptical via Bluetooth for a setup that’s ready in seconds.
- Three Core Training Modes: Tailor every session. Choose Free Training for ultimate flexibility, Timed Training for efficiency, and Distance-Based Goals for targeted challenges.
- Direct Automated Control: During guided sessions, the app automatically adjusts your equipment’s resistance, incline,or speed, creating a truly immersive and hands-free training experience.
- Diverse On-Demand Library: Access a wide range of workouts led by expert trainers, from scenic routes and HIIT to strength and recovery programs, all designed for effective home fitness. 
- Comprehensive Performance Dashboard: Track all your key metrics—calories burned, distance covered, workout duration, and history—in one clear overview to visualize and celebrate your progress.
【Discover More】
Discover the features that make your fitness journey engaging and insightful: "Global Go" Challenge: Turn daily exercise into a rewarding global adventure. Complete workouts to collect exclusive regional badges, making consistency fun and your achievements uniquely collectible.
【Contact Us】
We are committed to supporting your fitness journey. Connect with us and our community through the following dedicated channels:
- Email Support: For direct assistance, technical issues, or detailed feedback, please contact our official support team at yulumerit@gmail.com. We strive to respond promptly.
- Join Our Discord Community: Connect with fellow MERACH users! Our Discord server is the perfect place to exchange tips, share experiences, find motivation, and browse user-driven FAQs. Join the conversation here: https://discord.gg/dxHCfNvquG
Ready to begin? Download MERACH now, connect your machine, and start your journey to true fitness freedom at home.

bluejetty:00033481:ios.description:
Be the GM. Build the Dynasty.
Scout, draft, train, and manage your way to a championship. Baseball Franchise Manager puts you in charge of every decision — rosters, finances, facilities, and game-day strategy — as you build a franchise from the ground up.
WHY MANAGERS LOVE IT
• Deep stats and real-time match simulations
• Scout and draft talent from around the world
• Train players and track their development
• Upgrade facilities to boost performance and revenue
• Compete in daily league games against managers worldwide
• Casual characters, serious strategy
Live out a full season — spring training through the playoffs — and see if you have what it takes to lead your team to a title.
UPGRADE YOUR FACILITIES
Better facilities mean better players. Invest in training equipment and expand your stadium to boost performance, grow your fanbase, and increase revenue through ticket sales and sponsorships.
SCOUT THE WORLD FOR TALENT
A championship team starts with scouting. Track stats and performance across a global talent pool, then make your move in the draft or free agency to land the players your roster needs.
TRAIN YOUR ROSTER TO THE TOP
Tailor training programs to each player's strengths — strength, skill, conditioning — and track their progress as they develop into stars.
DAILY LEAGUES & TOURNAMENTS
Compete against managers worldwide in daily league games. Every match is a chance to prove your strategy and climb the standings.
Baseball Franchise Manager is the most realistic baseball management game out there. Put on your GM hat and build something legendary.
Questions or feedback? Reach us at info@grandpike.com or on Facebook @baseballfranchisemanager — we love hearing from our managers.
EULA: https://www.baseballmanagergame.com/eula

bluejetty:00150298:ios.description:
Zole is a remittance app that makes it easy and cheap to send money to Nigeria. Sending money internationally can be done with a few keypad taps, and with your phone number. 
It’s QUICK, SECURE, and FREE.
SECURE MONEY TRANSFERS
Your data and funds are safe with Zole. Our app uses cutting-edge encryption to ensure you can securely manage your wallet and transfer money internationally anytime.
THE FASTEST WAY TO SEND MONEY TO NIGERIA 
Are you looking for a remittance app that works instantly? Zole lets you:
 • remit money internationally to Nigerian bank accounts.
 • Instantly transfer funds to friends and family.
 • Request money with just a few taps.
FREE MONEY TRANSFERS
No fees, no surprises. Send and receive money for free.
HOW IT WORKS
1. Download the Zole app from your Apple App Store.
2. Create an account in just a few steps.
3. Verify your identity
4. Make a transfer
SEND MONEY INSTANTLY
Zole makes it simple to send money internationally or pay a friend or employee. Request money or transfer funds quickly and hassle-free. Whether you’re supporting loved ones in Nigeria or paying your employees, Zole is your go-to app for secure, fast, and free money transfers.
**Zole App is a financial services platform, not a bank. Banking services and Cash Card are provided and issued by Zole App's banking partners, not Zole App LLC.

Experience crystal-clear magnification that brings everything from fine print on medicine bottles to the hidden patterns in nature into sharp focus.
A built-in flashlight helps illuminate objects in low light conditions, making close-up exploration effortless.
Activate the contrast boost feature to make text razor-sharp and textures pop, enhancing your viewing experience with just a tap.
Enjoy automatic focus that allows you to navigate close-ups without losing clarity, ensuring every detail is captured.

Integrated QR code scanner: Quickly scan codes without needing a separate app.
Document magnifier: Easily zoom into photos, PDFs, and documents stored on your device for a clearer view.
Night mode: Read comfortably in low light or in the dark, ideal for those late-night reading sessions or when you're exploring under the stars.
Why Magnifier is a Must-Have App:
Whether you're a student, professional, hobbyist, or simply curious about the world, Magnifier's versatility makes it the perfect tool for exploration and discovery.
Designed with a user-friendly interface, Magnifier is suitable for users of all ages and tech levels.
Our commitment to excellence means regular updates and new features to enhance your magnifying experience.
Download Magnifier now to:
Read the smallest text with absolute ease.
Inspect hidden details on coins, jewelry, or electronic components.
Get an up-close look at the wonders of nature, from delicate flowers to the intricate wings of insects.
Master the art of scanning QR codes with ease.
Impress everyone with your ability to see the world in greater detail.
Get Magnifier for iOS today and experience the world like never before. Your adventures in magnification are just a download away.

bluejetty:00183452:ios.name: Gopuff - Grocery Delivery
bluejetty:00183452:ios.summary: Thousands of items – delivered faster than you’d ever expect. Gopuff is your personal teleportation device, bringing you everything you need in as fast as 15 minutes. From groceries and alcohol to home care products and more, Gopuff has you
bluejetty:00183452:ios.description:
Thousands of items – delivered faster than you’d ever expect. Gopuff is your personal teleportation device, bringing you everything you need in as fast as 15 minutes. From groceries and alcohol to home care products and more, Gopuff has you covered. We cut out the middleman, so what you see on Gopuff is what you get. That means no substitutions, no markups, and no service fees.
Now with Go, our AI-powered shopping assistant, getting what you need is even faster. Go learns your preferences, builds your cart, and helps you reorder in seconds.
From early ‘til late, we’ll take care of your weekly groceries, daily meals, and even your midnight cravings. With many locations operating 24/7, you can order and get back to relaxing, no matter what time of day. Simply open the app, tap on what you want, and find it at your door in as fast as 15 minutes. Why so fast? Because of our strategically placed Micro Fulfillment Centers, we are able to complete your order within minutes of you placing it.
KEY FEATURES
- Lightning fast delivery
- AI-powered shopping with Go
- Real-time tracking
- Contactless delivery
- Flexible payment options
- Access to Insane Weekly Deals
SHOP SMARTER WITH GO
Go knows your life. The longer you use it, the more it learns. 
Your cart builds itself. Any ask, handled. From a budget dinner for four to a snack under 200 calories, just say it. 
One tap. Place the order. Done. No searching, no scrolling, no substitutions.
GROCERIES MADE EASY
- Unbeatable pricing on 300+ fresh grocery items
- Get high-quality meat and seafood delivered straight to your door
- Add your EBT card and shop SNAP-eligible products at unbeatable prices 
YOUR FAVORITE ITEMS
- Shop big-name brands and local favorites, without the markups
- Prepare for your next party – Cheese and charcuterie, paper towels, cleaning supplies, and more delivered in no time
- With over 500 micro-fulfillment centers, we’re able to deliver your favorite products in over 1000+ cities**
- Seamlessly check out with your preferred payment method – credit card, debit card, Apple Pay, Venmo, or SNAP EBT
JOIN THE FAM FOR EXTRA SAVINGS & FREE DELIVERY
- Gopuff FAM members get even “lower than low” prices on everyday essentials like $2 organic eggs, milk, paper towels, and more. FAM members save an average of $25 per month ($300/year)
- Discover Insane Weekly Deals of up to 60% off dropping every Monday, exclusively for members
- Gopuff FAM members pay $0 delivery fees on every order, any time of day
SHOP YOUR FAVORITE BRANDS
- Lay’s, Reese’s, Tito’s and more. Find local and well-known names all across Gopuff to order what you want
- Starbucks is now available 24/7 for select Philadelphia areas. Coffee lovers can now order their favorite lattes and specialty beverages on Gopuff
- BevMo! customers can enjoy unparalleled liquor and wine selection delivered in as fast as 15 minutes by Gopuff in California, Arizona and Washington
AWESOME CUSTOMER SERVICE
- We hope to deliver your order just right, but just in case it’s not exactly what you expected, you can always give our team a call
- Get what you need, how you expect it. We got you covered
FIND GOPUFF NEAR YOU
Gopuff has hundreds of micro-fulfillment centers, plus BevMo! and Liquor Barn Stores. We also serve 1,000+ cities. Find us in Los Angeles, San Francisco, New York City, Philadelphia, Chicago, Austin, San Diego, Houston, Seattle, Miami, and many more across the United States!**
Download Gopuff today, try Go, join the FAM, and get everything you need delivered to your doorstep – in as fast as 15 minutes.
* Beer, wine, liquor, and fresh groceries available in select markets. Must be 21 to purchase alcohol. Please drink responsibly.
** Gopuff is not available in all markets–but you never know. Want us where you are? Find us on social @gopuff or visit gopuff.com for more.

bluejetty:00154056:ios.description:
Defend, Strategize & Survive – The Ultimate Tower Defense Challenge! 
Prepare for an intense Tower Defense experience where survival depends on strategy! Team up with friends or go solo to battle endless waves of zombies, unlock powerful towers, and enhance them with exclusive skins. Will you be able to withstand the onslaught and defend your base?
 Game Features:
 Epic Tower Defense Battles – Stop relentless waves of undead enemies.
 Upgrade & Unlock Towers – Strengthen your defense with advanced towers.

 Tower Customization – Personalize towers with powerful skins and abilities.
 Strategic Gameplay – Plan your defenses and adapt to evolving zombie threats.
 Daily Rewards & Special Events – Earn exclusive bonuses and power-ups!

Build and place your towers strategically to block zombie attacks.
Upgrade and customize towers to boost their strength.
Defeat powerful bosses and survive increasingly difficult waves.
Earn rewards, unlock upgrades, and rise as the ultimate defender!
Can You Survive the Zombie Invasion?
With thrilling battles, deep strategy, and cooperative gameplay, this Tower Defense game delivers the ultimate survival experience. Set up your defenses, upgrade your towers, and fight back against the zombie horde!
 Download now and start your defense mission!

bluejetty:00180022:ios.summary:
Easily see how far from picture lock you are — and email that information to colleagues with one tap.
"Runtime is just flat out better than the old way." - InPoint
From sleazy reality shows to prestige Hollywood feature films, Runtime sim
bluejetty:00180022:ios.description:
Easily see how far from picture lock you are — and email that information to colleagues with one tap.
"Runtime is just flat out better than the old way." - InPoint
From sleazy reality shows to prestige Hollywood feature films, Runtime simplifies the workflow of editors everywhere. Throwing out the decades old "timecode calculator" model, Runtime does only the tasks post-production professionals need most – with none of the other cruft. Keep track of act times. Calculate what percentage each act is of the total. Figure total run time, total content time, and how far over or under time the project is. 
Runtime is an easy and fun way to keep track of your film, tv or radio project. 
• calculate Total Runtime or Total Content Time
• automatically figures how over or under time a project is
• visually see your timings with the bar graph
• email timings to co-workers with one tap
• support for multiple projects
• 23.98, 24, 25, 29.97, 30, 59.94 and 60 fps all supported
• the least annoying timecode entry you'll find in the App Store!
• timer for timing segments live on set
• a no-nonsense tool for professionals
Editors, producers, preditors, and post supervisors all over the world have embraced Runtime's simple solution to a complex problem.
PLEASE NOTE: Runtime was created for editors who add times together to get a total. Need timecode multiplication? Timecode division? Runtime isn't for you.

bluejetty:00046746:ios.description:
Welcome to the Fox Creek Golf Course
A Graham Cooke Design
Since opening its fairways to the world on July 1, 2005, Fox Creek Golf Club has been able to consistently impress and surprise. Whether it be the loyal member who benefits from the facilities on a daily basis or the golfing tourist visiting us for the first time, the reactions are the same. Golfers are amazed at the beauty and the high level of conditioning that course superintendant Pascal Richard and his crew are able to achieve. In its short history, Fox Creek has hosted Premiers, Prime Ministers, hockey legends and PGA stars with the Maritime hospitality the area is known for.
When Stephen Ames and Paul Casey compare the greens to some of the best they play on tour, people take notice!

bluejetty:00153133:android.description:
🚨 [Photo Recovery & File Restore] – 3 easy and fast steps to recover mistakenly deleted photos/videos/audios/contacts/contacts! 
Lost precious memories? Files vanished after a system crash? Deleted contacts? Photo Recovery & File Restore uses deep scanning to swiftly recover 500+ file types (photos: JPEG/PNG; videos: MP4/AVI/MOV; audio: MP3/WAV; documents: PDF/DOCX, etc.) from devices/SD cards, safeguarding your data!
🔍 All-Scenario Data Rescue Expert
✅ Multimedia Recovery: Restore media files lost due to accidental deletion, cache cleanup, or system updates with proprietary algorithms.
✅ Cross-Format Support: Covers 500+ formats—photos (RAW/HEIC/PNG), videos (MKV/FLV/MP4), audio (WAV/ACC/MP3), docs (PDF/XLSX/ZIP)—solving 99% of data loss scenarios.
✅ Contact Recovery: Restore deleted or backed-up contacts.
✅ Smart Preview System: Preview file thumbnails & basic info before recovery to ensure integrity.
✅ Zero-Learning-Curve Interface: 3-step process (select type → scan → recover), accessible to all ages.
⚙️ Core Technical Advantages
► Dual-Mode Scanning Engine: Quick Scan (10s for recent deletions) + Deep Scan (recover formatted/corrupted data).
► Zero Data Uploads: Local processing with AES-256 encryption for privacy.
► No Root Required: Non-intrusive operation, compatible with Android 7.0+.
🛡️ Transparent Permission Notice
Requires file access permission to locate fragmented data during scans.
⭐ Our Promise ⭐
➜ No collection of chat/contact data.
➜ No cloud-based user profiling.
➜ File access only for scanning.
➜ Permissions auto-revoked post-scan.
🚑 2-Step Emergency Protocol
1️⃣ Stop using device immediately – Prevent data overwriting.
2️⃣ Launch [Photo Recovery & File Restore] – Recover 500+ formats for free.
📥 Lightweight (28MB), download now! Supports 75 languages, including English, Hindi, French, German, Japanese, Korean, Chinese, and more!

bluejetty:00047030:ios.name: Albert
bluejetty:00047030:ios.summary:
Follow Albert through a whole day, from awakening to his trip in an air balloon, from the fun fair to a charming date with lovely Lili! 
Help Albert with 20 beautifully and artistically designed adventures. Each steps gives you stars, star
bluejetty:00047030:ios.description:
Follow Albert through a whole day, from awakening to his trip in an air balloon, from the fun fair to a charming date with lovely Lili! 
Help Albert with 20 beautifully and artistically designed adventures. Each steps gives you stars, starts give you access to the next steps. Easy and simple. Yet Albert will need all your dexterity and wit to help him complete 20 smart and fun levels. Blow a chewing-gum bubble with the microphone, throw the soap to the bathtub while tilting your device, use all your fingers to catch falling stars from the night sky, call the dog to catch a fish, etc. Kids love it, parents can't resist it! 
Stunningly made with a thousand hand-painted drawings by renowned french illustrator Chloé Mazio, Albert takes full advantage of the Retina display for a unique and totally novel visual experience. Moreover Albert uses a special holographic effect for extra graphic immersion. Tilt your device and enjoy Albert's cool 3D effect. At last Albert also explores all the fun capacities of your device (multi-touch screen, microphone, speaker, accelerometer, speedometer) for smarter and funnier gaming. 
• 20 unique paper-made adventures 
• 24 hidden treasures to be found 
• Original graphic design and sound design 
• Ready for kids and geeks :) 
• Accelerometre 
• Microphone 
• Multitouch 
• Game center 
• Multiple languages : French, German, Japanese, Italian, Spanish, English and Chinese. 
• 5 stars on the App Store
• Exclusively on iOS & tvOS
AVERAGE REVIEW SCORE FOR ALBERT = 4,73 / 5 (8828 reviews) 
"Incredible art style. Neat faux-3d effect. Great variety of mini-games." – Gamezebo 
"You'll be charmed by his strange and beautiful world." – Slide To Play 
Have fun !

- 최저가 추이 그래프로 기간별 가격 변동을 한 눈에 볼 수 있어요.
- 최저가 하락률로 평균가보다 하락한 상품을 콕 집어서 알려드려요.

- 쇼핑은 다양하게, 적립은 한곳에서! 쇼핑부터 이벤트, 미션 참여하고 e머니 무제한 적립 받으
bluejetty:00085946:ios.description:
■ 에누리 가격비교
1. 에누리 가격비교
- 에누리에서 국내 주요 쇼핑몰 상품을 최저가로 한 번에 비교하고 가장 합리적인 가격에 구매하세요.
- 최저가 추이 그래프로 기간별 가격 변동을 한 눈에 볼 수 있어요.
- 최저가 하락률로 평균가보다 하락한 상품을 콕 집어서 알려드려요. 
2. 똑똑한 쇼핑방법, 리워드 쇼핑혜택
- 쇼핑은 다양하게, 적립은 한곳에서! 쇼핑부터 이벤트, 미션 참여하고 e머니 무제한 적립 받으세요.
- 열심히 모은 e머니, 인기 브랜드의 e쿠폰으로 교환하고 일상에서 사용하세요. 
3. 소중한 내 몸을 위한 선택, 건강Plus
- 이제 건강기능식품도 에누리에서 가격비교하고 구매하세요.
- 함량, 섭취, 성분 정보부터 AI 요약리뷰까지! 나에게 꼭 맞는 제품을 구매할 수 있도록 도와드려요.
- 가격대비 함량을 한눈에 비교하고 최적의 건강기능식품을 간편하게 찾아보세요.
4. 쇼핑은 타이밍! 가격구독
- 관심 있는 상품을 구독하고 나만의 쇼핑리스트를 만들어보세요.
- 구매 타이밍을 놓치지 않도록! 원하는 최저가가 되면 실시간 알림을 보내드려요.
- 일시품절이거나 판매예정인 상품에도 알림을 신청해 보세요.
5. 에누리만의 특별한 혜택
- 에누리만의 특별한 이벤트와 기획전을 준비했어요.
- 어떤 제품을 구매해야 할지 고민이라면, 쇼핑가이드를 확인해 보세요.
■ 국내최초 가격비교 사이트
- '15, '17~'19 소비자가 뽑은 가장 신뢰하는 브랜드 대상 (4회 수상)
- '15~'19 모바일 어워드 코리아 가격비교 서비스 (5년 연속)
- '14 상품정확도 1위! 상품정보 일치율 100%
※ 앱 접근권한 안내
에누리 앱은 관련 법령(「개인정보 보호법」 등)에 따라 서비스 제공에 필요한 접근 권한에 대해 아래와 같이 안내드립니다.
[선택적 접근권한]
- 저장공간(사진/영상/파일) : 게시글 작성시 이미지 업로드/다운로드
- 알림 : 쇼핑 정보 및 소식, 댓글, 구독 알림 설정 시 알림
- 신체활동 : 에누리 만보기 서비스에서 걸음 수를 측정하기 위해 필요
- 선택적 접근 권한은 해당 기능을 사용할 때 허용이 필요하며, 비허용시에도 해당 기능 외 서비스 이용이 가능합니다.
- 휴대폰 "설정>애플리케이션관리>에누리가격비교>앱 권한"에서도 설정 변경 하실 수 있습니다.
- 운영체제를 업그레이드 시 기존 권한 동의 상태는 유지되며, 권한 재설정을 원하실 경우 앱을 삭제 후 재설치해 주세요.

bluejetty:00084315:ios.summary: Weight loss in 30 days provides a daily workout at home for all your body muscles to lose weight fast. By spending a few minutes a day, you can lose weight fast and lose belly fat without having to go to the gym. In this weight loss program
bluejetty:00084315:ios.description:
Weight loss in 30 days provides a daily workout at home for all your body muscles to lose weight fast. By spending a few minutes a day, you can lose weight fast and lose belly fat without having to go to the gym. In this weight loss program, no equipment is required or no fitness coach is needed, all exercises you can be done anywhere at any time.
The app is the best way to lose weight as it features workouts for all your body parts including arms workouts, leg workouts, chest workouts, core workouts, abs workouts, butt workouts as well as full body workouts. It includes all the workouts like plank, crunches, lunges, triceps dips, squats, sit-ups, push-ups, wall sits, jumping jacks, etc.
Your dream to get those six packs can be a reality by toning your muscles. The app's weight loss programs are designed by certified pro fitness coaches and have a scientific approach for exercise to lose weight starting from stretching for warm-up to HIIT weight loss training All home workouts are designed in a manner that you will be addicted to doing it for your weight lose and you will see a new you within a few weeks.
DIET PLAN FOR EFFECTIVE RESULTS
Along with the workout schedule, you can use the feature of 5 types of diet plans and delicious recipes designed by an expert dietitian for effective results.
- Vegetarians
- Vegans
- Mediterranean
- Atkins
- Ketogenic
FEATURES
- Lose it with HD video guides
- Fat Burning Workouts & Hiit Workouts
- Stretching and warmup sessions 
- Fully integrated with Apple Health
- Workout and water reminders
- Step counter
- Calorie and weight tracker
- Lifestyle tips
- 5 types of meal plans
- 6 levels of workout
- Track the progress.
- Fully integrated with the Health app
How it works:
Download the App
Select from 6 level workout based on your fitness stamina
Choose a diet plan
Start your 30-day weight loss challenge plan!
Privacy Policy and Terms of Service: https://www.loyal.app/privacy-policy

Topics: productivity, leadership, emotional intelligence, communication, charisma, investing, psychology, relationships, self-confidence, mindfulness, and more.
Be curious. Be consistent. BeFreed.

bluejetty:00099302:ios.name: Tripo AI: 3D Model Generator
bluejetty:00099302:ios.summary:
Turn a photo or a few words into a 3D model you can restyle, animate, and export.
Snap a photo, pick one from your library, or describe what you want. Tripo AI builds the model, then lets you change its look, try motions on it, and export
bluejetty:00099302:ios.description:
Turn a photo or a few words into a 3D model you can restyle, animate, and export.
Snap a photo, pick one from your library, or describe what you want. Tripo AI builds the model, then lets you change its look, try motions on it, and export the model for your game or animation project, all from your phone.
Made for game developers, animators, and anyone who wants 3D models without learning 3D software.
HOW IT WORKS
1. Take a photo, choose an image, or type an idea.
2. Tripo AI generates your 3D model. You can leave and come back; it keeps working.
3. Change its textures or give it a motion.
4. Export it and bring it into your project.
FROM PHOTO TO 3D MODEL
Take a photo with your camera or choose an image from your library, and Tripo AI turns it into a 3D model. Spin it, zoom in, or tilt your phone to look around it. Switch lighting and display modes to check every detail. Want to change the photo first? Describe the edit, and Tripo AI updates the image before building the model.
JUST DESCRIBE IT
Prefer words? Type what you have in mind, like "a red toy car with four wheels", and Tripo AI builds the model directly from your text, with no image step in between. Not sure where to begin? Start from a template.
MAKE YOUR CHARACTERS MOVE
Pick a motion from the preset library and see your character move in 3D. Try a few and keep the one that fits.
CHANGE ITS LOOK
Your model is a starting point. Apply a preset texture style or upload a reference image to change its look without starting over. Split your model into parts, then select, hide, merge, or remove them. Rebuild the mesh with quads or triangles and set the face count you need.
GET INSPIRED BY OTHER CREATORS
See what other creators are making. Open any model to view it in 3D and find ideas for your own. Save the ones you like to your favorites.
EXPORT IT FOR YOUR PROJECT
Export your model for your game, animation, or 3D workflow. Supports GLB and FBX. Animated characters export with the motion you picked. Save the file to your phone or send it to another app. With a subscription, choose triangles or quads and set the face count before you generate.
WHAT YOU CAN MAKE
Want to see yourself in 3D? Turn a selfie into a character, give it a motion, and spin it around on your phone.
Building an indie game? Get props, creatures, or characters to start from instead of a blank scene.
Working on an animation? Turn a character idea into a 3D model and try different motions on it, right on your phone.
Have a drawing or a piece of concept art? Take a photo of it and see your idea as a 3D model you can turn and inspect from every angle.
Have a product idea? Test it in 3D before spending hours in modeling software.
Want to hold it in your hands? Make a custom 3D model for 3D printing, a unique gift, or home décor.
Stuck for ideas? Browse the community, find something you like, and make your own version from a photo or a prompt.
GET STARTED
Create an account and start making 3D models for free. No purchase is required to try Tripo AI.
SUBSCRIPTIONS
Some features require a subscription. Subscriptions are optional, and plans, benefits, and prices are shown in the app before you buy. Payment is charged to your Apple Account. Subscriptions renew automatically unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel your subscription at any time in your App Store account settings.
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

Welcome to Me Inside: Horror Adventure! A gripping quest where every step could be your last. Are you ready to face your fears and uncover the dark secrets of Me Inside?
😱 Trapped in the unknown
You wake up in your apartment and launch a game on your phone - Me Inside. At first, everything seems fun and interesting. But suddenly you find yourself inside the game! Is it just a game or is there a sinister force at work in the game? Your only chance is to solve the puzzles, uncover the hidden truth and escape before you lose yourself completely.
🔥 What Awaits You in Me Inside?
✔ Engaging Storyline – A chilling tale with unexpected twists.
✔ Terrifying Atmosphere – Dark visuals, eerie sounds, and unsettling environments.
✔ Challenging Puzzles – Test your logic and observation skills.
✔ Mystical and Psychological Horror – Face fears that exist both outside and within.

💀 An Immersive Quest Experience
If you enjoy games with immersive storytelling, mysterious puzzles, and psychological tension, this game is for you. Every step leads to new challenges, every door hides a secret, and every decision brings you closer to the truth—or your doom.
👀 Who is Yandere Girl? What is Me Inside game?
The deeper you go into this nightmare, the more you realize—this place knows you. Your memories, your fears, your past. Nothing is random. Everything has meaning. Will you uncover the truth, or will you become part of the this game?
During the day, girl is kind and affectionate, but at night she turns into an yandere girl with a knife who will chase you around the room!
🚪 Can You Escape the Nightmare?
Trapped in a twisted reality, you must find a way out. But the more you explore, the more the walls of reality crumble. Can you trust your own mind?
🎮 Easy to Play, Hard to Escape!
🎮 Intuitive controls for smooth gameplay.
👁 Immersive first-person perspective.
😨 A horror experience that stays with you.
📥 Download now and test your courage!

bluejetty:00182562:ios.description:
Fun Anti-Stress Game
Sudoku (Soduko) Classic Puzzle is one of the classic mind-relieving number games that combine math games and observation training, distracting you from the stress of daily chores and heavy responsibilities. Relax and have fun!
Best Brain Games
Brain training is healthy for both kids and adults, keeping your mind strong and active. Sudoku (Soduko) Classic Puzzle is one of the most integrated brain games to train your brain and strengthen your logic skills, sharpen your memory, and boost reasoning & problem-solving abilities.
Proper Difficulty Levels for Anyone
For newcomers or advanced players, there are different difficulty levels to choose from: Easy, Medium, Hard & Expert. The easy start will not scare your interest away while the challenging difficulty level will keep you entertained even if you are so familiar with this classic sudoku free puzzles.
Auto-Checker & Highlight
Do you ever need to squint your eyes to find out the duplicate numbers in the traditional Sudoku games? No more! Sudoku (Soduko) Classic Puzzle comes with an auto-checker that will automatically highlight the duplicate numbers to ease your eyes! It will also highlight the repeated numbers in selected Cell, Row, Column & Box for easier gameplay.
Sudoku Free Games for iPad & iPhone
You can download and play Sudoku (Soduko) Classic Puzzle anywhere & anytime you want for free! One of the most addictive no WiFi games for iPad and iPhone users, no mobile data needed.
More Highlights that Set Us Apart
*Swift & smooth animation, no lags
*Does not take up much storage on your devices
*Large & easy-to-tap buttons
*Different color schemes to choose
*Larger Sudoku board to see better
Sudoku Number Puzzles Play Features
*Duplicate number checking
*Auto highlight of Cell/Row/Column/Box
*Undo as well as erasing
*Note down possible numbers & remove notes via a tap
*Hints to help you figure it out
*Pause, restart or reset the difficulty level anytime you want
*Statistics tracking
____________________
How to Play Sudoku Puzzle Game
1. Sudoku board is a grid of 81 cells (nine 3x3 subgrids).
2. Fill all the empty cells with numbers to win the game.
3. Each of the 9 subgrids must include all the numbers from 1 to 9.
4. Each number must not be repeated in a row/column/subgrid.
About Sudoku Number Puzzles
Sudoku is a number game originated in Switzerland, but the word "Sudoku" is actually a Japanese word due to its early popularity in Japan. "Sudoku" is made up of "Su" (means "number" in English) and "Doku" (means "single" in English). Sometimes, Sudoku may be misspelled as Suduko, Soduko, Sudoko, Suduku, Soduku, Sodoku, Sedoku, Seduko, Sudo, etc.

bluejetty:00077323:ios.description:
Are you ready for a new coding adventure? The fuzzFamily have landed on Bug World but some unwanted slimes came along with them! It’s up to you to use your object-oriented programming and javascript skills to help defeat the slimes in Bug World by Kodable!
Bug World, a new coding game from the award-winning team behind Kodable, is designed to help kids learn and level up their programming skills in a fun and engaging way. Use real code to build, upgrade, and deploy your own heroes to push back the slimes all while exploring the captivating levels of Bug World.
WHAT THEY LEARN
Bug World features age-appropriate games and activities to introduce and reinforce coding concepts that will have kids thinking like programmers and writing real code using Kodable’s built-for-kids coding interface. 
Coding skills learned through Bug World include:
Object-oriented programming
Javascript
Classes/Objects
Properties
Functions
Arrays
Inheritance
CODE YOUR DEFENSE
Use one of Bug World’s seven heroes, or your own creations, to set up your defenses against the incoming waves of slimes. Need an extra boost to take down a tricky slime? You can drag and drop one hero onto another similar hero to merge them into a super-defender using code to update their stats in real-time. Need more help? Place a rune on the field to use their special coding properties to slow down or defeat the slimes in a certain area. There’s no one right way to defeat the slimes, so use your creativity to help code your defenses on Bug World!
WHY CODE WITH BUG WORLD?
Kodable is trusted by more than 50% of US Elementary Schools because of our commitment to making computer science education accessible for everyone. Bug World is the next step in Kodable and your child’s coding journey by giving them a whole new world of possibilities to explore while developing object-oriented programming and javascript skills. In addition to programming concepts, kids also learn incredibly important ‘soft skills’ such as
Problem solving skills
Executive thinking skills
Creativity
Collaboration skills
Communication skills
Critical thinking skills
KODABLE PRO MEMBERSHIPS
Kodable PRO memberships offer access to all content across Kodable’s suite of learning apps. Use your same login across all Kodable apps to access PRO content.

bluejetty:00127880:ios.description:
Wake up and go to sleep to your favorite music, never sleep through your alarm again, get your own collection of exclusive designer clocks, know weather conditions in your area, cook or work out with a multifunctional timer, and light up the darkness with a powerful built-in flashlight!
FEATURES: 
* Choose from stylish designer themes for the clock: Digital (Blue, Green, Red, and Yellow), Ultrasonic (Blue, Green, Red, and Yellow), Wordy, ThinLine
* Create your own wake-up playlist with the best music 
* Background alarm support: alarm will ring even if the app is not running 
* Choose a way to stop the alarm: shake your device or solve a math problem
* Go to sleep to your favorite songs or white noise 
* Check live weather conditions and temperature 
* Change the screen brightness so that it doesn’t blind you after a good night’s sleep 
* Shake your device or double tap on the screen to switch on the flashlight 
* Convenient app settings. Get easy access to any option you need. 
Alarm Clock for Me provides the functionality of 6 indispensable apps in 1: 
ALARM 
- Wake up to your favorite music 
- Shake your device or solve a math problem to turn off the alarm
- Set multiple alarms with different tunes 
- Background alarm support: alarm will go off even if the app is not running! 
- Easy access to the nearest alarm from the main screen 
- Huge Snooze/Stop alarm buttons 
- Add your notes to the alarm! 
- Adjustable volume of Sounds/Music 
- Vibrate / Fade in / Snooze options 
- Shake-to-snooze when alarm goes off 
CLOCK 
- Exclusive designer clocks 
- Vertical and horizontal modes 
- 12 or 24 time format 
- Show/Hide seconds 
- Show/Hide day of the week 
- Auto-Lock when plugged in ON/OFF 
- Auto-Lock when on battery ON/OFF 
- Customizable auto-lock time 
SLEEP TIMER
- Use the shortcut on the main screen to go directly to the sleep timer settings 
- Create your own playlist with your favorite songs 
- Shuffle music ON/OFF 
- Adjust the volume of Music/Sounds 
- Go to sleep to white noise 
WEATHER 
- Check live weather conditions and temperature 
- Automatic detection of your current location and weather conditions display in your area 
- Weather conditions and temperature in any location you choose 
- Temperature unit: Fahrenheit/Celsius 
- Show Weather ON/OFF 
COUNTDOWN
- Never miss important events and special occasions. Count down to your vacation, anniversary, graduation and more
FLASHLIGHT
- Shake your device or double tap on the screen to switch on the flashlight
TIMER
- No matter whether you are cooking or working out, multifunctional timer will always be at hand!
Beautiful. Reliable. Versatile. Get the alarm clock that you've been looking for!
For complete access to all Alarm Clock for Me features, you will need to allow access to the following: 
*Notifications – otherwise, alarm will not ring;
*[OPTIONAL] Location data to provide you with the weather forecast for your exact location;
*[OPTIONAL] Media library so that you can set your own music as an alarm or a sleep timer sound;
*[OPTIONAL] Camera to activate a powerful built-in flashlight;
*[OPTIONAL] Photos to give you a possibility to set them as countdown pictures.

bluejetty:00183852:ios.description:
“Money Manager Expense & Budget ” is an optimized application for personal account management. 
Household account management is complicated. But we make it simple by simplifying the things that are complex. The default settings will get you started, and once you get used to it, you can alter the settings according to your needs with the highly flexible and customizable functions available. 
- Super easy and simple to enter data anytime, anywhere.
- View your spending tendencies graphically.
- View statistics by simply entering the data.
- Search and calculator functions.
- Set up sub-categories and main categories as necessary.
- Manage all your accounts at once.
- Use multiple currencies.
- Check weekly, monthly, and annual statistics.
- Use the calendar view.
- Use budget planning features to plan weekly, monthly, and annual budgets.
- Change the start date of the month.
※ Applying double entry bookkeeping
It facilitates efficient account management. Automatic double entry bookkeeping.
※ PC manager function
You can view ‘“Money Manager” application using Wi-Fi. You can edit and sort the data by date, category or account group on the screen of your PC. In addition, you can see fluctuations of your accounts indicated on graphs on your PC.
※ Budget management function
You can manage your budget. It shows your budget and expenditures on a graph so you can compare a number of your expenditures against your budget quickly.
※ Credit Card / Debit Card management function
When entering a future payment date, you can see the payment amount and outstanding balance on the accounts page. You can connect your debit card to your accounts so that expenses are automatically recorded under a specific account.
 ※ Passcode
You can specify the desired time lapse before the app requests a passcode.
※ Automatic money transfer and frequency functions
You can set up automatic money transfers between your accounts and configure the frequency of those transfers.
※ Sort expenses by the recipient
You can sort your expenses by the recipient and view this information graphically.
※ Payment Profiles
You can easily enter frequent expenditures by creating payment profiles.
※ Backup / Restore
You can backup and restore your data via email, iTunes and iCloud. 
※ Multiple currency support – you can have individual entries in multiple currencies, and configure each account to calculate the total balance in your desired currency.
In Full Version. (https://itunes.apple.com/app/id564730202?mt=8)
Manage from PC is available.
There are no Ads. 
There is no limit the accounts. 
(In the lite version, 10 accounts is available.)
Subscription pricing and terms:
Money Manager offers auto-renewing monthly subscription at US$2.49/month and an auto-renewing yearly subscription at US$19.99/year to provide you with unlimited access to the Money Manager Data Sync Service while you maintain an active subscription.
Payment will be charged to the credit card connected to your iTunes Account when you confirm the initial subscription purchase.
Subscriptions automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current subscription period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and the cost of the renewal will be identified. 
You may manage your subscription and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to your Account Settings after the purchase. 
Read more about our terms and conditions here:
https://realbyteapps.com/policy/terms.html
Privacy Policy:
https://realbyteapps.com/policy/privacy.html

It's time to tee off! Get your golf equipment ready, get to the course and challenge real players from around the world!
Get in the hole with the least number of shots and win your match, have fun with your friends with Golf Strike's fun & intuitive golf gameplay.
MANY DIFFERENT WAYS TO GOLF
• Play Golf: join 6 players matches against other players from around the world
• Duel: take part in 1v1 head to head single-hole matches

• Play with up to 5 of your Facebook friends in the same match

• Enjoy the variety of Golf courses from all around the world, rendered in high quality graphics
