bluejetty:00180053:ios.name: Code Land: Coding for Kids
bluejetty:00180053:ios.summary: Code Land is an educational app that teaches coding to children by playing games. With activities spanning skill and reading comprehension levels, children can learn basic skills such as science, programming, logic, problem solving, and mor
bluejetty:00180053:ios.description:
Code Land is an educational app that teaches coding to children by playing games. With activities spanning skill and reading comprehension levels, children can learn basic skills such as science, programming, logic, problem solving, and more.
Code Land is accessible to everyone! All of our games and activities are specially designed and adapted to fit the level and abilities of each child. From visual games where you don't even need to know how to read, to advanced programming multiplayer games, there’s something for everyone. All games are designed to be fun and educational. They are set in a variety of situations, such as setting up a factory or getting out of a maze, all designed to appeal to users.
Play and learn freely without pressure or stress. Think, act, observe, ask questions and find the answers with Code Land and the Learny Land suite of games.
FEATURES:
• Learn key coding concepts such as loops, sequences, actions, conditions, and events.
• Develop logical thinking and problem solving skills
• Hundreds of challenges spread across various worlds and themes.
• No downloadable content means it’s easy to play offline.
• Easy and intuitive scenarios, with child-friendly interfaces.
• Content for everyone with no limiting stereotypes.
• Content for 4 years old and up.
• Supports multiple users.
• No ads, no data collection.
• No written communication between players or with other people.
• No commitments or inconveniences; cancel at any time.
• New content added regularly.
SUBSCRIPTION:
• Download and try the app for free, without any commitment.
• The full, unlimited version works through a subscription model.
• Payment will be charged to your Apple ID account.
• The subscription is automatically renewed unless renewal is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
• Manage subscriptions and turn off auto-renewal through the users account settings after purchase.
• Any unused part of a free trial period, if offered, will be lost when the user purchases a subscription to this publication.
ABOUT LEARNY LAND:
At Learny Land, we love to play, and we believe that games must form part of the educational and growth stage of all children; because to play is to discover, explore, learn and have fun. Our educational games help children learn about the world around them and are designed with love. They are easy to use, beautiful and safe. Because boys and girls have always played to have fun and learn, the games we make - like the toys that last a lifetime - can be seen, played and heard.
At Learny Land we take advantage of the most innovative technologies and the most modern devices to take the experience of learning and playing a step further. We create toys that could not have existed when we were young. Read more about us at www.learnyland.com.
Privacy Policy: We take Privacy very seriously. We do not collect or share personal information about your children or allow any type of third party ads. To learn more, please read our privacy policy at www.learnyland.com.
Contact us: We'd love to know your opinion and your suggestions. Please, write to support@learnyland.com.
Terms of Use: http://learnyland.com/terms-of-service/

bluejetty:00063333:ios.name: Evolution Board Game
bluejetty:00063333:ios.summary: Evolution continues to evolve! New changes mean faster, fluid games and more content to explore. Adapt, survive, and thrive in a changing world enhanced by incredible art and thoughtful, balanced mechanics. Inspired by the award-winning
bluejetty:00063333:ios.description:
Evolution continues to evolve! New changes mean faster, fluid games and more content to explore. Adapt, survive, and thrive in a changing world enhanced by incredible art and thoughtful, balanced mechanics. Inspired by the award-winning board game with more than 3 million players, Evolution has arrived on iOS.
"#1 Digital Board Game of the year" -Ars Technica
"Best Mobile Strategy Game of the year" -Pocket Gamer
NATURAL SELECTION IN ACTION
In the game Evolution, you adapt your species to survive and stay one step ahead of opponents. 
-Watering hole running dry? Evolve a long neck to reach food in the trees. 
-Staring down a Carnivore? Develop a hard shell to fend off an attack. 
-Evolve up the food chain to become a the most successful species.
TRY BEFORE YOU BUY!
Unlike most board games, evolution lets you try the game for free first. Freeplay includes the tutorial, the easy and intermediate AI opponents, five campaign levels, and 1 multiplayer game a day. Pay a one-time cost to unlock unlimited functionality such as the Weekly Challenges, the Hard & Expert AI, Pass and Play, the full Campaign, Private Multiplayer Games and Asynchronous Games, and unlimited Matchmade Games. 
CHALLENGING AND ADDICTIVE
Do you evolve protection from Carnivores, or find a way to eat if there is no Food in the Watering Hole? The ecosystem is constantly changing, and you’ve got to figure out what your opponents are up to. 
INTERACTIVE TUTORIAL
Our friendly professor will guide you from one watering hole to the next on our learn-as-you-play tutorial, showing you how to survive in evolution before sending you off to make a name for yourself. Hone your skill as you progress from lowly Biology Intern to competing for the Nobel Prize!
EXPLORE THE CAMPAIGN
Explore the mysteries of Evolution Island and discover distinct Boss opponents. As you move through the campaign you’ll unlock new “Apex Species” that are masters of specific strategies; defeat them to add them to your menu of single-player opponents.
MATCH MADE MULTIPLAYER
One click and the game will match you with players of similar skill in a fast paced online game. Make friends in the game and set up custom games, or rank up in the ongoing seasonal tournaments and see how far you can go.
ENDLESS REPLAYS, ONE PRICE
This isn't a collectible card game, the full set of cards are included in the base game. Thousands of possible species combinations evolve from 17 unique trait cards, meaning no two games are ever the same.
PACE & POLISH
With a smooth user interface and fast, informative animations, Evolution was built to satisfy a quick fix of intense strategic battles. Easy to learn, almost impossible to master, one game and you’ll find yourself addicted. Evolution isn’t just a top tier strategy game – it’s a whole new animal.
"Best Digital Board Game of the year" -Vulture
"A powerhouse game poised to steal the thunder of some of the most popular games on the app store" -Touch Arcade

bluejetty:00066159:ios.description:
Welcome to My Home, a place that you can make your dream come true! Play this fun addictive match 3 game and make your dream home-design FOR FREE! From a condo to a mansion or even a villa, you can design and decorate everything on your device by your fingertips! 
Enjoy the game that fuses colorful matching puzzle levels with a home you restore, makeover and decorate. Many free styles and furniture combinations await you in-game! Don't forget to stop by your landlord or best friend's house to catch up and talk about your dream! Come and download to design your home for free now! 
Game features:
* House Design: Open-ended addictive puzzle gameplay. Various styles at your disposal! Makeover and restore your houses all by yourself!
* Exciting match 3 levels: Hundreds of challenging match-3 levels with many awesome boosters. More matching challenging means more fun!
* Personalized storyline: All stories focus on YOU! Follow along with the adventure while designing your dream homes!
* Vivid characters: Fun and unique characters! Your best friend, your sweet landlord and many more surprises! 
* Multiple houses: Not satisfied with designing and restoring only one house? We have plenty of houses for you to design and decorate!
Challenge the match 3 puzzle levels Now! Time to show your talent for home-design in-game! Take the reins and bring your dream house to life now for free!
Wanna get all the latest information? Join our worldwide community on:
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/MyHomeMyDreams
Need some help? Contact our support via in-game settings or send us an email at myhome@zentertain.net.

◆ Pixel Idle RPG Adventure Begins ◆
A mysterious rift has unleashed monsters across the world. 
Only you, the chosen Slayer, can travel through cursed lands, defeat evil, and restore balance. 
Enjoy a retro-style AFK RPG with thrilling auto battles, powerful gear builds, and global PvP competition!
◆ AFK Growth, Real-Time Action ◆
Even when you're not tapping, your Slayer keeps progressing. 
Perfect for those who love tap RPGs or AFK arena-style systems with real-time battle feedback. 
Let your build do the work while you manage tactics and upgrades.
◆ Epic Dungeons & Dragon Raids ◆
Travel through cursed forests, frozen peaks, and molten caverns. 
Slay elite bosses and challenge legendary dragon raids. 
Claim powerful loot and rare upgrade materials to empower your Slayer.

Upgrade your weapons and armor, and unlock devastating skills. 
Combine elemental abilities like fire, ice, and lightning to find the strongest combo. 
Customize your idle build to fit your play style.

Join or create a guild and work together to defeat massive guild bosses. 
Compete in real-time PvP arena battles and climb the global rankings. 
Earn exclusive rewards and become a legendary Slayer.
◆ Daily Quests & Limited-Time Events ◆
Take on daily quests, join seasonal events, and unlock new content constantly. 
Whether you're seeking cosmetic skins or stat boosts, there's always something to progress. 
Your Slayer’s journey never stops.
◆ Built for Idle RPG & Pixel Game Fans ◆
If you love AFK progression, tap-based gameplay, or pixel adventures with endless upgrade potential, 
this game delivers the ultimate idle RPG experience. 
Download now and become the legendary Slayer who ends the chaos!

bluejetty:00134407:ios.description:
The ParkChicago® team introduces ParkChicago®Map, the official on-street parking map app. ParkChicago®Map gives you access to over 36,000 competitively priced parking spaces and helps you find your ideal parking spot. Use the app’s interactive map and search features to find parking at the lowest prices in Chicago city limits so you can skip the garage fees and reservations. ParkChicago®Map is a free service which complements the ParkChicago® app, where you have the convenience of paying for parking (and extending time) with your phone.
Get Started Today:
 - Download the free ParkChicago®Map app
 - No sign up, no email, no commitments, No hassle
 - Search for and view parking with the interactive map – use the intuitive pinch-to-zoom feature to view details
 - Click on the metered spot to view hours of operation and availability
 - Get directions to the parking spot
 - Select ParkChicago® to pay for parking
The Perks of ParkChicago®Map:
 - Effortlessly find the most convenient and affordable parking spots in Chicago
 - Use the predictive availability feature to see when a parking spot will be available over the next week
 - View metered parking space information such as rates, limits and restrictions
 - Keep it all mobile! Pay for metered parking via the linked ParkChicago® app
Make your parking experience as convenient as possible - download ParkChicago®Map today!

bluejetty:00041838:ios.description:
Supplements AI – The Smart Supplement Tracker
Taking supplements is an investment in your health. But without the right plan, that investment can lose its impact. Supplements need to be taken at the right time, in the right combinations, and with the right schedule to truly work. That’s where Supplements AI comes in: the ultimate Supplement Tracker that helps you take control of your routine, optimize absorption, and make sure you’re really getting the benefits you expect.
Track your supplements with confidence
Supplements AI is not just a simple pill reminder. It’s a complete Supplement Tracker that adapts to your life. The app builds a personalized Supplement Schedule and helps you stay consistent every day. With smart features, you’ll always know:
• Timeline view: see exactly when to take each supplement during the day for optimal absorption.
• Supplement Reminder notifications: intelligent alerts that adjust to your daily rhythm so you never miss a dose.
• Vitamin Tracker: log your vitamins and minerals, and keep an organized view of your supplement stack.
• Daily log: record each intake to build long-term consistency and improve results.
Optimize your supplement schedule
Not all supplements should be taken together. Some nutrients boost each other’s effects, while others reduce absorption if combined. Supplements AI automatically analyzes your supplement stack and builds the best plan for you:
• Synergies maximized: pair supplements that work better together, like vitamin D and magnesium.
• Interferences avoided: prevent negative interactions between nutrients.
• Meal-aware planning: know which supplements should be taken with food and which are best on an empty stomach.
• Research-based dosage: get access to recommended dosage ranges backed by scientific studies.
Insights that go beyond tracking
Taking a supplement is one thing. Knowing if it truly works for you is another. With Supplements AI, you get more than a tracker – you get insights.
• Well-being tracking: log daily mood, energy, focus, sleep, and productivity.
• Correlation analysis: see how your supplements affect your performance and well-being over time.
• Personal feedback loop: understand if your routine is actually helping you reach your goals.
Detect your nutrient deficiencies
Sometimes the biggest challenge is knowing which supplements you actually need. Our Nutrient Checkup is based on the latest scientific studies and helps identify potential nutrient deficiencies based on your diet, lifestyle, and habits.
• Personalized recommendations for vitamins and minerals.
• Science-driven probability scores for deficiencies.
• A clear picture of which supplements are most likely to benefit you.
Always improving – Supplement Scanner coming soon
Choosing the right product on the shelf can be overwhelming. Soon, Supplements AI will launch a Supplement Scanner: simply scan a label or barcode to see product quality, dosage, and whether it fits your personalized plan. This feature will make Supplements AI not just a tracker, but your all-in-one supplement companion.
Why choose Supplements AI?
• Smart Supplement Tracker: structured schedules, not guesswork.
• Vitamin & Supplement Reminder: intelligent notifications to keep you consistent.
• Nutrient Deficiency Detection: know what your body may actually need.
• Supplement Insights: discover if your stack is really making a difference.
• Science-backed knowledge base: every supplement profile includes description, benefits, dosage, and risks.
Whether your goal is better focus, improved recovery, deeper sleep, or overall well-being, Supplements AI gives you the tools to make your supplements work for you.
Don’t waste your supplements. Make them count.
Download Supplements AI today and take control of your health with the most advanced Supplement Tracker on the App Store.

bluejetty:00178068:ios.name: MCAT Prep 2026
bluejetty:00178068:ios.summary:
MCAT Prep 2026 is an exam preparation application that will help you successfully pass The Medical College Admission Test (MCAT) developed and administered by AAMC with a high score on your first attempt.
MCAT Prep 2026 not only helps you
bluejetty:00178068:ios.description:
MCAT Prep 2026 is an exam preparation application that will help you successfully pass The Medical College Admission Test (MCAT) developed and administered by AAMC with a high score on your first attempt.
MCAT Prep 2026 not only helps you gain insight into concepts related to MCAT preparation, but also helps you increase your confidence in passing the test on your first attempt by practicing thousands of questions from similar tests.
When preparing for the MCAT exam, it is important to note that you need to prepare sufficient time for taking the exam. This is because you will need to complete the 230-question test in 6 hours and 15 minutes.
### Passing the exam in the first attempt ###
In MCAT Prep 2026, there are a large number of questions prepared by exam experts that cover the range of standardized exam requirements. Depending on the exam requirements, you will need to master 4 subjects, each containing multiple subdivision of content areas. You have the flexibility to choose which subjects you need to practice, depending on your situation.
Specifically, MCAT subjects include:
- Chemical and Physical Foundations of Biological Systems 2.
- Critical Analysis and Reasoning Skills
- Biological and Biochemical Foundations of Living Systems
- Psychological, Social, and Biological Foundations of Behavior
### Main features ###
- Over 1,000 practice questions, each including detailed answer explanations
- Specialized exercises by content area, with the flexibility to switch between them at any time
- View analysis of your current performance in the "Statistics" section
The most important part of passing the MCAT is to keep practicing and not lose confidence in the test. You will find that each time you practice on the MCAT Prep 2026, your knowledge of the exam increases, which increases your certainty of passing the exam.
Set aside a certain amount of time each day to practice some questions while hinting to yourself that you will do the same tomorrow. After you develop good study habits, you will find it easier to pass and score high on not only these MCATs, but any other exams that follow!
### Purchase, Subscriptions and Terms ###
You will need to purchase at least one subscription to unlock access to all features, content areas, and questions. Once purchased, the cost will be deducted directly from your Apple account. Subscriptions will automatically renew and be charged based on the rate and term selected for the subscription plan. If you need to cancel your subscription, please do so no later than 24 hours before the end of the current term or your account will be automatically charged for renewal.
You can manage your subscription by turning off auto-renewal in your account settings in Apple after purchase. If a free trial period is offered, any unused portion will be forfeited at the time you purchase your subscription (if applicable).
Terms of Service - http://mcat.yesmaster.pro/terms-of-service.html
Privacy Policy - http://mcat.yesmaster.pro/privacy-policy.html

bluejetty:00016648:ios.description:
WHAT IS LAST CLOUDIA?
A fantasy RPG that weaves a sprawling tale with quirky characters and cinematic effects. Its gorgeous, fast-paced battles feature pixel art characters sweeping though 3D playspaces. Download the game now!
CINEMATIC EFFECTS AND SWEEPING SOUNDTRACK
A riveting tale told with pixel-art characters and 3D backgrounds, brought to life with lovingly crafted music and animation!
WHITE-KNUCKLE COMBAT ACTION
Heart-pounding real-time combat action at a speed that's only possible with pixel art!
DEEP CHARACTER-BUILDING SYSTEM
Go beyond collecting strong characters—train your favorite characters to have the stats you want! It's all up to you!
HANDS-FREE AUTOPLAY
No need to grind manually—just gear up your team and send them out to collect power-up materials!
STAR-STUDDED CAST OF VOICE ACTORS
Famous Japanese voice actors provide dynamic voices for characters in battle, when powering up, on the Home screen, and more!
—STORY—
Welcome to Granzelia, where people live among magical beasts. 
Long ago this world was tyrannically ruled by the God of Ruin, until the hero Adel and goddess Lilaha joined forces to seal it away. In the centuries since then, that hero's bloodline built the Aldana Empire to peacefully rule all the land—but lately changes are afoot.
As reports of strange beast attacks surge, the 12th Order knight Kyle and the magical beast Rei set out on a mission. Neither knows it's the start of an epic battle that will shake the world!
You'll love Last Cloudia if you like...
• Playing any fantasy role playing game
• Games with classic pixel art, made just for game fans
• Anime or any RPG where you play though a legendary tale
• Any traditional JRPG (Japanese role-playing game) with intense battles and story development
• Action games where players mow through foes in 3D playspaces
SWORDS, SORCERY, AND SCINTILLATING COMBAT!
The RPG Last Cloudia has it all!

bluejetty:00146249:ios.name: Math Games for Kids: Grade 1-2
bluejetty:00146249:ios.summary: Embark on an exciting mathematical adventure with the launch of Dinosaur Math 2, the sequel to the highly acclaimed Dinosaur Math series! Designed as a fun and engaging math game for kids, this app takes your child through a vibrant journey
bluejetty:00146249:ios.description:
Embark on an exciting mathematical adventure with the launch of Dinosaur Math 2, the sequel to the highly acclaimed Dinosaur Math series! Designed as a fun and engaging math game for kids, this app takes your child through a vibrant journey of learning and discovery.
Enter the World of Math and Adventure
Dinosaur Math 2 is more than just a learning game; it's a gateway into a world where mathematics meets imagination. Kids can delve into the mysteries of numbers and math concepts through immersive mini-games and captivating storylines. This app is designed to cater to the learning needs of children, making it one of the best math games for kids available today.
Learn Numbers with Exciting Mini-Games
In this fascinating world, your child will learn vertical form addition and subtraction, essential building blocks in mathematics. These concepts are introduced through a series of interactive and engaging puzzle games. The little dinosaur, your child’s guide in the app, encounters various challenges, turning each math problem into a thrilling rescue mission.
Rescue Missions: Counting and Problem-Solving
Children will steer spaceships across diverse landscapes - from valleys to underwater realms - to rescue little monsters in trouble. bluejetty:00018138:ios.description:

• Clients with eligible devices can log in with Face ID
• View your account balance, activity, holdings and projected income
• Access your statements, trade confirmations and tax documents
• Update your profile information such as your home address, email address and phone number
• Link virtually all your external accounts and credit cards to monitor your activity for a more holistic financial view

• Set up account alerts and adjust your preferences
• Trade stocks and exchange-traded funds (ETFs)

• Configure multi-factor authentication settings to help protect access to your accounts

• Contact our Client Service Center at: 1-888-454-3965 (24 hours a day, 7 days a week) to speak directly with a Service Professional. If you are outside the United States, please call collect at: 1-801-617-9150.

• Authorize wires and transfers with one click

• Transfer funds between your Morgan Stanley accounts and other financial institutions
• Transfer assets from an external brokerage account into your Morgan Stanley brokerage account
• Pay your bills with Morgan Stanley’s Online Payments service

• Find the nearest Morgan Stanley branches

Magpie Beauty USA was started in 2018 and we are thrilled to be able to provide these products to nail techs in North America. We plan to be where you are - at nail only shows throughout the US.
To stay up to date with the latest products and education opportunities, follow us on social media! @MagpieBeautyUSA

bluejetty:00136763:ios.description:
NumMatch - Logic puzzle is the perfect relaxing number game. 
Immerse yourself in the world of math number games! Playing this game will let you relax, especially after a work day; solving a free puzzle every day will train your brain and maths skills. Become a match number master!
HOW TO PLAY:
- The goal is to clear all the numbers from the board.
- Find pairs of equal numbers (1 and 1, 7 and 7) or pairs that add up to 10 (6 and 4, 3 and 7) on the number grid.
- The pairs can be cleared vertically, horizontally, and even diagonally when there is no barrier between them and at the end of one line and the beginning of the next.
- When no matches are on the board, you can tap to add new numbers on the puzzle pages.
- If you get stuck in this logic game, Hints are available to help you progress 
- Try to clear the numbers on the board to achieve the highest score
DAILY CHALLENGE AND GIFT 
For extra fun, we have prepared something special for you. Play Nummatch Journey with 100 new block puzzle games every week for free! Each NumMatch puzzle has a different goal: collect gems and excellent awards!
Enjoy your daily achievements and unlock cool badges, which will cheer you up!
 FEATURE:
- Play easy with no pressure or time limit.
- Unlimited free Hints - Stuck? No worries, easily continue with one tap!
- Play every day and complete daily challenges or seasonal events to get unique trophies.
- Gorgeous visuals paired with delightful sound effects.
- Update hundreds of new puzzles every week
- Play anytime and anywhere. No WiFi connection is required!
NumMatch Logic Puzzle is the perfect way to test your problem-solving skills and train your brain. So what are you waiting for? Experience the addictive NumMatch today!
If you have any questions or concerns, please do not hesitate to contact us at support@matchgames.io

bluejetty:00039836:ios.summary:
Ferry travel made easy with Ferryhopper
Book ferries in Greece, Italy, Spain, Turkey, Croatia, and more countries with Ferryhopper, the leading ferries app trusted by millions. Compare companies, prices, and timetables, and book your fe
bluejetty:00039836:ios.description:
Ferry travel made easy with Ferryhopper
Book ferries in Greece, Italy, Spain, Turkey, Croatia, and more countries with Ferryhopper, the leading ferries app trusted by millions. Compare companies, prices, and timetables, and book your ferry tickets with no hidden fees.
Discover what you can do with the Ferryhopper App:
> Search and compare real-time ferry schedules for more than 500 destinations from over 160 ferry companies across 33 countries.
> Compare ferry prices and book ferry tickets at no extra cost, to travel with confidence.
> Make use of all available offers and discounts for both passengers and vehicles, and book the cheapest ferry tickets for your trip.
> Monitor the location of your ferry live with the ferry tracking feature. See the live position of the vessel on the map and check for any delays on the day you’re traveling. (Note: the Ferry Tracking feature is currently available for select ferry routes and will soon be released across more destinations.)
> Check in online, find your ferry tickets easily on your mobile phone, and have all your boarding details in one place.
> Book faster: save your details, frequent co-travelers, vehicles, and card information. Access your most recent ferry schedules searches, pick up right where you left off, and proceed with booking your tickets in a few taps!
> Organize your island-hopping trip in a single booking. Are you planning to explore Mykonos, Santorini and Crete in one go? Looking to island-hop from Menorca to Mallorca and then Ibiza in Spain? Or to visit Amalfi, Naples, Sardinia and Sicily in Italy? Book your island-hopping itinerary easily, with direct or indirect routes. Just pick your destinations, stops, and dates, and sail away!
> Share your trip details with your co-travelers easily through the app.
> Receive personalized recommendations and exclusive offers based on your favorite destinations.
> And remember, if an issue comes up, you can always contact our exceptional Customer Service team directly through the app!
Bonus:
Already using our ferry booking engine? See and manage your trip details in the app by retrieving bookings made on the Ferryhopper website.
More cool things about the Ferryhopper App:
> It’s available in English, Greek, Spanish, Italian, French, German, Portuguese, Polish, Bulgarian, Dutch, Croatian, Turkish, Swedish, Danish, and Albanian.
> It’s ad and spam-free.
> It’s free to download and use any time.
If you have any questions, ideas or feedback, you can contact us at support@ferryhopper.com and we will get back to you as soon as possible!

bluejetty:00166510:ios.description:
Block Joy is an addictive IQ puzzle game, with simple yet challenging puzzles designed to train your brain. Challenge your puzzle game skills with this exciting game that will give you fun and challenge for hours.
* Inspired by the treasure-hunting theme with wood, gold, and gems, Block Puzzle - Gems Adventure gives you an adventurous and classic puzzle-solving experience. * Train your brain and test your logical thinking with this simple game that lets you combine puzzle blocks, build and destroy structures by creating lines. Compete with friends around the world! Enjoy addicting brain training exercises with Block Puzzle - Gems Adventure
OUR FEATURES:
 Connect Shapes, No Matter Where You Are

Love puzzle games and looking for a game to play in your leisure time? Look no further, Block Puzzle - Gems Adventure is the perfect game you need!

bluejetty:00024482:ios.description:
Welcome to the magical fantasy world of My Unicorn 2 dress up game for girls! The world’s cutest rainbow unicorn is back with even more pet care and fun activities for girls and boys! awesome surprises, exciting mini games and more virtual pet care adventures!
If you like caring games for girls with cutest unicorns that you came to the right place!
You will have the chance to visit a land full of beauty adventures for girls and take a trip to the unicorn magical rainbow hair salon for girls, learn all about unicorn caring, how to love and give them the best attention in the world.
Fulfill every kid’s wish to have your own unicorn, Adopt a rainbow pony!
Take good care of the little pony: feed, bathe, go potty, dress up and play!
Express your creativity with your new pet pony! Dress up the unicorn in pretty dresses and fun costumes! Add accessories! Decorate the unicorn the way you like! 
My Unicorn is all about magical colors, cuteness and style!
Get creative with your own one-of-a-kind unicorn - dress up, makeup and hairstyle, wings, horn and tail, jewels and accessories, just pick your favorite and make it magical.
Care for your unicorn, wash it, dress it, choose its colors and style and make it your own cute pony.
My Unicorn 2 is brought to you by Pazu Games Ltd, the publisher of popular kids’ games like Girls Hair Salon, Girls Makeup Salon, Animal Doctor, and many more, which are trusted by millions of parents worldwide.
Pazu games designed especially for children under the age of 10. It offers fun and educational games for girls and boys to enjoy and experience.
We invite you to try out Pazu games for kids and toddlers for free and discover a wonderful brand for boys’ & girls’ games, with a large portfolio of educational and learning games for girls and boys. Our games offer a variety of game mechanics adapted to the kids’ age and capabilities.
Pazu games have no ads, so the kids have no distractions while playing, no accidental ad clicks, and no external interferences.
This game is included in the Pazu subscription which offers access to 50+ Pazu’s games with full game versions, no ads, a child-friendly interface, and up to 3 devices for each subscription.
Pazu games are trusted by millions of parents and loved by millions of kids worldwide.
Our games are designed especially for kids and offer fun educational experiences for girls and boys to enjoy.
With a variety of game mechanics adapted to different ages and capabilities, it is suitable for kids to be able to play on their own, without the support of adults.
For more information, visit our website: https://www.pazugames.com/

• See feeding times for future days
• Sunrise and Sunset times each day

• Automatic and accurate timezone conversion

• Easy swiping between screens
• Works well and looks good on iPhone and iPad
An indispensable tool for planning every hunting outing.

From the creators of Strange Case: The Alchemist and Strange Case 2: Asylum comes the next spine-tingling installment in the series: Strange C
bluejetty:00087150:ios.description:
Step Aboard the Ghost Train of Mystery! Solve the Enigma of the Haunted Rails in Strange Case 3!
From the creators of Strange Case: The Alchemist and Strange Case 2: Asylum comes the next spine-tingling installment in the series: Strange Case 3: Ghost Train. Prepare for a hair-raising journey filled with puzzles, danger, and spectral intrigue!
Continue Your Detective Adventure
The story picks up where Strange Case 2: Asylum left off, plunging you deeper into the chilling mysteries of a cursed ghost train. As a fearless detective, you'll follow the trail of the supernatural, uncovering the secrets of a locomotive haunted by tragedy and terror.
Mastermind Puzzles and Devious Riddles
Board the ghost train and face a series of mind-bending escape room challenges! Every train car is a new puzzle to crack, with hidden compartments, cryptic messages, and cursed relics waiting to be uncovered. Can you decipher the codes and solve the train’s eerie mysteries?
Explore the Haunting World of the Ghost Train
Step into a chilling atmosphere where ghostly passengers, spectral whispers, and haunting melodies set the tone for your investigation. Each clue brings you closer to unlocking the train’s tragic past and your own connection to its haunting.
Escape Before You’re Trapped Forever
The ghost train hurtles toward an ominous destination. Solve the puzzles, confront the phantoms, and find your way off the train before it’s too late. But beware—the train's mysteries are deeply intertwined with the sinister events of the asylum!
Why You’ll Love Strange Case 3: Ghost Train
- A seamless continuation of the Strange Case series with a chilling new twist.
- Thrilling escape room gameplay combined with ghostly suspense and supernatural intrigue.
- Detailed, immersive environments that bring the ghost train to life.
- Offline gameplay - perfect for haunting adventures anywhere, anytime.
- No hidden fees, no strings attached - just install, play, and escape!
Will You Solve the Mystery and Break the Curse of the Ghost Train?
Download Strange Case 3: Ghost Train now and uncover the secrets of the haunted rails. The clock is ticking, and the specters are waiting. Can you escape the ghost train before it claims you as its next passenger?

bluejetty:00127531:ios.name: Network Utility Pro
bluejetty:00127531:ios.summary:
Keep under control your network with Network Utility, an user friendly set of network tools that will help you to analyze your LAN, and not only that.
► NETWORK INFO
A complete and easy to understand report of your device's network interf
bluejetty:00127531:ios.description:
Keep under control your network with Network Utility, an user friendly set of network tools that will help you to analyze your LAN, and not only that.
► NETWORK INFO
A complete and easy to understand report of your device's network interfaces. In that tab you'll find information like the IP, IPv6, other addresses or the data usage statistics about your Wi-Fi, Internet or Cellular connection (if any).
► CELLULAR DATA MONITOR
Don't lose sight of your data usage, with four taps you'll have a data monitor configured and ready to use. 
The following data usage plans' period are supported:
- Daily
- Weekly
- Monthly
- 28 days
- 30 days
- 90 days
► LAN SCANNER
Analyze your Wi-Fi with the LAN Scanner tool. Discovering who is connected to your network and Ping it, is a matter of two taps.
Easily manage custom subnets to scan only a portion of your LAN.
► PING
Ping a LAN device, Ping a server, ping whatever you want. IPv6 addresses are supported too and advanced options like packet size, timeouts, intervals, etc.. are available and easily configurable.
The results of your Ping are available numerically in the aggregated stats, graphically in the real time graph or listed, a row per ICMP response received.
► GEO IP
Have you ever wondered where a server or any other IP is located? That's the tool for you, show the location on a map and get additional details like the ISP or the ASN in the details pane.
► DIG
A DNS lookup utility made simple. A list clearly shows the result of your query and the advanced options allow you to customize your request from the type of query to the DNS server.
► WHOIS
Find any information about a domain name and it's owner e.g. the status, creation date, registrant email and address and many more.
► NSLOOKUP
A no-frills textual DNS lookup utility.
► WIDGET *
Network Utility comes with an useful widget that brings network informations and the cellular data usage into your notification center, home screen e lock screen.
► EXPORT RESULTS ANYWHERE
Every utility has an export button that allows you to export the result of your task to the File app, to the Notes app and many other apps or simply copy the raw textual result.
► MAC APP
Network Utility is also available on the Mac App Store as Network Kit X, the same app but tuned to take advantage of macOS.
Start a tool on your iPhone/iPad a continue it on your Mac thanks to Handoff and Continuity.
!! N.B.
- Cellular data monitor is available only on iPhone or iPad with Cellular.
- Due to an operating system limitation, LAN Scanner can only show the MAC address of detected devices on iOS 27 and later. Hostname resolution is only available when the LAN gateway is used as the DNS server.
- Widgets are updated only at scheduled intervals (e.g. every 5 minutes), so they can show outdated info. Open the app to get info updated in real time.

bluejetty:00140072:ios.name: Shoot Out: Shooting Simulator
bluejetty:00140072:ios.summary: Embark on a thrilling mission in Shoot Out, a heart-pounding mobile shooter that combines tactical stealth with intense combat. As an elite military operative, your duty is to navigate through enemy territory, silently eliminating opponents
bluejetty:00140072:ios.description:
Embark on a thrilling mission in Shoot Out, a heart-pounding mobile shooter that combines tactical stealth with intense combat. As an elite military operative, your duty is to navigate through enemy territory, silently eliminating opponents with an arsenal of powerful weapons. Gear up and face the clash of mortal combat in this action-packed game that brings together the top elements of hero warfare and strategic shooting. 
Key Features:
1. Diverse Arsenal:
Choose your weapon wisely from a vast array, including iconic firearms like AKM, M4A4, KRISS VECTOR, SPAS12, SVD, and RPG. Each weapon is meticulously designed for the ultimate combat experience. 
2. Intense Levels:
Navigate through challenging levels, where your skills will be put to the test. Engage in a monster hunter clash with enemies who lurk in the shadows. Call upon your combat skills to emerge victorious in this mortal arena.
3. Military Hero:
Step into the boots of an American marksman, a true hero on a mission. Your skills will be the difference between victory and defeat as you engage in epic battles and execute precision shots.
4. Arena Breakout:
Immerse yourself in the thrill of the game with arena breakout action. The gameplay is dynamic, keeping you on the edge as you strategically move through the battlefield.
5. Realistic RPG Experience:
Experience the game as if you were part of a modern combat scenario. Engage in epic battles, reminiscent of popular war games, where every bullet counts.
6. Fun and Addictive:
Shoot Out - Silent Assassin combines the excitement of shooting games, the fun of arena breakout, and the thrill of hunting games. It's the perfect blend of entertainment and adrenaline.
7. Sniper Mastery:
Become a combat master with sniper rifles, utilizing your stealth and precision to eliminate targets from a distance. Engage in sniper 3-D action and showcase your skills as a sniper assassin.
8. Variety of Environments:
From city streets to wild landscapes, engage in hunting sniper missions and street fights. The game offers a diverse range of environments to keep the gameplay fresh and exciting.
9. Multiplayer Modes:
Challenge your friends or other players worldwide in various multiplayer modes. Compete in epic battles, proving your skills in a variety of combat scenarios.
10. Critical Ops and Strike Force:
Enter the world of critical ops and strike force missions, where every action is crucial. Execute critical strikes and become the ultimate force on the battlefield.
Gear up, aim, and fire now! Shoot Out is the ultimate shooting game that brings together the exciting elements of combat, stealth, and hero warfare. Immerse yourself in this action-packed adventure and become the silent assassin the world needs. Download now and experience the thrill of the perfect shot!

Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase.
Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours prior to the end of the current period.

bluejetty:00063130:ios.summary:
Challenge yourself with the most diabolical version of solitaire ever devised, a card game played by Winston Churchill during the Second World War. 
Begin your journey as a Cadet alongside a young Churchill in 1893 at the famed military co
bluejetty:00063130:ios.description:
Challenge yourself with the most diabolical version of solitaire ever devised, a card game played by Winston Churchill during the Second World War. 
Begin your journey as a Cadet alongside a young Churchill in 1893 at the famed military college of Sandhurst. Take on challenging missions and follow Churchill's career as you earn promotions and new military ranks or subscribe to the daily game, delivered straight to your app. With enough grit, you might just become Prime Minister. 
Featuring unique gameplay with two decks of cards and an added challenge of liberating cards contained in a row called the Devil’s Six, this addictive game will keep you coming back again and again. No game of solitaire will keep your mind as sharp or improve your concentration like Churchill Solitaire.
Challenge friends, family, and opponents worldwide to beat your solitaire score and time. With classic graphics and audio that pay homage to Sir Winston, his words, and his era, Churchill Solitaire will inspire, enlighten, and entertain.
Features:
- Three free trial deals of easy, medium and hard levels of difficulty.
- Cinematic video and audio of Winston Churchill.
- Social media integration allowing you to share and challenge your scores.
- Challenging gameplay.
- Badges and ranks from Sandhurst Cadet through Greatest Briton.
- Access to hundreds of numbered “Campaign” deals.
- Access to nearly infinite random deals.
- Access to a daily game delivered to the app.
- Challenge your friends and family.
- iCloud support - sync automatically with your iPhone and iPad.
Try the game for free. If you get hooked, as we’re confident you will, you can unlock more deals with in-app purchases (IAP) and totally randomized deals to frustrate and reward the most cunning solitaire player. 
Join us on Facebook at http://www.facebook.com/ChurchillSolitaire
Follow us on Twitter at @PlayChurchill
Terms of Use: http://churchillsolitaire.com/terms-of-use/
Privacy policy: https://www.churchillsolitaire.com/privacy-policy/

Whether you’re an experienced investor or new to the markets, we’ve designed this intuitive app with you in mind. 
New, quick-access buttons and a fully searchable help section have the answers you need — and the shortcuts to get you there fast.

• Keep on top of transactions with push notifications
• Protect your account and personal information with 2-step verification (2SV) 
We’ll be adding new features regularly.

Meet your new intelligent, all-in-one mobile AI helper! 
AI Mind is an easy-to-use mobile tool that provides intelligent and personalized responses to any of your queries.
With this single mobile app, you'll have quick access to a wealth of information on various topics and get help with any task you may have. Whether you need assistance crafting an impressive CV, writing a compelling blog post, finding a delicious recipe, or looking for a book recommendation, this app has got you covered.
It's like having an AI Assistant in your pocket, always ready to help with a friendly chat interface!
ADVANCED AI FEATURES:
- Human-like and friendly chatbot
- AI suggestions based on your queries
- Conversation History
- Voice input
- Convenient sharing and copy-paste options
- Creates all types of content
- Recognizes text from images
- Intuitive and easy-to-use
- High speed and accuracy
What sets this app apart is its human-like chat experience. It's not just a bot, but AI friend with unique superpowers that's always open to talk and help with advice. It offers suggested queries on your topic, extracts text from your photos, and even recognizes your voice requests!
PERFECT FOR:
- Work: helps with job-related tasks such as CV building and crafting business letters;
- Studies: assists in learning, including essay writing, grammar checks, and exam preparation;
- Content creation: provides inspiration and fresh ideas for blog posts, highlights, captions, and more;
- House and family: offers help with recipes, 'how-to' guides, and activities for kids;
- Fitness and health: gives information and advice related to a healthy lifestyle, mental wellbeing, and fitness;
- Entertainment: suggests movies, books, and fun activities based on your preferences;
- Traveling: helps with planning your trip and provides recommendations for local restaurants, shops, or attractions;
- Friendly chat companion: offers a human-like chat experience, always ready to help with any question!
This app is perfect for anyone who values efficiency, creativity, and innovation. It offers a seamless, intuitive user experience, making it easy for you to get the information you need when you need it. Whether you're a student, a professional, a content creator, a parent, a fitness enthusiast, a movie buff, or a traveler, this mobile AI Chat is designed to assist and inspire you.
Discover the power of the cutting-edge technology, experience a new way of finding information and generating ideas with AI chatbot – the app that truly aids your lifestyle!

- รับชมบนจอใหญ่ ด้วยการแคสต์จากมือถือขึ้นทีวี

bluejetty:00126714:ios.description:
Take control of your health data — export, analyze, and back it up securely.
Export 150+ health and fitness metrics from iPhone in CSV, JSON, Markdown, or GPX format. Perfect for data backup, personal insights, or analysis using AI tools via the integrated MCP Server. 
Automate exports. Select any of the integrated integrations:
• iCloud Drive
• Google Drive
• Dropbox
• REST API
• Home Assistant
• MQTT
• iOS Calendar
• Email
You can also use Sync to Mac or create your own dashboards (macOS app install required)
HIGHLIGHTS:
Health Auto Export supports several metrics and data types categorized into:
* Health Metrics (steps, heart rate, sleep phases, blood pressure, etc.)
* Workouts + Routes (running, cycling, swimming, hiking, etc.)
* Medications
* State of Mind
* Symptoms
* Menstrual Cycle Tracking
* ECG
* Heart Rate Notifications
Automations & Integrations:
* Built-in MCP Server. Query health data directly over the network 
* Export to iCloud Drive, Google Drive, Dropbox
* Send data to REST APIs, MQTT, Home Assistant
* Automate email reports to yourself or a care provider
* Log data as events in Calendar
* Automate actions with Shortcuts
* Build your own applications and integrations that leverage health data
Health data on desktop:
* Sync data to Health Auto Export macOS app
* View charts and statistics with the configurable dashboard
* Or use the open-source web app (GitHub) to create your own database and dashboards on macOS/Windows/Linux
Health data widgets:
* Add health widgets to your Home Screen on iPhone, iPad, and Mac
* Track your progress at a glance
PRIVACY:
* 100% private and secure — no account required, third-party sharing.
* No data collection, no sharing of your information
* You remain in control of your health data
PRICING:
Health Auto Export contains in-app purchases. Try all Premium features for seven days, then choose from Free, Basic, and Premium tiers:
FREE:
* Add health data widgets to your Home Screen.
* View charts with the statistics dashboard.
BASIC (one-time purchase):
* Use Manual Export to export health data whenever you need it.
* Create simple automations with Shortcuts.
* Export individual metrics with greater detail, such as Sleep Phases, ECG, heart rate notifications, or Blood Glucose metadata.
* Control data aggregation (seconds → yearly).
* Export workouts with routes, heart rate, heart rate recovery, and other metadata.
PREMIUM (subscription or lifetime purchase):
* Get on with the rest of your day while Health Auto Export syncs your health data in the background. 
* Automatically export data to your own or any of the integrated platforms. 
* Sync to Mac makes your health metrics and workouts available on Mac by syncing from iPhone.
* Includes all Basic features.
SUPPORTED DATA:
- See the full app overview and list of supported data at https://healthyapps.dev
Terms of Use can be viewed at https://healthyapps.dev/terms
Privacy Policy: https://healthyapps.dev/privacy-policy

bluejetty:00073005:ios.description:
Block World 3D is a sandbox game with crafting and building, where you can explore, craft, survive, build and more with other players.
CRAFTING
This is a block craft game and you are the best craftsman. You may create many items and blocks from crafting recipes. Build a city and have a school party craft there.
BUILDING
This is a building game in sandbox mode. Build your house or build your world. In creative mode, you can build any buildings and structures. The game has a built-in editor for creating constructions.
SURVIVAL
This is a survival game, you will need to find food when you are hungry and water when you are thirsty, you will be constantly in a state of survival.
CREATIVE
Unlimited creativity, build, destroy and build again. Infinite items and blocks. Invulnerability and flight. And all this is free. All in One - Creative and Destruction.
EXPLORATION
Explore the endless world of blocks alone or with friends, or even craft your own world for other users to see.
ADVENTURE
This is an adventure, in this mode you can not destroy and create, but you can interact with players, mobs and other characters.
MULTIPLAYER
You can play with your friends in multiplayer in the most popular construcion games through our servers for free and for as long as you like.
GAME MODES
Choose any mode and set all parameters for any map. Survival, building, adventure, battle, maybe we will add new modes soon.
MARKET
On the market, you can buy or get a lot of add-ons, maps, textures, worlds and much more for free.
CUSTOMIZATION
Create your character, many skins for girls and boys. In the game you will find a skin editor, customize your character! Choose any appearance and clothes.
ITEMS AND BLOCKS
Items - weapons, armor, clothes, tools, resources, ingots, stones, food, potions, dyes, plants and more.
Blocks - natural, building, decorative, interactive.
All this can be found or created in the world.
FREEDOM
This is an simulator open world box. The game does not have a main plot or any goals. You can choose what you need to do. You can go explore the world or build your own.
Join and play together with millions of players from all over the world!

bluejetty:00150813:ios.description:
HVSB is your personal financial advocate that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other banks and credit unions, into a single view. It’s fast, secure and makes life easier by empowering you with the tools you need to manage your finances.
Here’s what else you can do with HVSB:
- Keep your transactions organized by allowing you to add tags, notes and photos of receipts and checks.
- Set up alerts so you know when your balance drops below a certain amount
- Make payments, whether you’re paying a company or a friend
- Transfer money between your accounts
- Deposit checks in a snap by taking a picture of the front and back
- View and save your monthly statements
- Find branches and ATMs near you
Secure your account with a 4-digit passcode and fingerprint or face reader on supported devices. 
To use the HVSB app, you must be enrolled as a Huron Valley State Bank digital banking user. If you currently use our Internet Banking, simply download the app, launch it, and login with the same Internet Banking credentials.

bluejetty:00138050:ios.name: Guild of Guardians
bluejetty:00138050:ios.summary:
Lead Your Guild. Summon Guardians. Conquer Dungeons.
Guild of Guardians is a fantasy idle RPG that combines strategic gacha gameplay with competitive dungeon crawling. Build your dream squad of legendary Guardians and fight through hordes
bluejetty:00138050:ios.description:
Lead Your Guild. Summon Guardians. Conquer Dungeons.
Guild of Guardians is a fantasy idle RPG that combines strategic gacha gameplay with competitive dungeon crawling. Build your dream squad of legendary Guardians and fight through hordes of enemies in your quest to save Elderym. Every decision, upgrade, and victory matters in a world on the brink of darkness. Will you rise to the challenge and become the hero Elderym needs?
Save Elderym – A Realm in Peril
Once a thriving land, Elderym has been engulfed by the shadow of the Dread. Explore cursed ruins, brave treacherous dungeons, and vanquish the darkness threatening the realm. The fate of this fantasy world is in your hands – only the boldest Guardians can banish the Dread and restore light to the world.
Summon & Collect Your Ultimate Squad
- Unique Guardians: Summon and collect a vast roster of Guardians, from rare, epic and legendary rarities. Each Guardians belongs to a rarity and Domain (element) that can turn the tide of battle.
- Build Synergistic Teams: Guardians come in diverse roles – stalwart Tanks, swift Rangers, mystical Mages, devoted Healers, and more. Balance your squad wisely to unleash powerful team synergies. Plan formations and combos that give you the edge in every fight.
- Upgrade & Ascend: Level up your heroes and ascend them to unlock game-changing abilities. Equip your team with enchanted gear to strengthen their stats and evolve them into unstoppable forces.
Conquer Challenging Dungeons
- Climb the Leaderboards: Test your squad in the Arena and battles against other players. Outsmart opponents with your superior team composition and strategy. Rise through the ranks from rookie to legend, and seize your spot at the top of the global leaderboards.
- Thrilling Events: Participate in special events held regularly. From time-limited dungeon events to themed challenges, there’s always a new way to earn rewards and showcase your skills. Compete for glory and exclusive prizes in seasonal events – will you top the charts?
- Join Guilds – Unite & Conquer: Team up with players around the world by joining a Guild. Coordinate strategies with your guildmates and take on formidable guild bosses. Share tips, trade resources, and help each other grow. Dominate the battlefield as a united guild and reap exclusive guild rewards. In Guild of Guardians, no Guardian fights alone!
Play and Own Your Progress
- True Ownership: Experience the next evolution of mobile RPGs with optional Web3 integration and NFT support. Every hero and item you earn can be yours forever. Own your in-game assets – your Guardians, gear, and skins are unique NFTs stored securely, giving you true control over your collection.
- Play-to-Collect Fun: Even if you’re not familiar with NFTs, Guild of Guardians is fully enjoyable as a deep, free-to-play RPG. Web3 features are smoothly integrated in the background, enhancing the game without complicating it. Dive in and play your way; ownership is an added bonus to an already thrilling adventure.
Support
Encountered any issues? We're here to help; Your adventure is our priority!
Contact us at our email: support@guildofguardians.com
Join the Community
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/guildofguardians
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/guildofguardiansofficial
Twitter/X: https://twitter.com/GuildOfGuardian
Discord: https://discord.com/invite/gog
YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@guildofguardiansofficial
Legals
Privacy Policy: https://www.immutable.com/legal/privacy-policy
Terms of Use: https://www.guildofguardians.com/legals/terms-conditions

bluejetty:00144591:ios.summary: Bike registrada é o aplicativo essencial para todos os amantes de bicicletas, projetado para oferecer uma experiência completa e segura no mundo do ciclismo. Com recursos intuitivos e uma interface amigável, nossa plataforma torna mais fáci
bluejetty:00144591:ios.description:
Bike registrada é o aplicativo essencial para todos os amantes de bicicletas, projetado para oferecer uma experiência completa e segura no mundo do ciclismo. Com recursos intuitivos e uma interface amigável, nossa plataforma torna mais fácil gerenciar suas bicicletas, adquirir seguros para proteção, vincular selos exclusivos e muito mais. Seja você um ciclista casual ou um entusiasta dedicado, o Bike registrada está aqui para simplificar sua jornada de ciclismo.
Recursos-chave:
1. Registro de bicicletas: Armazene detalhes importantes sobre suas bicicletas em um único local. Inclua informações como marca, modelo, número de série e fotos para ajudar a identificar suas preciosas máquinas.
2. Consulta de bicicletas: Acesse rapidamente todos os detalhes de suas bicicletas registradas, proporcionando maior comodidade ao planejar suas aventuras ciclísticas.
3. Seguro para bicicletas: Proteja suas bicicletas contra roubos, acidentes e danos. Descubra opções de seguro adequadas às suas necessidades e garanta maior tranquilidade em suas pedaladas.
4. Vincular/Desvincular Selo: Cada selo é um adesivo que pode ser colocado em sua bicicleta e possui um QR Code único. Esse QR Code, quando consultado, permite que você receba notificações da localização da bicicleta caso ela seja roubada, facilitando a recuperação.
Nosso compromisso é oferecer a melhor experiência possível para a comunidade de ciclistas. Estamos sempre atualizando e aprimorando o Bike registrada com base no feedback de nossos usuários para garantir que nossas funcionalidades atendam às suas expectativas.
Faça parte da comunidade Bike registrada e leve suas aventuras de bicicleta para o próximo nível. Baixe agora e comece a explorar um mundo de possibilidades sobre duas rodas.
Observação: Algumas funcionalidades podem exigir uma conexão à internet e a disponibilidade de serviços pode variar de acordo com a localização geográfica.

bluejetty:00120722:ios.description:
An app for choral singers who don't read music well.
Snap a photo or import JPG, PNG or PDF.
Touch notes in the image to hear the pitch.
Not for instrumental parts - see details below.
Whether you sing in a choir, or a barbershop quartet, or other vocal group, What's My Note lets you hear and learn the pitches in your sheet music. You can repeat single notes or intervals as many times as you like.
Use What's My Note? to read published choral music - the kind used by high school choruses, church choirs, musical theater, and barbershop quartets. If you are not sure that What's My Note? will read your music, e-mail us a photo, and we'll let you know.
For a demo, please view the video on our website.
(What's My Note DOES NOT play scores from start to finish, does not play more than one voice at a time, does not interpret rhythms, does not recognize or play piano or instrumental parts. Hand-written manuscripts and most forms of popular music probably won't work.)
You can import PDFs and JPEGs, and use What's My Note's OCR feature on any device. To photograph music, What's My Note? requires an 8 megapixel camera, available on these models (or later): iPhone 4s, iPod Touch 6th Generation, iPad Pro, iPad Air 2, iPad Mini 4.

bluejetty:00062870:ios.description:
Enjoy a step by step horse training checklist that includes the very basics of leading your horse through all of the groundwork and progresses to ridden exercises. The process outlined in this app will create a foundation for any horse whether fully trained or barely handled. After completing the exercises in this app, you should be able to continue to train your horse for whatever discipline or activity that you wish to.
If you’ve ever felt like you and your horse just aren’t quite on the same page or maybe you’ve doubted whether you’re really the right person to train your own horse. Here’s the truth—we know you are. No one knows your horse better than you, and with the right guidance, you can build the trusting, connected partnership you’ve always wanted.
That’s exactly why Warwick Schiller’s Online Video Library exists. With easy-to-follow, down-to-earth videos, Warwick breaks things down in a way that makes sense—no confusing jargon, no pressure, just clear, practical steps that help you and your horse feel more confident.
You'll learn how to truly understand your horse, work through challenges with patience and kindness, and create a calmer, more enjoyable relationship—at your own pace, in a way that works for you.
Because you are the best person for your horse. And we’re here to help you believe it.
Warwick Schiller’s App Features:
- Stream over 900 videos
- Add Favorites
- Monthly Archives
- History "Watched videos" 
- Training Checklist where you can add horses and keep track of their progress.
- Ability to download videos for offline use.
- Videos are in order of the successful process.
Over 900 Videos available addressing every horse problem you can encounter and how to fix them, how to start a horse, foal handling through to high level movements needed for any discipline.

bluejetty:00066041:ios.summary:

Your activities, such as walking, runni
bluejetty:00066041:ios.description:
Hops is a gamified activity tracker. It motivates you to be more active every day.
The spirits of trees called Hops live in the forest. And your everyday activities in the real world help them grow!
Your activities, such as walking, running, exercising or climbing stairs, will be used as energy for exploring new areas and crafting materials for items. And you can collect Hops Friends by achieving missions!
Be more active every day with Hops!
------------------------------
◎ FEATURES
- Explore the beautiful forests with cute Hops
- Get traveling energy by achieving daily goals
- Get crafting materials from your steps
- Change outfits and get cool effects
- Collect Friends by completing missions
- Glanceable recent activities and stats
- Measure Walking workouts
------------------------------
◎ APPLE WATCH APP FEATURES
(Requires watchOS 6 or later)
- Stats for Today and Yesterday
You can see your stats for Activity, Steps, Floors (Flights Climbed), Distance, Workouts(minutes) instantly.
- Measure Walking Workouts
While measuring walking, Steps and Floors (Flights Climbed) will also be displayed in real time.
------------------------------
◎ DAILY GOALS
You will earn Energy by achieving the Daily Goals. And if you accomplish every daily goal, you'll get an extra bonus Energy!
You can choose 3 activities from the following:
- Activity Rings (Apple Watch required)
- Steps
- Floors (Flights Climbed)
- Workouts (minutes)
- Distance
- Stand (based on Steps)
------------------------------
◎ 500 STEPS = 1 MATERIAL
One crafting material appears every 500 steps. The app will display a maximum of 20 materials simultaneously.
Let's walk a lot and get more materials!
------------------------------
◎ MISSIONS
Missions are the challenging activity goals with a limited time period from 1 hour to 24 hours. By succeeding it, you will get Hops Friends!
------------------------------
◎ ABOUT ACTIVITY DATA
This app integrates with Apple's Health app and reads/writes activity data from it.
On iPhone, the Walking workout is measured using Core Motion, and Hops app writes the result in the Health app.
The Health data is saved only in your devices. It will never be sent to anywhere by the app without your permission.

bluejetty:00140730:ios.description:
Welcome to this engaging and satisfying nuts and bolts color sort game! It is the ultimate puzzle game where fun meets relaxation! With mysterious nuts that keep you guessing, and surprise special levels that pop up when you least expect them, every round is packed with fun and excitement. Plus, with a variety of cool themes, there's always something new to explore.
It's not just about the challenge, it's about the chill. Enjoy unlimited shuffles, skip levels at your leisure, and take all the time you need. No rush, no pressure, just pure sorting bliss.
And when it comes to satisfaction, we've got you covered. With powerful bolt tools, a generous reward system, and over ten thousand levels, this game is guaranteed to keep you hooked. Whether you're a color-match newbie or a sort-it master, Nuts Sort is your ticket to endless sorting fun! 
How to Play Nuts Sort Puzzles?
- Tap a bolt to pick up a nut, then tap another bolt to place it.
- You can only stack nuts of the same color together, and only if there's enough space on the bolt.
- Your mission is to organize all the nuts by color on their own bolts to finish the level.
- Use "Undo" to backtrack your moves, or "Shuffle" if you're unsure what to do next.
- Stuck? Add an "Extra Bolt" to help you out.
- Feel free to skip levels whenever you want and keep mastering the nuts and bolts sort puzzle!
What Makes This Game Stand Out?
- Diverse Themes: 
Explore a wide range of themes that make each color sort game feel fresh and exciting.
- Over 10,000 Levels: 
Challenge yourself with over ten thousand levels in this nuts and bolts color sort game. 
- Mysterious Nuts: 
Face the thrill of unknown colors with our question mark nuts. 
- Special Levels: 
Encounter special levels that add a twist to your sorting adventure. 
- Unlimited Replays: 
Replay levels as often as you like in this sort-it game. 
- Extra Bolts and Undo Tools: 
Use extra bolts and undo tools to make every move count.
- Level Skipping: 
Skip levels at any time and keep your sorting journey smooth. No need to get stuck - just sort it your way!
- No Time Limits: 
Enjoy the freedom of no time limits in this color sort puzzle. Play at your own pace and master every level!
- Generous Rewards: 
Earn generous rewards as you master each level. The more you play, the more you win in this color sort game!
Nuts Sort brings endless fun with its unique twist on the classic color sort game. With thousands of levels, mysterious nuts, and surprise challenges, you'll master every aspect of this nuts and bolts color sort puzzle!
Whether you're here to relax or aiming to become a sort-it master, Nuts Sort offers unlimited replays, extra bolts, no time limits, and generous rewards. Jump in and experience the ultimate nuts and bolts color sort game today!

bluejetty:00069094:ios.description:
Classic Bike helps you find, buy and get the most from your classic motorcycle. With our expert buying guides, bikes for sale listings and auction news, Classic Bike is your one-stop shop for finding your dream classic motorcycle. 
Our spannering supremo Rick Parkington helps you keep you bike in tip top condition with the nitty gritty of motorcycle repair and maintenance, featuring detailed help on all manner of workshop jobs arming you with all the knowledge you need, whatever the jobm, from quick fixes to full-scale restorations.   
We’ll also help you get out and enjoy your classic bike with our coverage of the greatest events that bond our classic motorcycling community including shows, events, racing and meet-ups.  
Get your fix of nostalgia and relive the glamour of the golden age of motorcycling with our classic racing stories and interviews with legends from motorcycle racing’s heroic past.  
Your next pride and joy 
Our comprehensive buying guides help you decide on and choose the perfect classic for you. With tips on what to look out for, what to pay and how to bag a deal, you’ll be armed with all the information you need to find your dream machine.  
The glamour 
We celebrate the golden age of motorcycle racing with beautiful photography, interesting interviews and insight into the era that made us fall in love with classic motorcycles. 
The nitty gritty 
Rick’s Fixes from spannering supremo Rick Parkington gets down and dirty in the workshop or garage to give you the expert help you need when repairing, maintaining or restoring your classic motorcycle. Featuring clear easy-to-follow step-by-step instructions means you’ll have your classic bike back on the road in no time.  
The heartland 
We cover the greatest events that bond our classics community, with meet-ups, club events, historic racing and shows. Get closer to the stars of motorcycle racing with a different take on the biggest stories in the world of motorcycle racing. We get the inside line from racers, engineers, team owners and race series directors on the races, the results, team news and future of this thrilling sport.

bluejetty:00040034:ios.description:
Have you ever wondered what happens when you go back to a primitive society? 
Tens of million years ago, when the world was still dominated by primitive animals, Primitive Brothers came to life. 
Click by click, tap by tap, they hunt, survive and adventure through a lot of civilizations. 
Are you ready to explore this wonderful primitive world? 
Primitive Brothers is an easy-to-play and immersive Idle Tap clicker RPG game. 
Tap to hunt monsters, level up bros to unlock super-powerful weapons and higher civilizations. 
Start your adventure and tap to win now!
With Primitive Brothers You Can:
► Tap to Adventure Through Thousands of Levels 
Battle through waves of monsters and bosses. Each level, which there are 4000+, and each civilization gives you more and more power, strength, loot, rewards.
► Upgrade Unique Weapons and Totem Skill Points
There are more than 500+ weapons. Be sure, you will enjoy each tap and click you'll make. Besides, there is an abundance of skill points (totem, reinforce, supply, companion, and many others) to help you boost your combat power.
► Customize Your Look
Customizing your Bro, face, hairstyle, masks, clothes!
► Survive the Dungeons
Bronificent Tower, Rune Shard Dungeon, Continent Dungeon, and other terrible dungeons waiting for you to challenge.
► Enjoy the PvP Battle Mode
Battle players from all over the world in PvP mode, where you will get higher ranks and unique, special Tap game rewards.
► Build Your Team
Unlock girlfriend and bros to gain new power, you are no longer fighting alone.
► Unlock Various Interesting Places
Craft and upgrade your equipment and create new weapons in Smithy. Trade in market and enjoy dancing with your friends in Club. We even have a hospital, alchemy workshop in the town, and you can earn more stones and coins by doing fishing.
► Win Rewards Daily
Click to hit the monster, and get a great amount of loot (stones and coins, chests, unique tools, weapons, skins, clothes, and many others), that fall after defeating enemies, completing numerous quests and events.
Tap Download and have unstoppable fun!
Primitive Brothers is free to play, but there are optional in-game items will require payment. You can turn off the payment feature in your device's settings if you wish to disable the feature.

bluejetty:00122179:ios.description:
Join 20 million happy users and unleash your creativity!
1. Write a text conversation in TextingStory 
2. Create a video with your story 
3. Watch it and share it
TextingStory allows you to write conversations like any messaging app, except you can switch sides by swiping left or right over the message area. You can also press the characters' names. 
Take all the time you need to write your conversations. The videos are automatically accelerated for a consistently fast-paced result!
Every keystroke is recorded, so feel free to play with corrections, hesitations, or misspellings!
This is a simple app with endless possibilities.
TextingStory pioneered a new video format in 2016 and has become wildly successful on various social media, with some users getting tens of millions of views of their videos. It has its own Know Your Meme entry and T-Mobile even reproduced it in a 2019 Superbowl ad.
TextingStory is also a popular educational app for spicing up course material or hands-on activities with students.
Get it now!
********** Frequently Asked Questions **********
If your question is not here or the answer doesn't help => iphone@yvz.fr
Q: How do I change the character's names?
A: To access their settings, make a long-press on any character in the character list.
Q: How do I change the message side?
A: Swipe over the messages area. Or tap the + or camera button, then tap "Change writing side". You can also change the side of any message in edit mode. Tap the pencil button to enter edit mode when you're not writing a message.
Q: How do I add pictures or GIFs to the stories
A: You need to purchase the Storyteller or Pro upgrade. Any purchase unlocks character pictures and the ability to send pictures or GIFs.
Q: I don't see the typing area in the videos. Why is that?
A: Check if "Show typing" is ON in the video settings.

bluejetty:00017519:ios.description:
Sudoku by Brainium has updated the classic Sudoku puzzle game you know and love, with a clean, modern design, calming backdrops, and intuitive controls. With endless number puzzles and five levels of difficulty, our Sudoku is perfect for players of all skill levels. Whether you’re in the mood for a quick game to help you relax, or an expert level logic challenge to train your brain, there’s a board for you. 
Brainium Sudoku also features the first and best smart hint system available. It goes beyond simply giving you the answers. Instead, it helps you learn and improve your skills by teaching you “why” the answer is what it is.
With every puzzle, our “Hint” button provides the techniques you need to make progress even when it seems like your path is blocked. The instructions are easy to understand, unique for every puzzle, and presented with easy to follow, helpful animations and colorful visuals. This feature will improve your Sudoku skills whether you’re a first-time player or a seasoned expert. It’s the perfect companion for anyone looking to take their number game or logic puzzle skills to the next level. 
Enjoy a clear, easy to read, and customizable Sudoku board with visual guides that make reading the board and figuring out where to place your next numbers a 
breeze.
Our input system is designed to make entering numbers and notes simple, and our user-friendly scoring system makes it easy to compete with yourself or friends.
Starting and keeping a daily habit of mental exercise is easy by playing Sudoku’s Daily Puzzles, which are sure to keep your mind sharp and at ease. Track your progress with onboard statistics and unlock fun achievements along the way.
Brainium’s Classic Sudoku Features:
• The world’s most advanced Sudoku learning tool and hint system
• Hints that teach you the logic behind the answer
• Five perfectly balanced difficulty levels from beginner to expert
• Daily Puzzle Challenges - complete them to earn points and gold checkmarks
• Two beautiful grid styles
• Nine relaxing backdrops
• Light or dark grid fonts with adjustable size
• Auto Light/Dark mode adjusts the theme based on your device settings
• Unlimited collection of brain training logic puzzles
• Game Statistics to track progress
• Auto-Fill Notes option
• Auto-Clear Notes option
• Auto-Check Errors option
• Number Painting option allows you to rapidly fill open squares with a selected number or note
• Universal App looks great on iPhone and iPad
• Global and friend leader boards
• Portrait and landscape play options
• Right or left-handed option in landscape
• iPad keyboard compatible
We hope Sudoku by Brainium brings you endless fun, relaxation, and a challenge for your mind.

• Spider Solitaire
• FreeCell
• Pyramid
• Blackjack

bluejetty:00015885:ios.name: Dinosaur World Encyclopedia
bluejetty:00015885:ios.summary: The education app World of Dinosaurs takes you to those prehistoric times with a single tap. As soon as you enter the land before time, rotate your device left to right to get a 360-degree view of the illustrated landscape. (Tip: Use your h
bluejetty:00015885:ios.description:
The education app World of Dinosaurs takes you to those prehistoric times with a single tap. As soon as you enter the land before time, rotate your device left to right to get a 360-degree view of the illustrated landscape. (Tip: Use your headphones for an immersive soundscape experience as you enter the Mesozoic Era.) 
World of Dinosaurs takes advantage of the fact that we are currently living in the golden age of dinosaur discovery and presents comprehensive information based on the latest discoveries and scientific theory, within a beautiful multimedia presentation. World of Dinosaurs includes amazing high-definition original illustrations, which along with the accompanying information create the ultimate dinosaur resource covering dinosaurs of all time, discovery, extinction, and even dinosaur ancestors still alive today.
World of Dinosaurs is an informative, interactive tool for the next time you're working on a project, presentation, or simply want to satisfy your dino curiosity. From the Table of Contents, tap on the Dinosaurs section and use the magnifying glass to browse through an extensive A to Z list of dinosaur species. On the Discovery tab, view detailed infographics on fossil formation and dinosaur intelligence. 
The app's amazing AR experience enhances users' learning experience too. Choose from five dinosaurs from the AR Dinosaurs tab and, in the blink of an eye, you'll find one of those massive creatures hanging out right by your desk. If your friends don't believe you, take a picture and send it to them - it will be roar-some!
Prehistoric Pack:
The ultimate experience in the world of dinosaurs with the Prehistoric Pack. Access to all contents and future updates includes all dinosaurs, pterosaurs, marine reptiles, discoveries, and more. Prehistoric Pack updates every month to add new dinosaurs and more.
Prehistoric Pack is an auto-renewing subscription. Payment for the Prehistoric Pack subscription will be charged to your Apple ID account at the purchase confirmation. The subscription will renew automatically unless it is canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current period. For more information please read the terms of use:
https://worldofdinosaurs.net/termsofuse.html
