bluejetty:00021940:ios.description:
Tabata Pro – The ULTIMATE HIIT Interval Timer for MAXIMIZING YOUR WORKOUT
Tabata Pro is a MUST HAVE TABATA TIMER designed to elevate your fitness routine. Whether you’re into HIIT, TABATA, or any INTERVAL TRAINING, this powerful workout timer is engineered to optimize your performance and help you achieve your fitness goals faster.
Used by top trainers, bodybuilders, physical education departments, and athletes worldwide, Tabata Pro is the ultimate fitness timer for HIIT, TABATA, CIRCUIT TRAINING , CrossFit, and general gym workouts. Whether you're using it for weight training, kettlebells, running, cycling, or any form of interval training, Tabata Pro is your go-to tool for improving performance.
MAXIMIZE YOUR FITNESS WITH TABATA AND HIIT TRAINING
High-impact TABATA and HIIT training are known for their ability to deliver maximum fitness results in a short amount of time. Tabata Pro helps you stay on track with precise timing, ensuring you get the most out of every workout session.
Use Tabata Pro as your dedicated Tabata timer, following the traditional Tabata method, or simply as a versatile HIIT interval timer for other types of workout training. Whether you're using your iPhone, iPad, or Apple WATCH, Tabata Pro works seamlessly across all devices.
INTERACTIVE COACHING & SOUND ALERTS
The built-in speaking coach in Tabata Pro guides you through every stage of your workout, including preparation, work intervals, rest periods, cool down, and recovery. Tabata Pro comes with carefully selected, high-quality alert sounds that cut through the noise of your workout music, ensuring you're always in sync with your timer.
MUSIC CONTROL WITH WORKOUT DJ
One of the standout features of Tabata Pro is its integration with Workout DJ, which gives you complete music control during your workout. Automatically start and change your music throughout your session, with different tracks for each interval. This feature allows you to set the right workout music for each phase of your HIIT or Tabata training.
TRACK YOUR PROGRESS WITH APPLE HEALTH INTEGRATION
Tabata Pro integrates with Apple Health, so you can easily track your workouts and store them in the Apple Health database. Pair it with a heart rate monitor or use the Apple Watch app to track calories burned and monitor your heart rate, giving you detailed insights into your fitness journey.
KEY FEATURES OF Tabata Pro:
* Premium quality **Tabata timer** for HIIT and interval training 
* Workout DJ for automatic music control and interval music changes 
* High-quality audio, visual, and voice alert system 
* Fully customizable timing, cycles, and Tabata intervals
* Multiple quick-change Tabata timer presets
* Mute sound option for silent workouts 
* Multitasking and split-screen support for easy use on all devices 
* Custom external display support for gym or group training 
* Apple Health integration to track workouts and stats 
* Apple Watch app for easy access on your wrist
4 Products in 1:
* In-pocket personal audio coach with headphones
* Main display for room use or on fitness equipment
* External display for group training or gym sessions
* Tabata timer and HIIT timer right on your wrist with the Apple Watch app
General Uses:
* Tabata Timer
* Interval Timer
* Tabata WOD Timer
* HIIT Timer
* Walk/Run Timer
Take your fitness to the next level with Tabata Pro—the only Tabata timer and HIIT timer you need to maximize your workouts. Whether you're training for Crossfit, circuit training, or simply want a workout clock that keeps you on track, Tabata Pro is designed to help you reach your goals faster.

bluejetty:00029713:ios.description:
White noise, rain, ocean waves and 40+ ambient sounds, mixed the way you like. Noizio turns any place into a calm one: set a few sounds, balance the volumes and let it play for as long as you need — to focus at work, unwind in the evening or fall asleep faster.
Free to download and free to keep using. No ads, no sign-up, no account, no internet required.
Every feature is free. The sleep timer, your own saved mixtures, sharing, background playback, the Lock Screen timer — nothing is held back. You start with six sounds, and one optional purchase adds the other 35+. Once, not monthly: Noizio has never had a subscription and still doesn't.
Already bought Noizio? Everything stays yours. Nothing you paid for has been taken away.
FREE, FOR GOOD
• Six sounds to start with: White Noise, October Rain, Sea Waves, Campfire, Sunny Day and Thunderstorm
• Your own mixtures. Turn on several sounds, balance each one with its own volume slider and save the result. Share a mixture with a friend or import theirs.
• Sleep timer. Set it from 1 to 60 minutes or pick an exact time; the sound fades out gently and stops. The countdown stays accurate even while the app is in the background.
• Plays in the background. Keep listening while you read, work or lock the screen. The lock screen and Control Center show what's playing.
• Fits into your day. Pauses when you unplug your headphones, resumes after a phone call, and never interrupts music from other apps until you press play.
• Seamless loops. You can't hear where a sound repeats — no clicks, no fades, no matter how long you listen.
• Dark and light themes, or Auto to follow your system. A dark and a tinted app icon for your home screen.
• Made for iPad too, with a two-column layout. Fully usable with VoiceOver.
ONE PURCHASE ADDS THE REST
Nature: Birds in Park, Tropical Birds, Night Owls, Frogs and Crickets, Farm, Summer Night, Desert, Winter Wind, River Stream, Blue Whales
Places: City Street, Paris Cafe, Playground, Subway, Inside Train, Sailing Yacht, Ship Hull, Deep Space, Space Drone
Things: Clock, Heartbeat, Keyboard Typing, Old Typewriter, Vinyl Cracks, Wind Chimes, Magical Chimes, Kitty Purr, Ghosty
Noise: Pink Noise, Brown Noise
Tones: Alpha, Beta, Gamma, Delta and Theta Waves
It is a single purchase, shared with your family, and it stays yours.
WHAT PEOPLE USE IT FOR
• Focusing at work or while studying, and drowning out an open office or a noisy street
• Falling asleep and staying asleep, at home or in a hotel room
• Meditation, yoga and breathing exercises
• Winding down after a long day
• Masking tinnitus and other constant noises
• A soft background for a baby's nap
Noizio has been helping people focus and sleep since 2015. It is made by one developer, it stays small and quiet, and it does one thing well.
Available in English, German, Spanish, French, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Portuguese (Brazil), Ukrainian, Simplified Chinese and Traditional Chinese — sound names included.
noizioapp.com

GameTree is the ultimate LFG platform and gamer social network. With our interest-based matchmaking and our Discord bot, Scout, you can instantly form squads, find teammates, and make lasting gamer friends across all platforms.
Tired of random lobbies that don't click? GameTree connects you with players who match your games, playstyle, and personality. Whether you play Arc Raiders, Marvel Rivals, Rocket League, Call of Duty, Minecraft, League of Legends, or tabletop RPGs, GameTree helps you discover teammates you'll actually enjoy gaming with.

bluejetty:00178937:ios.description:

Keep driving around the city and the job can come at any minute, don't forget to accept the job and rush to pick up your passenger, before any dodgy taxi driver gets in your way in this crazy city taxi simulator 2020 game.
Heaps of taxi games on the store, but none as realistic and sophisticated like this taxi game. Good service and timely pick up will earn you more rewards and tips in city taxi sim game 2020. Passenger will call you early morning for their airport taxi service, keep an eye on the clock, as these passengers will not accept any delay in this airport taxi simulator 2020, while you are playing this taxi game.
Offroad taxi games are fun, if you have an online competitor, have is desperately trying to snatch jobs of your hands and hand it over to any other cabby, who is part of the same taxi driving simulator game. off road Cabbie is quite popular in the country area, as he is always very bubbly character and knows all his passengers by name and their destination by heart in cab simulator game. So earn the respect of all the country people with your jolly attitude and make a fortune for yourself in taxi driver sim 2020 game.
Note: If you choose to join as a Radio Taxi Driving Game 2021 Pro member, you are agreeing to an auto-renewing subscription plan that will automatically be charged through your account as per your choice of plan.

- Huge selection of cars from classic to modern taxi models

- Drive the passengers to their destinations by using Road navigation(GPS)
- Smart AI traffic cars, vans and trucks

- Smooth controls Steering,Touch Buttons,Tilt and Joystick Touch
- High quality graphics

- Button A = Gas
- Button B = Back/Brake

bluejetty:00119921:ios.description:
The Arena app allows current Basecamp users to utilize our competitive games King of the Mountain and Climb, anytime and anywhere. Play the games in solo mode or challenge a classmate to a battle of wits. Collectively, the two game modes offer over 5,000 questions designed to assist students to commit critical core academic content to long-term memory. The questions are presented in five unique Mountains (i.e., Musculoskeletal, Neuromuscular, Cardiopulmonary, Other Systems, Non-Systems). The games add a competitive aspect to studying and fully engage students as they learn. See how you stack up to the competition! Students can explore their performance data using the Arena – Scorecard and Leaderboard. Summative data collected in the Arena can be used to direct future remedial efforts. Lace up those hiking boots and let the games begin!
Company Information
Scorebuilders is a physical therapist owned company whose sole focus is to prepare students for the National Physical Therapy Examinations. We sell more review products and offer more review courses than any other company. Scorebuilders has experienced three decades of continuous growth and is the recognized leader in physical therapist and physical therapist assistant licensing preparation. Scorebuilders offers candidates the knowledge and insight necessary to achieve their educational goals.

bluejetty:00078592:ios.summary: O app ESJB é a maneira mais simples, prática e segura de você acompanhar o dia a dia de seu filho na escola. Esqueça as ultrapassadas agendas de papel, você pode utilizar seu celular e ter acesso às informações de seu filho em tempo real e
bluejetty:00078592:ios.description:
O app ESJB é a maneira mais simples, prática e segura de você acompanhar o dia a dia de seu filho na escola. Esqueça as ultrapassadas agendas de papel, você pode utilizar seu celular e ter acesso às informações de seu filho em tempo real e onde estiver!
Com o app, você tem todas as funcionalidades necessárias para acompanhar o dia a dia de seu filho na palma da sua mão:
* Diário: acompanhe as atividades realizadas pelo seu filho. Seu filho recebeu presença na chamada? As tarefas de casa foram entregues? Foram marcadas provas? Foram marcados trabalhos?
* Recados: envie um recado diretamente para o professor de seu filho ou para a diretora da escola e seja avisado quando receber uma resposta.
* Calendário: verifique o dia e o horário das atividades da escola. Acompanhe a data das provas e trabalhos. Seja avisado assim que receber um novo convite e receba um lembrete quando uma atividade estiver próxima. Informe sua participação aos professores aceitando ou rejeitando os convites.
* Medicamentos: informe ao professor os medicamentos que seu filho está tomando, em que horário eles devem ser ministrados e em que dosagem. Encaminhe junto uma foto da receita médica.
* Dados: informe os dados mais importantes sobre seus filhos. Quais são as suas alergias? Qual o seu plano de saúde? Quais são as pessoas autorizadas a buscá-lo? Qual o seu aniversário?
O app está disponível gratuitamente para os pais e alunos.

bluejetty:00070149:ios.summary: Do you love motorcycle racing games? Looking for adrenaline? This is it, the ultimate motorcycle simulator “TiMX: This is Motocross” is here. Get immersed in the epic physics of dirt bike racing & freestyle with what TiMX brings to the tabl
bluejetty:00070149:ios.description:
Do you love motorcycle racing games? Looking for adrenaline? This is it, the ultimate motorcycle simulator “TiMX: This is Motocross” is here. Get immersed in the epic physics of dirt bike racing & freestyle with what TiMX brings to the table. You’ll find no rockets or powerups here, only the most skilled and smooth riders will take home the win from the moto race! 
We’re introducing scrubs, whips and freestyle to mobile motocross gaming like you’ve never seen before. Choose your style whether it be to throw down a monster turn up, racer whip, turn down & loads more. Show your motor skill!
Multiple moto race disciplines available:
* MX Motocross
* Supercross - SX
* Freestyle Motocross - FMX
Get ready to battle head to head against motorcycle riders from around the world in our new PvP duals. Make your way to the top and collect as many trophies as you can to unlock new divisions with extra tracks and environments from around the world.
Features of our motorcycle racing simulator:
* Multiple moto race disciplines: Supercross/MX/FMX
* Player vs Player Multiplayer Duals
* Scrub & Whips!!
* 2 Stroke & 4 Stroke
* 64 Freestyle Tricks & 360 to unlock!!
* FMX Modifications - Flip Levers, Grab Holes
* Complete Gear, Rider & Bike Customisation
* Collect Trophies to Unlock Divisions
* Over 30 Tracks
* Jersey Name, Number & Butt Patch Customisation
* World Leaderboards
* Rotating Environments & Tracks Updated Regularly!
* Facebook, Google & Instagram Integration
Riders asked for the ultimate dirt bike racing & freestyle game like this for years and we listened to the action sports community! Get ready to race and express your own style in one of the world's best mobile motocross games “TiMX: This is Motocross”. 
We`ve done a lot of work to bring you the real experience of motorcycle racing, and it is now on you to show your motor skill and enjoy it!
Coming soon
* Vs Friends
* Weekly Championship
* Weekly Takedown
* Speed & Style
Download this motorcycle simulator, and we ensure you that you will experience one of the best motocross games! Show your motor skill in different dirt bike racing disciplines like supercross, MX, and FMX!
---
Developed by Aussie Adrenaline Game Studios

Pick your war machine — attack he
bluejetty:00066372:ios.description:
Blow up everything. Total Destruction is a physics destruction sandbox where you demolish buildings, flatten cities, and wipe out enemy armies with tanks, helicopters, planes, warships and nuclear weapons.
Pick your war machine — attack helicopter, fighter jet, heavy tank, artillery or destroyer — and unleash machine guns, autocannons, rockets, bombs and nukes on fully destructible cities. Watch buildings collapse into rubble, ships break apart and sink, and battlefields turn to fire and debris.
DESTRUCTION SANDBOX
- Fully destructible buildings — every structure can be demolished
- Realistic physics: debris, fire, shockwaves and chain explosions
- Nuclear weapons that flatten entire cities
- Dynamic ship destruction and sinking
- Sandbox mode with weapon customization — tune damage, reload, ammo and explosion types, and build your own chaos
BUILD YOUR OWN VEHICLES
- Vehicle editor: design and customize your own tanks, aircraft and war machines
- Upgrade armor, engines and weapon systems
- 75 vehicles including the Warthog, Ka-50, HIMARS and the massive P. 1000 Ratte super tank
WAR CAMPAIGN
- 70 missions across land, air and sea, plus new daily challenges every day
- Fight across desert, jungle, arctic, night city and open sea
- Battle infantry, tanks, drones, advanced air defense systems and Arleigh Burke destroyers
- Special weapons and powerful boss encounters
- 19 achievements to unlock
Total Destruction is an offline destruction simulator — no internet required. Whether you want strategic army battles or pure demolition mayhem in sandbox mode, jump in a tank, take off in a helicopter, and destroy it all.
New content added regularly — more vehicles, missions and destruction on the way.

Walk Your Way to Better Health with Walking Weight Loss: Walk Pal
Take your fitness to the next level with Walking Weight Loss: Walk Pal! Our easy-to-use pedometer app helps you track your daily steps, distance, and progress—keeping you motivated every step of the way.
With a simple and intuitive interface, you can effortlessly monitor your daily, weekly, and monthly walking stats. Plus, our guided walking workouts are designed to help you stay active, improve your fitness, and achieve your weight loss goals.

 • Set personalized goals and reminders to stay on track
 • View detailed walking statistics for better insights
 • Access 500+ of guided walking workouts tailored to different fitness levels
 • Simple and easy-to-use design for all users

 • See visible changes in only few weeks!
 • Improve overall fitness and well-being through regular walking.
 • Stay motivated with progress tracking and goal-setting.

TIRED OF LIMITED STORAGE POPUPS?
Clean Manager is here to help you clean your storage and get free space on your phone easily.
PHOTO AND VIDEO CLEANER
- Search and delete duplicated photos and videos. No more similar photos, only the best ones
- Delete unused screenshots
- Free up space by deleting heavy photos and videos!

- Swipe through your gallery effortlessly with Clean Manager’s intuitive system
- Swipe left to remove unwanted photos or duplicates
- Swipe right to keep what’s important for you

- Our compression tool helps you to save storage space by reducing your photo or video size

- Monitor your phone’s battery, storage, and performance at a glance with Clean Manager’s widgets!

- Use Clean Manager’s smart AdBlocker in Safari

Clean Manager is free to download, but a paid subscription is required to unlock and use the cleaning features. Without an active subscription, these features are not available.
Several subscription plans are available, from $7.99 to $49.99 depending on the plan and its duration (weekly or yearly). Prices are in USD and may vary by region. The exact price of the plan you select, in your local currency, is always displayed in the app before you confirm your purchase.

Your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current period.
You can manage your subscription and turn off auto-renewal at any time in your Apple Account settings.
With Clean Manager, your private photos and videos are safe and protected.

Construct your naval base and build your own fleet! Battle your way through epic Campaign and save the world. Fight with other players with
bluejetty:00170787:ios.description:
Armada is a Turn-Based Naval Battle Epic Si-Fi RPG with hundreds famous warships in the history. 
Construct your naval base and build your own fleet! Battle your way through epic Campaign and save the world. Fight with other players with your strategy to see who is the king of the ocean. Challenge the mysterious Super Warships hiding over the world.
Collect the epic warships in history and training a powerful fleet to face various situations.
Assemble the greatest fleet of warships for strategic victories!
***
Features
[Strategic Gameplay]
Witness the dazzling display of each Warship's unique skills.
Different crew groups to pick and choose additional abilities for your warships!
Come up with the best strategy to win battles.
[Endless Fun]
Construct, decorate your naval base, battle other commanders, explore unknown oceans, fight in PvP battles, expand your Collection, train warships, and more.
[Massive Collection]
Battleship, carrier, cruiser, destroyer.
Different warships, different attributes and thousands combination to against all kind of challenge!
Collect as many warships as you can and assemble the greatest fleet.
[Raid other players]
Look for opponent and raid their base for resources. Train and arm your warships, to be the king on the ocean!
[Equipment]
You need to find as many as powerful equipment as you can. 
They will enhance the power of your warships. If you can collect a set of equipment your warship will get some special abilities.
[Special action]
Every day, the government will issues bounty for the commanders to complete their special missions.
Carefully choose the mission to earn your great reward if you don't want to bury at the bottom of the ocean.
[Super giant warships]
They are big, powerful and mysterious. 
They are hiding all over the world and no one knows where they came from.
Explore and find them, challenge and defeat them with your clan allies to get unique materials in return.
***

bluejetty:00080155:ios.summary:
THE OFFICIAL JASON VLOGS APP: VIDEOS, GAMES, SELFIES AND CALLS
Welcome to the official app of the Jason Vlogs YouTube channel! Watch every favorite episode, play learning games, make a selfie video with Jason and even call him, all in one
bluejetty:00080155:ios.description:
THE OFFICIAL JASON VLOGS APP: VIDEOS, GAMES, SELFIES AND CALLS
Welcome to the official app of the Jason Vlogs YouTube channel! Watch every favorite episode, play learning games, make a selfie video with Jason and even call him, all in one safe app made for kids ages 2 to 6. Meet Jason, Alex and Sara and join their fun adventures every day.
NEW! SAY CHEESE: A SELFIE VIDEO WITH JASON
Upload a photo, pick a story, and your child stars in an exclusive selfie video right next to the star. Save it and share it with family. A parent gate protects every upload, and photos are used only to create your video.
NEW! CALL JASON: REAL-TIME AI CALLS
Your child can call Jason and chat with him in real time. Ask questions, tell stories, share jokes and enjoy friendly conversations with the YouTube star. Every AI call supports speech development, vocabulary and communication skills, all through play.
WATCH KIDS VIDEOS: ALL EPISODES PLUS EXCLUSIVES
- The most complete collection of Jason Vlogs episodes from YouTube
- Exclusive videos you will not find on YouTube
- Funny challenges, toys, outdoor games, playground fun and family travel vlogs
- Offline mode with Fun Pass: download videos and watch without Wi-Fi, perfect for trips
- New videos and games added every week
PLAY LEARNING GAMES
- Counting and alphabet games: first numbers and letters
- Coloring pages for little artists
- Puzzles and logic games that train memory and attention
- Car games and quick reaction challenges
- Simple controls made for little hands
Every game builds real skills: creativity, logical thinking, reaction time and hand and eye coordination. Made for toddlers and preschool kids, from 2 to 6 years old.
MEET THE HEROES
Jason loves toys, games and hanging out with his friends. Alex loves sports and outdoor activities and always has a new fun challenge for him. Together with Sara they turn every day into an adventure that kids want to watch again and again.
MADE FOR PARENTS' PEACE OF MIND
- Curated, family friendly videos and games in one place
- A parent gate before any photo upload
- Photos are used only to create your selfie video
- Ad-free experience with Fun Pass
FUN PASS
Try the app for free with a selection of videos and games. Fun Pass unlocks the full video library, all games, offline downloads, coins for AI calls, weekly new content and an ad-free experience.
BEST ON iPAD
All games and videos are adapted for tablets and look great on a big screen.
Get the official Jason Vlogs app and let your child watch, play, call and star in a video with their favorite YouTube star!
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

Clawesome hairdo? Creeperific
bluejetty:00121676:ios.description:
Oh, My, Ghoul!!! 
Clawdeen Wolf™, the trendiest monsterista from “Monster High” just opened her very own beauty salon - and she needs YOUR spooktacular touch! 
Help Clawdeen give her ghoulfriends killer looks!
Clawesome hairdo? Creeperific nails? How about a new fangtastic outfit? You can get ’em all in the ghoulest one-stop shop!
Oh wait, that’s not all: You can get freaky-fab looks by using our gore-geous selfie filters. You can even create your own filters, so get creative! 
Are you ready for some spooky fun, ghoulfriends?!
Fangtastic Features:
> Use spooky-cool hair salon tools like magic growing spray, hair dyes, mousse and so much more! You can even use Znap to electrify hair! 
> Our selfie filter pack gives you monstrous looks, lets you dance like a Zomboy, AND you can create your own fangtastic filters too - how clawesome is that?!
> Add your freaky fab photos to Spookygram to show off your killer looks.
> Give the boo-tiful monsters the makeover of their nightmares, using the best makeup tools you’ve ever laid your eyeballs on! Add lightning stickers and spider face jewels for an extra creepy cool touch.
> Dress up time! Mummy leggings or dresses fit for a rock star monster? The choices are endless! And wait till you see the crazy shoe collection!
> No monster look is complete without killer nails! Choose claw-like nail shapes, add purrfect rings, and give the monsters spooktacular manicures. 
> Accessorize your spooky clients with clawesome jewelry like crazy-shaped earrings or spiky collar necklaces.
> Give makeovers to all of the ghoulest monsters: Frankie Stein™, Draculaura™, Clawdeen Wolf™, Cleo de Nile™, Lagoona Blue™, Ari Hauntington™, Silvi Timberwolf™ and Twyla™.
MONSTER HIGH and associated trademarks and trade dress are owned by, and used under license from, Mattel. ©2017 Mattel. All rights reserved.

bluejetty:00183156:ios.description:
将棋アプリなら完全無料の「AI将棋 ZERO」！
移動時間や暇な時間に気軽に遊べるアプリです。
シンプルに将棋で遊ぶことだけを追い求めています。
将棋は思考のトレーニングや発想力の強化にもつながりますので、ぜひ遊んでみてください。
◆主な特徴◆
・AIとの対戦機能
独自開発のAIを搭載しています。
入門 + 10級から9段まで、20段階のレベルをご用意しました。
初心者から中級者、上級者まで幅広くお楽しみいただける強さを設定しています。
将棋を始めたい方やルールは知ってるけど・・・といった方にもフィットするかと思います。
・2人対戦機能
AIではなく友人や将棋仲間等、実際の人と対戦することができます。
・棋譜の保存機能
対戦後に棋譜を保存することが出来ます。
対戦を見直して、ご自身の上達に役立ててください。
・戦績記録機能
各レベルとの対戦成績が自動で記録され、勝率を計算してくれます。
各レベルで100勝を目指しましょう！
・オーソドックスなゲームを手軽に
簡単操作なので誰でも気軽に楽しめます。
◆将棋ZEROはこんな人にオススメです◆
・初心者なので弱いAIと対戦したい
・暇な時間に将棋を楽しみたい
・将棋を始めてみたいけど、ルールがわからない
・将棋のルールは知っているけどやりこんでいないため、もう少し上達したい
・集中して将棋を取り組みたい
・定石の確認や練習をしたい
・棋譜を見返して、上達したい
・最近流行っているのでやってみたい
・対戦成績が記録されると燃える
・小さいころに将棋をやったきりだけど、懐かしいので遊んでみたい
・子供が将棋を覚えてやりたがっているので、ちょうどいい難易度の将棋ゲームを探している
・将棋盤は場所を取るためアプリで代替したい
・将棋アプリを一通りためしてみたけど、しっくりくるものが無かった
・かっこいいデザインの将棋アプリで遊びたい
・これからは将棋の時代だと思っている
・囲碁派だけど将棋も気になる
・詰め将棋が好きで、本を買って時間のあるときに楽しんでいる
・将棋の奥深さに惚れ込んでいる
・AIと対戦できて、1人プレイでも飽きない暇つぶしゲームを探している
・オフラインでできる対戦ゲームを欲しい
・仕事や勉強の気分転換用に、ちょうどよいアプリを探している
・ボードゲームが好きで、オセロやチェスなどのアプリでよく遊んでいる
・マインスイーパーやナンプレなど、パズル要素と理詰め要素のあるゲームが好き
・ゲームアプリでも、ソーシャルゲーム等の課金モノではなく定番ゲームが好き

bluejetty:00084017:ios.description:
AI Tattoo Generator & Creator – Transform your tattoo dreams into reality with the power of artificial intelligence! Whether you’re looking for a small, minimalist piece or an elaborate sleeve, our AI-driven tattoo design app simplifies the process of exploring, customizing, and creating a one-of-a-kind piece of body art. Get inspired, experiment with styles, and discover the perfect tattoo that tells your unique story.
KEY FEATURES
- AI-Powered Tattoo Designs: Harness cutting-edge technology to instantly generate original, personalized tattoo ideas that align with your style, theme, or concept.
- Endless Creative Possibilities: Browse a variety of design categories like tribal, geometric, floral, abstract, and more. Mix and match elements to bring your vision to life.
- Easy Customization: Refine colors, shapes, sizes, and styles using intuitive editing tools. Compare multiple versions until you find your perfect design.
- Trend Exploration: Stay on top of tattoo trends and discover fresh inspiration. Make popular concepts your own and adapt them to your personal aesthetic.
- Seamless Sharing: Show off your unique designs to friends, tattoo artists, or social media. Get feedback before making a lifelong decision.
WHY CHOOSE AI TATOO GENERATOR & CREATOR?
Instant Inspiration – Quickly generate endless tattoo concepts, saving hours of brainstorming. 
Personalized Results – Craft designs that reflect your personality, interests, and artistic preferences. 
User-Friendly Interface – Enjoy a simple, intuitive workspace for exploring and editing designs. 
Professional-Quality Designs – Produce high-resolution images you can easily share with tattoo professionals.
We love to receive feedback from you. Feel free to send your questions or suggestions about our AI Tattoo Generator app to onemind.development@gmail.com.
You can find terms and privacy links of AI Tattoo Generator & Creator here: 
https://zipoapps.com/tattoocreatorios/terms
https://zipoapps.com/tattoocreatorios/privacy

The earlier kidney disease is detected, the better the chance of slowing or stopping its progression.
This App includes 5 equations for calculating eGFR (Glomerular filtration rate).

- Cockcroft-Gault
- MDRD

bluejetty:00152730:ios.description:
Find Devices & Air Tag Tracker: Never Lose Your Gear Again
Tired of the daily hunt for your missing devices? 
Find Devices & Air Tag Tracker transforms your phone into a powerful radar for all your Bluetooth-enabled belongings. 
Locate everything from AirPods to smartwatches with precision and ease. 
Stop searching and start finding!
Why Choose Our App?
Our application cuts through the frustration of lost items by giving you direct, actionable intelligence.
It’s built on a powerful scanning engine designed for one purpose: to provide immediate clarity on where your devices are, or where they were last seen.
Core Features & Benefits
1. Real-Time Bluetooth Scanner:
What it is: An advanced scanner that detects and lists all nearby discoverable Bluetooth devices.
How it helps: See a real-time feed of devices around you, allowing you to quickly identify your gear before you leave it behind. Watch signal strength to gauge proximity.
2. Find Your AirPods & More:
What it is: Broad compatibility that goes far beyond just AirTags.
How it helps: Confidently locate a wide range of items, including Apple AirPods, smartwatches, wireless earbuds, fitness trackers, and other Bluetooth accessories. It's your one-stop tracking solution.
3. Last Known Location History:
What it is: An automated feature that saves the GPS location where your device was last connected.
How it helps: When a device goes missing, launch the app to see its last recorded location pinned on a map. This gives you a critical starting point to retrace your steps and recover it.
4. Intuitive, User-Friendly Design:
What it is: An interface built for speed and simplicity.
How it helps: Get started in seconds. With a clean, uncluttered layout, you can navigate the app effortlessly and find the information you need without any hassle or confusion.
Ready to Live Without the Stress?
Download Find Devices & Air Tag Tracker today and turn your phone into your most reliable finding tool. Regain your peace of mind and keep your valuable devices secure.
Download Now and Start Tracking!

Ignite engines, buckle up, and now dive into the epic sci-fi universe of Isaac Asimov’s Foundation—the beloved novels that also inspired the acclaimed Apple TV+ series.

Immersive Story: The Master Trader's Galactic Odyssey
-Play a unique role as an interstellar trader/bounty hunter/political strategist navigating between the Empire, Foundation, other factions and rebels, uncovering the secrets of

Space Exploration: Thrilling Landing Shooter Combats
-Go explore the galaxy freely, discover tons of floating space ruins and fascinating planets, and get ready for a breathtaking landing battle to unlock hidden secrets!
-Deploy 3-hero strike teams in dynamic landing missions, with various strategic combinations to spark their potential! Use precise control and tactical prowess to overcome alien threats.
Galaxy Wars: A Rising Trade Empire
-Construct a variety of combat crafts and strategize your fleet formation to exploit and protect your galaxy's trade routes from threats and rivals.
-Join powerful alliances and showcase your RTS skills in large-scale interstellar conflicts. Rise as a dominant force in the galactic economy.
EMBARK NOW! 
Within the Foundation universe:
Write Your Sci-Fi Legend • Build your Ideal Flagship • Build Trade Networks • Command Elite Fleets • Forge Your Galactic Destiny!

bluejetty:00146956:ios.name: Give Us The Floor: Group Chat
bluejetty:00146956:ios.summary: Join a safe support community where 2SLGBTQIA+ youth ages 13 to 24 are there for each other without fear of stigma, taboo, or shame. If you're Queer, Trans, Nonbinary, Genderfluid, Ace, Questioning, an Ally, etc — you are welcome and safe t
bluejetty:00146956:ios.description:
Join a safe support community where 2SLGBTQIA+ youth ages 13 to 24 are there for each other without fear of stigma, taboo, or shame. If you're Queer, Trans, Nonbinary, Genderfluid, Ace, Questioning, an Ally, etc — you are welcome and safe to be yourself with Give Us The Floor. 
Upon sign-up, you'll find 25+ community-wide discussion channels covering a range of topics, ranging from serious topics such as body image, mental health, discrimination, BIPOC, and anxiety, to lighter content, including pets, memes, and more. You'll also have the opportunity to join a more focused small group consisting of up to 20 young people within two years’ age of each other, led by a trained youth facilitator. Try out new pronouns, get advice on coming out, celebrate your accomplishments and Queer joy, find support with friends and family issues or bullying, and find encouragement in your discussion group. Participants will also be invited also become a certified Youth Facilitator and earn community service hours after being an active participant in the app for a minimum of 2 weeks.
How we prioritize participant safety:
1. Privacy and safety are important and no personal identifying or contact information may be provided at any time within the app. 
2. No one-on-one communication is permitted or even possible within app functionality. All communication exists within group discussion spaces. 
3. All discussions are moderated by trained Youth Facilitators with the capability to hide and/or delete content that violates Community Guidelines.
4. Harassment or bullying of any kind is not tolerated and will result in removal from the app.
5. Each participant is asked and encouraged to flag any comment or thread that does not respect the rules, or just doesn’t feel right, using our easy, anonymous reporting feature within the app.
6. No adult content may be shared. Content shared in the app must come from an approved source and must be appropriate for users under age 18. We also may utilize third party AI tools for vetting content for safety and compliance with Community Guidelines. At no time will personal information about app participants be shared with third parties without prior authorization.
7. A Community Care and crisis response team with professional, clinical mental health backgrounds is available to support Youth Facilitators with situations requiring crisis escalation or other challenges during peak usage hours, seven days a week. 
8. Participants may contact Community Care at any time in the app using the easy contact form or at info@giveusthefloor.org.
Note: Give Us The Floor is a registered non-profit that has been operating since 2015. It has positively impacted thousands of young people. Upon signup, you will be asked to share a phone number and zip code to verify that each member is a real human and for generalized statistics for funding purposes, but we will not share your personal information with third parties at any time.
This space is for support, not for dating. Members are expected to strictly abide by the community rules. Habitual or serious rule-breaking will result in your removal from the Give Us The Floor community. While Give Us The Floor specializes in support for 2SLGBTQIA+ youth, we welcome all allies to a space that is free from Queer or Transphobia and discrimination against 2SLGBTQIA+ identities and lifestyle.

bluejetty:00149966:ios.name: Fishing Chaos
bluejetty:00149966:ios.summary:
Fishing Chaos is the most comprehensive fishing app you'll find.
Designed by engineers that would rather be fishing, our app fuses passion for the sport with cutting edge technology to augment your skill.
With features for the weekend war
bluejetty:00149966:ios.description:
Fishing Chaos is the most comprehensive fishing app you'll find.
Designed by engineers that would rather be fishing, our app fuses passion for the sport with cutting edge technology to augment your skill.
With features for the weekend warrior, charter booking agencies, and everyone in between, our app will help you catch more fish and allow your business to be smarter and run more efficiently.
Charter management
Fishing Chaos offers charter booking management designed for customers and captains. Anglers have the ability to search our database for charter businesses around the good ole U.S. of A. Charter staff manages their trip types and the app does the rest. Online calendaring makes it easy for clients to see charter availability, and automatic scheduling helps prevent double-booking. Pay through the app from initial trip deposit to tips. Anglers can see their booking details and communicate with their captain all within the app.
Tournaments
Our app gives anglers the ability to register and purchase tournament tickets, view live leaderboards, find a weighmaster to weigh-in their catch, or submit fish using online submission. Tournament managers see real-time statistics on their tournament, and have results available instantly on their mobile device. Gone are the days of waiting for the official tallies.
Catch log & virtual tackle box
Easily log your catch, attach photos, notes, location, tackle, and metrics. Keep an inventory of your tackle and use it to keep track of what bait you are most successful with. 
Map
Whether it’s tracking catch history with pinpoint markers or a heatmap layer, viewing tournaments within a region, or searching for charters, the interactive map brings all these components into one view for quick and easy access.

Achieve screen time control with the world’s most-loved screen time app! Opal is the fun, free Screen Time app to improve your focus and make the most out of every day.
5 to 6 hours. That’s the average time you’ll spend looking at your phone today, often without realizing it. It's time to fight back. With a combination of screen time control, app limits, app blockers, real time data, leaderboards and rewards, you will focus better and accomplish your dreams, just like Opal’s members.
**As of August 2026, Opal has saved humanity 500 Million hours of screen time. **
Many of the world's top teams and companies trust Opal to help protect their focus. You can too.
**Opal cut my screen time by 2 hours per day – Marketing at Google **
**You need this app. When I first got opal my daily screen-time was about 8 1/2 hours a day. Now it's 1 hour. **
**Opal has become an indispensable tool in my quest for productivity and mindful technology usage **
**Get Opal! - Ali Abdaal, productivity expert**
BENEFITS
Save 1 hour and 23 minutes per DAY from less screen time, on average.
94% of Opal members are less distracted
93% are more productive thanks to the app
90% report improved well-being
Added benefits:
- Better screen time control
- Better productivity at work
- Reduce stress, be more mindful
- Supports focus challenges, including ADHD
- Set daily work hours, sleep, and routines
- Block apps to unplug and detox
- Stay in focus when you need it most
- You're happy and in control of your screen time
FEATURES
- #1 Screen Time Control: the most loved app for screen time control with 4.8/5.
- #1 App Blocker: Instantly Block apps and websites you choose at a specific time of day throughout the week to organize your time.
- Focus Difficulty: Make it hard, or make it a bit easier. Deep Focus won't let you cancel or bypass at all.
- App Limits: Set daily usage limits on apps and websites to automatically block them and prevent overuse.
- Mindful Block Screens: Discover quotes, puns and more every time you try to open an app or website you really shoudn't.
- Blocklist & Allowlist: Easily pick any app, game or website you want to block or allow during your Blocks.
- Focus Report: Measure your progress with clear metrics, actionable screen time stats, and benchmark against your peers.
- Focus Score: Check your screen time and focus level at any point easily spotting Focus and Distracted time.
- Calendar: Set daily working hours, sleep and routines, block apps automatically, so you don’t have to remember.
- Precious Rewards: Unlock unique MileStones you can share with friends.
- Leaderboard: Challenge friends to top the leaderboard, enhancing productivity, focus and keeping each other motivated.
- Breaks: Choose the app you want to use, write your intention, and set a timer.
- Focus Mode Integration: Sync your Opal Focus Sessions with iPhone Focus Mode to block apps.
- Shortcut Integration: Connect iPhone shortcut automations to start/stop Focus Sessions based on app opens, time, location and more!
- Focus Reminders: Get timely reminder notifications when you get distracted or reach a time limit.
- Deep Focus: Need ultimate focus? Deep Focus is the maximum level of protection — you can’t bypass or cancel.
- More Fun: Opal is guilt-free and fun.
- Widget: Have Opal on your home screen!
CREATE A PERSONALIZED APP BLOCK LIST
Easily pick any app, game or website you want to block or allow to Block Apps.
PRIVATE & SAFE
We use Apple's Screen Time API in order to monitor and block apps you use. Installation is easy and takes a few seconds on your iPhone.
Unlike most apps, Opal works entirely on your phone and personal browsing data never leaves your device.
TERMS, PRIVACY & CONDITIONS
Read on https://opal.so/terms & https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00039100:ios.description:
Capture your music, anytime, anywhere.
With Mobile VOCALOID Editor, all you need is a melody and lyrics to start creating vocal tracks—anytime, anywhere, right from your smartphone.
From this version, the app is offered through a monthly subscription, giving you continuous updates and new features.
Try it free for 14 days and see how easy it is!
Please check “Before You Start (Important)” at the end.
■ Create with VOCALOID on your smartphone
- Start with a 14-day free trial.
- Just enter a melody and lyrics, and your vocal track is ready instantly. Optimized for touch controls with an intuitive interface. Tutorial videos are available on the official site.
■ Comes with ready-to-use voices
- Two voicebanks are included:
 "asa" – an AI-powered voice with a “delicate, transparent singing style”
 "VY1 Lite" – our standard female voice
- AI voicebanks including “asa” support Japanese, English, and Chinese.
■ Enjoy with familiar voices
- From popular characters to the latest AI voices, additional voicebanks are available as in-app purchases directly within the app.
■ Main Features
- Import/export VOCALOID4 VSQX and VOCALOID6 VPR formats
- Up to 32 tracks (VOCALOID, VOCALOID:AI, and audio tracks combined)
- Parameter editing such as pitch bend (same as VOCALOID6 Editor on Mac/PC)
- Real-time and step input with built-in or iOS-compatible MIDI keyboards
- Mixer Screen with compressor and reverb
- Export mixdown as WAV or AAC
For full specifications, please visit the official website.
■ Available Voicebanks (in-app purchases)
Voicebanks are sold separately and require an active subscription to use.
- VOCALOID:AI Voicebanks
Hatsune Miku V6 Original / Hatsune Miku V6 Soft / Vocalo no Ci-chan / Kanade / Uge / Kasukabe Tsumugi / Fuiro / Kotonoha Akane / Kotonoha Aoi / GekiyakuV / KazehikiV / AI Yuzuki Yukari / AI Kizuna Akari / AI Tsuina-chan / AI Megpoid SOLID / Shiki Rowen AI / AI Megpoid / AI Otomachi Una Sugar / AI Otomachi Una Spicy / AI Hibiki Koto / ZOLA KYO / ZOLA YUU / ZOLA WIL / galaco BLACK / galaco WHITE / JESSICA / SANDRA / BRIAN / MATTHEW / HARUKA / AKITO / SARAH / ALLEN / SAKURA / ASAHI / MICHELLE / LUCAS / TAKU / SHION
(More to come in future updates)
- VOCALOID Voicebanks
Hatsune Miku / v for flower / Kaai Yuki / IA / IA ROCKS / Megpoid Native / Megpoid English / Yuzuki Yukari Jun / Yuzuki Yukari In / Yuzuki Yukari Rin / Fukase JP / Fukase EN / Tohoku Zunko / Yumemi Nemu / VY1 / VY2 / CYBER DIVA / CYBER SONGMAN / Rana / Aoki Lapis / Merli / ZOLA KYO / ZOLA YUU / ZOLA WIL / galaco RED / galaco BLUE / Mew / Sachiko / Hiyama Kiyoteru Natural / Hiyama Kiyoteru ROCK / miki Natural / unity-chan!
----- Before You Start (Important) -----
- Version 2.0 requires iOS 17 or later.
- From Version 2.0, core features are available through a subscription.
- Purchased voicebanks are one-time in-app purchases, but can only be used with an active subscription.
- Customers using Version 1.x can continue indefinitely for free, including previously purchased voicebanks.
- The app version can be checked under HELP > About Application.
- EULA: https://s3.ap-northeast-1.amazonaws.com/download.vocaloid/license/MVE/EULA_MVE_EN.pdf
- Privacy Policy: https://www.yamaha.com/en/apps_docs/apps_common/common_PP_fb-20190820.html
-----

bluejetty:00186773:ios.summary:

Through guided video lessons, mindfulness practices,
bluejetty:00186773:ios.description:
Ready to quit smoking, vaping, or tobacco? Craving to Quit® is a clinically proven tobacco cessation program that helps you break free from nicotine addiction and take back your health. 
Through guided video lessons, mindfulness practices, chat-based coaching, and progress tracking, you’ll learn step by step how to reduce cravings, manage withdrawal symptoms, and finally quit tobacco for good. Whether your goal is to stop smoking cigarettes, quit vaping, or give up smokeless tobacco (dip, chew), Craving to Quit gives you the tools and support to succeed. 
Craving to Quit is based on a smoking cessation program developed and tested at Yale University. In clinical trials, this approach proved twice as effective as the gold standard treatment. The 21-module program helps you address both the physical and psychological sides of nicotine addiction, including cravings, withdrawal, stress triggers, and habit loops. 
PRICING 
Craving to Quit is free to download and includes the first 4 modules with limited tools. An in-app subscription purchase allows access to all features and the remaining modules on an auto-renewing subscription basis.* 
1 month: $24.99 
Subscription access includes: 
• All guided video lessons 
• Chat-based coaching 
• Live weekly calls 
• Community forum 
• In-app tools and mindfulness exercises 
• Tobacco tracker 
• Goals, check-ins, and reminders 
Craving to Quit can also be accessed through employer, health plan, or public sector programs. Contact us at Sharecare to learn how you can provide Craving to Quit to your population. 
*PRICING & TERMS 
All prices are for United States customers. Pricing in other countries may vary and actual charges may be converted to your local currency. 
Your Craving to Quit subscription will automatically renew at the end of each term unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end term and your credit card will be charged through your iTunes account 24-hours prior to the end of the current period. You can manage your subscriptions and turn off auto-renew at any time from your iTunes Account Settings, but refunds will not be provided for the unused portion of the term. 
Need help with the app? Please email support@cravingtoquit.com or go to https://claritasmindsciences.zendesk.com/hc/ 
TERMS OF SERVICE and PRIVACY POLICY: https://www.sharecare.com/terms/privacypolicy 
For scientific references: https://scholar.google.com/citations?hl=en&user=GjmDbisAAAAJ&view_op=list_works&sortby=pubdate

bluejetty:00127711:ios.description:
Countdown is a free, super easy to use countdown timer and reminder for the important events & dates in your life.
Features:
• Check your events on the Lock Screen with our widget (Premium feature)
• Glance at your events on your Apple Watch
• Glance at your events using our widget in StandBy (Premium feature)
• Place our Widget anywhere on your Home Screen to view your most important events (Premium feature)
• Share your countdowns with friends and family
• Auto Import (Premium): Connect your calendars to Countdown and automatically add new events.
• Pick any color you'd like for your countdown background
• In addition to receiving a notification when it is time for your event, you can receive reminders 1 day before or 1 week before the event.
• Choose the format in which you want to see your countdown (Premium feature)
• Create as many events as you'd like
• Count up from past events (available on each countdown page)
• Sync your events across your devices with iCloud
• Set your countdowns to repeat yearly, monthly, weekly or daily
• Sort your events from the closest to the most distant
• Dark Mode
• Add notes to your events
• Count only working days
• Have many events? Organize them with tags
Add as many events as you want: Vacation, Birthday, Holiday, Party, Thanksgiving, Christmas, Halloween, Cruise, Valentines, Wedding, Anniversary, Birth, Baby, Graduation, Pregnancy, Trip, New Home, Retirement, Game, Goals, Concert and many more.

We love hearing from you and we read every single email you send us!

bluejetty:00078026:ios.summary:

Step into a prehistoric playground where your favorite dinos eagerly await! Experience a world rich with activities that combine education, adventure, and pure joy. Many
bluejetty:00078026:ios.description:
Dive into "Dino World for Kids" – Where Fun and Learning Come Alive!
Step into a prehistoric playground where your favorite dinos eagerly await! Experience a world rich with activities that combine education, adventure, and pure joy. Many distinct dinosaurs, each with their own personality, are ready to embark on fantastic journeys with your child.
Discover a magical land where friendly dinosaurs roam, each with their unique style and personality. From the playful aquatic dino frolicking with fishes, the curious dino waiting to hatch from its egg, to the flying dino eager for freedom - every moment is filled with adventure and learning.
What's Inside "Dino World for Kids"? 
Embark on an Underwater Adventure: Dive deep and play with our aquatic dino. Splash around with colorful fish and watch the waters come alive in vibrant hues.
From Egg to Exploration: Every dino's journey begins in an egg. Hatch them and see what dino wonders await. Your child's curiosity will be ignited as they discover different dinosaurs from each egg!
Dino Dress-up Delight: Fashion meets the Jurassic! Does your little one dream of styling their own dino? Mix and match outfits and watch our cute dinos strut with style.
Fly to Freedom: One of our dinos is trapped and yearns to spread its wings. Join the quest to unlock the cage and watch our friend soar high into the skies.
Feeding & Learning Fun: It's not just about feeding their appetite but also their brain! Play interactive educational games while treating our dinos to delightful meals.
Dino Doctor to the Rescue: Sometimes, our dino pals encounter a little trouble. Don the doctor's hat and nurse them back to health, teaching kids about care and compassion.
Engage in Mini-Game Mayhem: With a plethora of educational mini-games, your child will never run out of fun activities. Counting, matching, and more – our dinos make every lesson feel like playtime.
Hatch and Grow: Curious about what lies inside those mysterious eggs? Hatch them to meet your new dino pals! With many dinosaurs waiting to be discovered, every hatching experience brings joy and surprise.
Educational Mini-Games: Dive into a world of learning with a twist of fun! Help the dino navigate mazes, pop colorful bubbles in the shape of dinos, and even go on a fishing spree. These activities are designed not just for amusement but to sharpen young minds.
Night-time Adventures: Gather around the campfire with dinos under a starlit sky, play enchanting tunes, or just enjoy the serene beauty of Dino World at night.
Creativity Unleashed: Dress up your favorite dino, give them a makeover, or just play around with different looks. The fashion possibilities are endless!
With vibrant graphics, intuitive gameplay, and a plethora of activities, "Dino World for Kids" is more than just a game; it's a portal to an enchanting world of learning and fun. Perfect for toddlers and small kids, this game is sure to ignite the spark of curiosity and wonder in every child.
You can unlock all levels, all new game features and all dinos, via auto-renewable subscription:
we offer three auto-renewing subscription options: weekly subscription, monthly subscription, annual subscription.
By subscribing you get unlimited access to all contents.
Your subscription will automatically renew at the end of each term and your credit card will be charged through your iTunes account.
You can turn off auto-renew at any time from your account settings but refunds will not be provided for any unused portion of the term.
Your account will be charged according to your plan for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period.
If you wish to avoid auto-renewal you must turn it off at least 24 hours prior to the end of the current period in your Account Settings.
Privacy policy and Terms of Use Page:
https://sites.google.com/view/tinybitgames/privacy
https://sites.google.com/view/tinybitgames/terms-of-use

bluejetty:00087222:ios.description:
Binky Math is a fun-filled app with 300+ fun math games for kids, perfect for toddlers, preschoolers, kindergarteners, and 1st graders. It’s designed to help children learn numbers, build confidence in early math, and enjoy a playful learning experience. The app features 300+ activities that kids aged 2–7 will love to play—and the more they play, the stronger their math skills become!
Children will have a great time completing challenges, while you’ll enjoy watching them grow and learn. Parents can monitor learning outcomes, and kids will be captivated by the bright graphics, cheerful sound effects, collectible stickers, and engaging gameplay.
Help your toddler or preschool child learn numbers, tracing, counting, and more with this easy-to-use app created for kids and parents to explore together. Binky Math includes colorful, interactive experiences that turn learning into fun, making it one of the best kindergarten math games available.
This app is the perfect introduction to early math concepts like counting, addition and subtraction for kids, and even multiplication games for kids, laying a solid foundation for long-term learning. Whether your child is just starting with numbers or ready to explore more advanced concepts, Binky Math adapts to support every level.
Binky Math includes activities like number tracing and recognition, English number pronunciation, object counting, comparing amounts, and logic games. Children also develop sorting, precoding, and early reasoning skills through hands-on play. With targeted practice in addition, subtraction, and first-grade math, Binky Math provides a comprehensive learning journey in one convenient app.

bluejetty:00128445:ios.description:
Slice, chop, and roll your way to sushi success in this satisfying cooking game. The more sushi you roll, the happier your customers will be and the more money your restaurant will make! 
► NOW YOU’RE COOKING!
Sharpen your knife skills on all sorts of Japanese dishes. But the cooking fun doesn’t stop there! You can keep unlocking new actions as you advance to add tons of captivating new mini-games to your gameplay experience.
Satisfy customers by making quality food fast with a variety of fixings, and watch them react with lots of likes and a big cash tip — or anger at poorly made food. When making sushi, be sure to pick up the right ingredients and avoid obstacles to deliver the most delicious meals. Be careful: no guest wants too much seaweed and too little fish — or worse, thumbtacks and moldy cheese in their sushi!
► SUSHI AND CHILL
As you slash through fun levels in the game, you’ll cut through your worries in real life! Feast your eyes and ears on anti-stress ASMR vibes while you work your way to master sushi chef. With its charming graphics and optional vibration, this relaxing game will have you dreaming of sushi! 
► GAME FEATURES:
• Beat increasingly challenging levels to earn more cash and unlock new fillings and toppings. This cooking and restaurant management game is sure to keep you coming back for seconds!
• Level up your sushi skills to earn better Surprise Box rewards, including new ingredients, cutting tools, and actions. You can also earn more skins to customize your gameplay!
• Roll and chop sushi, scale and slice fish, grate cheese, make rice, weigh out noodles in take-out boxes, and more in different mini-games that never get old.
• Work with the classic ingredients of fish, rice, and seaweed, and earn special toppings as you progress, including chili peppers, durian fruit, and caviar. Combine your options to make different types of dishes, including maki, sashimi, nigiri, noodles, and more.
• Upgrade your restaurant with new furniture, dishware, decorations, and accessories to increase your revenue per minute. The more levels you complete, the more options you’ll have for chopping: why slice with a plain old knife when you could hack with an ax or gnaw with a chainsaw?
• Test your skills in entertaining bonus levels with wild and unexpected ingredients. Roll out the red carpet for VIP guests by making sushi and other dishes with fun objects like cash, gold, bling, gadgets, computer chips, honeycomb and more. Don’t forget to top it off with diamonds and rubies! 
• Relax and enjoy this ASMR game with anti-stress sounds, visuals, and tasty virtual treats. Who knew sushi could be so soothing?
• Check out the in-game store to buy special bonuses and upgrades.
• The user-friendly and easy-to-learn interface makes it easy to jump in and get rolling.
What other game can serve you tasty sushi, engaging and satisfying gameplay, a chill ASMR atmosphere, and the opportunity to run your own restaurant? Once you find yourself on a roll, you won’t be able to put this game down!
Well, what are you waiting for? Step up to the cutting board and start cooking! Chop-chop! 
► Download the game now and get your sushi on!

bluejetty:00119976:ios.description:
This app is an engaging and educational tool designed to help babies and preschool toddlers enjoy learning new words. It features high-quality, real-life picture flashcards and supports pronunciation in Mandarin, Cantonese, and English, allowing children to explore languages in a fun and interactive way. With 29 categories and over 500 words, it is an ideal early education resource for young learners.
Features:
 ● Two pronunciation modes: Mandarin/English and Cantonese/English. 
 ● A comprehensive set of high-quality, real-picture flashcards. 
 ● Over 500 words across 29 categories, covering all aspects of daily life.

 ● Interactive quiz sessions and memory matching games to help children learn happily while tracking their progress. 
 ● New [Learn Chinese Characters] section: Divided into Basic and Advanced levels, helping kids recognize characters and learn stroke orders through interactive play. 
 ● English Enlightenment games: Designed to build confidence and help children remember basic English vocabulary in everyday scenarios. 
 ● Toddler Play House & Animal Puzzles: Simple, fun puzzles to help toddlers recognize different animals. 
 ● Learn to Count: Introduces the basic concepts of numbers in an engaging way.
 ● Full support for both Simplified and Traditional Chinese. 
 ● Simple, kid-friendly navigation interface.

It features high-quality, real-life picture flashcards and supports pronunciation in Mandarin, Cantonese, and English, allowing children to explore languages in a fun and interactive way. With 29 categories and over 500 words, it is an ideal early education resource for young learners.

Features:
 ● Two pronunciation modes: Mandarin/English and Cantonese/English. 
 ● A comprehensive set of high-quality, real-picture flashcards. 
 ● Over 500 words across 29 categories, covering all aspects of daily life. 
 ● Categories include: wild animals, vehicles, farm animals, food, vegetables, fruits, numbers, shapes, colors, plants, weather, digital devices, body parts, national flags, sports, family, daily supplies, marine organisms, occupations, furniture, clothes, insects, festivals, time, seasons, stationery, and more.
 ● Interactive quiz sessions and memory matching games to help children learn happily while tracking their progress. 
 ● New [Learn Chinese Characters] section: Divided into Basic and Advanced levels, helping kids recognize characters and learn stroke orders through interactive play. 
 ● English Enlightenment games: Designed to build confidence and help children remember basic English vocabulary in everyday scenarios. 
 ● Toddler Play House & Animal Puzzles: Simple, fun puzzles to help toddlers recognize different animals. 
 ● Learn to Count: Introduces the basic concepts of numbers in an engaging way.
 ● Full support for both Simplified and Traditional Chinese. 
 ● Simple, kid-friendly navigation interface.

Contact us:
Website: http://www.iappsteam.com
E-mail: support@iappsteam.com

bluejetty:00160018:ios.description:
**MMGuardian Parental Control apps** helps parents keep their kids safe online, manage screen time, track location, block apps, and monitor kids phone usage. 
As a leading **parental control app**, MMGuardian gives you all the tools to protect your child from digital risks and guide them towards healthy device habits. 
It is also a robust alternative to Google Family Link, offering even more advanced monitoring and parental control features. 
But it can also be used together with google family link since google family link doesn't offer any child monitoring features. 
---
### Key Features of MMGuardian Parental Control:
**Monitor & Manage:**
- View your child's location, SMS text messages, app usage, call logs, and web seach and web browsing.
- Receive safety alerts when messages or searches indicate dangers such as sexting, drugs, cyberbullying, grooming, violence, or suicidal thoughts.
- Monitor phone calls: see who your child is calling and receiving calls from.
**Control Screen Time & Block Apps:**
- Set daily screen time limits.
- Block or allow apps easily with the built-in app blocker.
- Schedule when specific apps can be used to avoid distractions.
**Safe Browsing & Web Filtering:**
- Block inappropriate websites.
- Get alerts for harmful web searches.
**GPS Location Tracker & Family Locator:**
- Track your child's phone location in real-time.
- View location history and know where they have been.
**Remote Lock & Control:**
- Lock or unlock your child's phone remotely.
- Wipe the child's phone when it is lost
- Buzz the child phone even when it is on mute
- Prevent phone use during school, bedtime, or family time.
---
### Social Media Chat Monitoring for Iphones: 
MMGuardian monitors messages from popular social media apps:
- WhatsApp
- Kik
- Discord
Get alerts if a chat contains signs of sexting, cyberbullying, grooming, or dangerous behavior.
---
### Detailed Reports:
- Full reports of text messages, call logs, app usage, and web activity.
- Understand your child's phone habits with easy-to-read summaries.
---
### Why MMGuardian Parental Control Apps:
MMGuardian allows parents to:
- Monitor kids phone activity and ensure their safety online.
- Limit screen time and reduce excessive phone use.
- Protect against cyberbullying, grooming, and inappropriate content.
- Track phone location with GPS tracker and family locator.
- Control everything remotely from your phone.
- Enjoy a reliable family link alternative with customizable options.
---
### Free 14-Day Trial:
Use all premium features FREE for 14 days. After the trial, continue protecting your child by subscribing:
- $4.99/month or $49.99/year for one child phone.
- Family plans available for up to 5 child devices.
---
We encourage parents to openly discuss using a **parental control app** with their children. Explain how it helps protect them from risks such as screen time addiction, cyberbullying, sexting, and online predators, while teaching responsible digital behavior.
- Cancellation of a current subscription during the active subscription period is not permitted.
- Any unused portion of the free trial period was forfeited when a subscription is purchased.
Battery use disclaimer: This application uses GPS for location services. Continued use of GPS running in the background can dramatically decrease battery life.
Our Privacy Policy may be reviewed at https://www.mmguardian.com/privacy
Our Terms of Service may be reviewed at: https://www.mmguardian.com/terms

bluejetty:00121238:ios.description:
Chaos has erupted in the Tar-Liss Empire in these detective games! An ancient dragon has returned to take revenge on the Empire and transform all of humanity into dark creatures. Now it’s up to you – the Honored Healer – to go through challenges in new hidden object games and save the Empire again! Can you find all the dragon’s artifacts and hidden pictures, heal the residents of the Empire, and put a stop to the dragon’s evil plan, or will you find yourself his next victim? Find out in this fantasy game Enchanted Kingdom: Darkness!
· THE DARK DRAGONS RETURN FOR VENGEANCE IN THE EXCITING BONUS CHAPTER!
Stop other dark dragons from taking revenge upon the Tar Empire in the Bonus Chapter full of hidden treasures, hidden objects games and puzzles!
· COMPLETE YOUR COLLECTION OF DRAGONS AND LORE!
Gather interesting knowledge and lore about dragons as you play hidden object adventure and challenging mini-games!
· SPEND YOUR DRAGON EGGS TO EQUIP YOUR IMPERIAL LABORATORY!
Collect dragon eggs and use them to improve your Imperial Laboratory! Play the games and find the hidden objects on each scene of the beautiful world of the Tar Empire!
· ENJOY EXCLUSIVE ARTWORK, WALLPAPERS, ACHIEVEMENTS, AND MORE!
This Collector’s Edition gives you an opportunity to replay your favorite mini-games and puzzles, download wallpapers and concept arts and enjoy many other bonuses, which you won’t have in a standard version!
· NEVER GET LOST WITH THE STRATEGY GUIDE!
Always know your next move while playing adventure games with a helpful Strategy Guide!
This game has a free trial part. You can unlock the full version through an in-app purchase.
-----
Questions? Email us at support@dominigames.com
Visit our website to search and find hidden object games: http://dominigames.com
Become our fan on Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/dominigames
Follow us on Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/dominigames

apple-itunes:458530296.description:
* Over 8 Million Downloads! - Come see what all the fuss is about *
===== WHAT PEOPLE ARE SAYING (or TWEETING)! =====
- "Freakingly addictive! Ski on Neon is the most addictive game I’ve played lately." Ruben Berenguel of whatsoniphone.com.
- “The game is pleasantly challenging and tremendous fun when you get your timing on the slopes right.” Clinton Ferreira of AppAdvice. 
- “Warning! This app is highly addictive! Neat concept, awesome music and it reminds me of how we all are all just skiing through space trying to catch some air.” Lydia2 via appolicious.com
- “Ski On Neon is the best game ever!!!!” shelbigogenson via Twitter
- “Seriously. Ski-on-Neon will be the cause of my high blood pressure.” Goodstuffsam via Twitter
- “My recent twitter neglect is due to my latest addiction: Ski On Neon!” Bearovski via Twitter
- “Amazing new concept but the difficulty is unmerciful!” OoOshii
LET'S HIT THE SLOPES!!!! - A high speed skier (with questionable fashion sense) jetting though over 36 unique and challenging levels! 
Mastered all the courses? The 'Red Menace' level pack gives you the option of 36 MORE LEVELS for just .99 cents. New backgrounds, new achievements and new, more difficult, courses! Feed your frustratingly addictive new habit with the 'Red Menace' level pack!!!
Ever wondered what skiing will be like in the futuristic utopian society that is just around the corner? So have we!!! Our guess is something like this...
Rule #1. If you can't do it on a NEON TUBE, then it's not worth doing!!
Rule #2. Strange brightly colored spandex suits are MANDATORY!
Rule #3. Anyone who does things well gets to turn into a FIREBALL!! (Which is weird, right?)
- Jet over buzzing NEON and perfect your skills in 8 DISTINCT GAMEPLAY MODES! - 
SIMPLE YET ADDICTIVE (possible familiar...) SINGLE BUTTON GAMEPLAY!!
Crouch and dive - Crouch and dive - Crouch and dive. Sounds easy right… We'll see about that.
TAKE TO THE SKY
Test your Big Air skills with HIGH FLYER gameplay mode.
RACE THE CLOCK
SPEED TRIALS offer fast pace and challenging slopes. "Let's get low, let's get fast" - Will Smith (Independence day) 
BRING IT ALL TOGETHER
Test your skills with TECH SLOPES gameplay. Beat the clock and catch big air. If you can't do both, your skills need some work.
BIG AIR - OVER AND OVER
Bring your high flying skills to a new level with VERTIGO CHALLENGE gameplay! Rack up altitude before the clock runs out!
FLOAT YOUR A%# OFF
Master your in air skills with the AIR TIME CHALLENGE gameplay. The clock is ticking, you better stay off the ground!!
PERFECT PERFECT..
No mistakes allowed in the infinite PRO SLIDER CHALLENGE! See how many perfect slides in a row you can get, but make one mistake and it's game over!
STOP PLAYING WITH YOURSELF
New 'Pass and Play' MULTIPLAYER gameplay lets you challenge a friend and compare 4 different Ski On Neon skill sets. Keeping it old school and forcing you to interact with friends in real life.
NEW SLOPES EVERY TIME YOU PLAY
Randomly generated slope EVERY TIME YOU START A NEW GAME. Never play the same level twice!
TRACK YOUR SCORES
6 leaderboards let you know where you stack up against your friends and against THE WORLD!!
TROPHIES! TROPHIES!
Over a two dozen achievement trophies. Some are easy as pie, some are much much more difficult than pie.
So let's suit up and take a trip into what we, and probably Zach Morris and Marty McFly, believe to be THE FUTURE of winter sports. We hope you enjoy it. Goods as advertised…You will literally SKI-ON-NEON! "Welcome to Earth!!" - Will Smith (Independence Day)
KABOOOOOM!!!

apple-itunes:715886886.name: Relisten — all live music
apple-itunes:715886886.description:
Relisten is the easiest way to carry 210,000+ live concert recordings in your pocket. Thousands of Grateful Dead shows, every Phish show on phish.in, and tens of thousands more from archive.org's Live Music Archive. Every recording comes from the tapers' tradition: fan-recorded with the artists' blessing and free to stream.
Every night of every tour, in your pocket.
Whether you're chasing a run, digging into a new band, or just hunting for a great random show, Relisten makes the entire archive easy to browse, play, and take with you.
What you get:
• Gapless playback between tracks — segues stay intact, the way the band played them
• Download any show for offline listening, anywhere
• CarPlay support for the road
• Cast to Google Cast devices at home
• Scrobble every play to Last.fm
• Shuffle or repeat, one song or a full show
• Browse by artist, year, venue, song, and source (SBD, AUD, and more)
• Sort by ratings, popularity, and what's trending right now
• Taper notes on every recording
• "Surprise me" random show when you can't decide what to play next
• Free, ad-free, and open source
Deep catalogs from the Grateful Dead, Phish, Widespread Panic, Billy Strings, Tedeschi Trucks Band, Dead & Company, Joe Russo's Almost Dead, Goose, Phil Lesh & Friends, King Gizzard & the Lizard Wizard, The Disco Biscuits, String Cheese Incident, Ween, moe., Yonder Mountain String Band, and Umphrey's McGee — plus thousands more artists from the Live Music Archive.
Built by live music fans, for live music fans.
Follow @relistenapp or join the Relisten Discord for updates, feedback, and what's coming next.

apple-macos:6761168308.name: Dialog | Messenger
apple-macos:6761168308.description:
Dialog brings personal conversations, teamwork and customer chats together. Message, call, share moments and turn plans into tasks.
WIDGETS IN CHATS
Vote on a meeting date, collect questions, or share a to-do list. Everyone can respond and check off items right in the conversation.
KEEP THE CONVERSATION GOING
Send text, photos, videos, files and voice messages in personal or group chats. Reply to a message, add reactions, pin important details and schedule messages. Start an audio or video call when a conversation needs more than text.
SAY IT WITH A DRAWING
Underline a word or draw a heart on a message. The original stays available, and you can see who added the marks. Send a standalone drawing that plays stroke by stroke. Choose a brush and color to make it your own. Drawings are not saved to your photo library automatically.
A SPACE FOR YOUR COMPANY
Switch between your personal and business accounts. Talk to customers and colleagues, create team chats and assign inquiries to staff or departments. Keep work conversations separate from personal ones.
FIND AND MESSAGE A COMPANY
Search the directory by company name or tax ID, view its profile and contact the right department. Business accounts require company verification; some actions may require a qualified electronic signature.
TURN CONVERSATIONS INTO TASKS
Create tasks, lists and reminders in a chat. Assign an owner, discuss details in comments and track progress.
KEEP FILES ORGANIZED
Collect documents in storage, organize them in folders and open what you need from a conversation. Choose photo and video quality before sending.
SHARE A MOMENT IN REELS
Post photos and videos for 24 hours. Add captions and choose your audience. Watch, reply and react to other posts.
CHOOSE HOW PEOPLE FIND YOU
